21:2.en: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play

21:3.ar: لَٰهِيَةࣰ قُلُوبُهُمْۖ وَأَسَرُّواْ اُ۬لنَّجْوَي اَ۬لذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثْلُكُمُۥٓۖ أَفَتَاتُونَ اَ۬لسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَۖ
21:3.en: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)

21:4.ar: قُل رَّبِّے يَعْلَمُ اُ۬لْقَوْلَ فِے اِ۬لسَّمَآءِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لسَّمِيعُ اُ۬لْعَلِيمُۖ
21:4.en: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower

21:5.ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓاْ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمِۢ بَلِ اِ۪فْتَر۪يٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرࣱۖ فَلْيَاتِنَا بِـَٔايَةࣲ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ اَ۬لَاوَّلُونَۖ
21:5.en: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents)

21:6.ar: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنَٰهَآۖ أَفَهُمْ يُومِنُونَۖ
21:6.en: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe

21:7.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالاࣰ يُوح۪يٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ فَسْـَٔلُوٓاْ أَهْلَ اَ۬لذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَۖ
21:7.en: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not

21:8.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَداࣰ لَّا يَاكُلُونَ اَ۬لطَّعَامَۖ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَٰلِدِينَۖ
21:8.en: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals

21:9.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ اُ۬لْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا اَ۬لْمُسْرِفِينَۖ
21:9.en: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals

21:10.ar: لَقَدَ اَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰباࣰ فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمُۥٓۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَۖ
21:10.en: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense

21:11.ar: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةࣲ كَانَت ظَّالِمَةࣰ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْماً اٰخَرِينَۖ
21:11.en: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk

21:12.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَۖ
21:12.en: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it

21:13.ar: لَا تَرْكُضُواْ وَارْجِعُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَۖ
21:13.en: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned

21:14.en: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers

21:15.ar: ۞فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْو۪يٰهُمْ حَتَّيٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيداً خَٰمِدِينَۖ
21:15.en: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct

21:16.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا اَ۬لسَّمَآءَ وَالَارْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَۖ
21:16.en: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play

21:17.ar: لَوَ اَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْواࣰ لَّاتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآۖ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَۖ
21:17.en: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did

21:18.ar: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِالْحَقِّ عَلَي اَ۬لْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقࣱۖ وَلَكُمُ اُ۬لْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَۖ
21:18.en: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

21:19.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَۖ
21:19.en: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary

21:20.en: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not

21:21.ar: أَمِ اِ۪تَّخَذُوٓاْ ءَالِهَةࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لَارْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَۖ
21:21.en: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead

21:22.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ اِلَّا اَ۬للَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَاۖ فَسُبْحَٰنَ اَ۬للَّهِ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَۖ
21:22.en: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him)

21:23.ar: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُۖ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَۖ
21:23.en: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned

21:24.ar: أَمِ اِ۪تَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةࣰۖ قُلْ هَاتُواْ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِے وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِےۖ بَلَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ اَ۬لْحَقَّ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَۖ
21:24.en: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse

21:25.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا يُوح۪يٰٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا فَاعْبُدُونِۖ
21:25.en: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me

21:26.ar: وَقَالُواْ اُ۪تَّخَذَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَداࣰۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥۖ بَلْ عِبَادࣱ مُّكْرَمُونَۖ
21:26.en: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves

21:27.ar: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِالْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَۖ
21:27.en: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command

21:28.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْۖ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ اِ۪رْتَض۪يٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَۖ
21:28.en: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him

21:29.ar: وَمَنْ يَّقُلْ مِنْهُمُۥٓ إِنِّيَ إِلَٰهࣱ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَۖ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِے اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
21:29.en: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers

21:30.ar: ۞أَوَلَمْ يَرَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقاࣰ فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَاۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ اَ۬لْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَےْءٍ حَيٍّۖ اَفَلَا يُومِنُونَۖ
21:30.en: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe

21:31.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْۖ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجاࣰ سُبُلاࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَۖ
21:31.en: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way

21:32.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا اَ۬لسَّمَآءَ سَقْفاࣰ مَّحْفُوظاࣰۖ وَهُمْ عَنَ اٰيَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَۖ
21:32.en: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents

21:33.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَ اَ۬ليْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ وَالشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَۖ كُلࣱّ فِے فَلَكࣲ يَسْبَحُونَۖ
21:33.en: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit

21:34.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرࣲ مِّن قَبْلِكَ اَ۬لْخُلْدَۖ أَفَإِيْن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ اُ۬لْخَٰلِدُونَۖ
21:34.en: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal

21:35.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسࣲ ذَآئِقَةُ اُ۬لْمَوْتِۖ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِالشَّرِّ وَالْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةࣰۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَۖ
21:35.en: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned

21:36.ar: وَإِذَا ر۪ء۪اكَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنْ يَّتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُؤاًۖ اَهَٰذَا اَ۬لذِے يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَۖ
21:36.en: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent

21:37.ar: خُلِقَ اَ۬لِانسَٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلࣲۖ سَأُوْرِيكُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِے فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِۖ
21:37.en: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten

21:38.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَت۪يٰ هَٰذَا اَ۬لْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَۖ
21:38.en: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

21:39.ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَنْ وُّجُوهِهِمُ اُ۬لنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَۖ
21:39.en: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped

21:40.ar: بَلْ تَاتِيهِم بَغْتَةࣰ فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَۖ
21:40.en: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved

21:41.ar: وَلَقَدُ اُ۟سْتُهْزِۓَ بِرُسُلࣲ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِالذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَۖ
21:41.en: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them

21:42.ar: ۞قُلْ مَنْ يَّكْلَؤُكُم بِاليْلِ وَالنَّه۪ارِ مِنَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِۖ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَۖ
21:42.en: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord

21:43.ar: أَمْ لَهُمُۥٓ ءَالِهَةࣱ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَاۖ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَۖ
21:43.en: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us

21:44.ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّيٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ اُ۬لْعُمُرُۖ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَاتِے اِ۬لَارْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنَ اَطْرَافِهَآۖ أَفَهُمُ اُ۬لْغَٰلِبُونَۖ
21:44.en: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors

21:45.ar: قُلِ اِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِالْوَحْيِۖ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ اُ۬لصُّمُّ اُ۬لدُّعَآءَ ا۪ذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَۖ
21:45.en: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned

21:46.ar: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةࣱ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَۖ
21:46.en: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers

21:47.ar: وَنَضَعُ اُ۬لْمَوَٰزِينَ اَ۬لْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ اِ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسࣱ شَئْاࣰۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةࣲ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ اَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَف۪يٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَۖ
21:47.en: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners

21:48.ar: وَلَقَدَ اٰتَيْنَا مُوس۪يٰ وَهَٰرُونَ اَ۬لْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءࣰ وَذِكْراࣰ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
21:48.en: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil

21:49.ar: اَ۬لذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ اَ۬لسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَۖ
21:49.en: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom)

21:50.ar: وَهَٰذَا ذِكْرࣱ مُّبَٰرَكٌ اَنزَلْنَٰهُۖ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَۖ
21:50.en: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it

21:51.ar: ۞وَلَقَدَ اٰتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَٰلِمِينَۖ
21:51.en: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him

21:52.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذِهِ اِ۬لتَّمَاثِيلُ اُ۬لتِےٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَٰكِفُونَۖ
21:52.en: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion

21:53.en: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them

21:54.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمُۥٓ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِے ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲۖ
21:54.en: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error

21:55.ar: قَالُوٓاْ أَجِئْتَنَا بِالْحَقِّ أَمَ اَنتَ مِنَ اَ۬للَّٰعِبِينَۖ
21:55.en: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester

21:56.ar: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ اِ۬لذِے فَطَرَهُنَّۖ وَأَنَا عَلَيٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لشَّٰهِدِينَۖ
21:56.en: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that

21:57.ar: وَتَاللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدْبِرِينَۖ
21:57.en: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs

21:58.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذاً اِلَّا كَبِيراࣰ لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمُۥٓ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَۖ
21:58.en: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it

21:59.ar: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
21:59.en: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer

21:60.ar: قَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا فَتيࣰ يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُۖ
21:60.en: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham

21:61.ar: قَالُواْ فَاتُواْ بِهِۦ عَلَيٰٓ أَعْيُنِ اِ۬لنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَۖ
21:61.en: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify

21:62.ar: قَالُوٓاْ ءَآنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُۖ
21:62.en: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham

21:63.ar: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمُۥٓ إِن كَانُواْ يَنطِقُونَۖ
21:63.en: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak

21:64.ar: فَرَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَيٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمُۥٓ أَنتُمُ اُ۬لظَّٰلِمُونَۖ
21:64.en: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers

21:65.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُواْ عَلَيٰ رُءُوسِهِمْۖ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَۖ
21:65.en: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not

21:66.ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَئْاࣰ وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمُۥٓۖ
21:66.en: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you

21:67.ar: أُفࣲّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَۖ
21:67.en: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense

21:68.ar: قَالُواْ حَرِّقُوهُ وَانصُرُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتَكُمُۥٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَۖ
21:68.en: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing

21:69.ar: قُلْنَا يَٰنَارُ كُونِے بَرْداࣰ وَسَلَٰماً عَلَيٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَۖ
21:69.en: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham

21:70.en: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers

21:71.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَلُوطاً اِلَي اَ۬لَارْضِ اِ۬لتِے بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
21:71.en: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples

21:72.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَۖ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةࣰۖ وَكُلّاࣰ جَعَلْنَا صَٰلِحِينَۖ
21:72.en: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous

21:73.ar: ۞وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُۥٓ أَئِمَّةࣰ يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَاۖ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ اَ۬لْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ اَ۬لصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ اَ۬لزَّكَوٰةِۖ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا عَٰبِدِينَۖ
21:73.en: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone)

21:74.ar: وَلُوطاً اٰتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْماࣰ وَعِلْماࣰۖ وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ اَ۬لْقَرْيَةِ اِ۬لتِے كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ اُ۬لْخَبَٰٓئِثَۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمَ سَوْءࣲ فَٰسِقِينَۖ
21:74.en: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd

21:75.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُ فِے رَحْمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحِينَۖ
21:75.en: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous

21:76.ar: وَنُوحاً اِذْ نَاد۪يٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ اَ۬لْكَرْبِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِۖ
21:76.en: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction

21:77.ar: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُ مِنَ اَ۬لْقَوْمِ اِ۬لذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْمَ سَوْءࣲ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَۖ
21:77.en: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all

21:78.ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَٰنِ فِے اِ۬لْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ اُ۬لْقَوْمِۖ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَٰهِدِينَۖ
21:78.en: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment

21:79.ar: فَفَهَّمْنَٰهَا سُلَيْمَٰنَۖ وَكُلّاً اٰتَيْنَا حُكْماࣰ وَعِلْماࣰۖ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ اَ۬لْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَالطَّيْرَۖ وَكُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَۖ
21:79.en: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof)

21:80.ar: وَعَلَّمْنَٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسࣲ لَّكُمْ لِيُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْۖ فَهَلَ اَنتُمْ شَٰكِرُونَۖ
21:80.en: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful

21:81.ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَٰنَ اَ۬لرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةࣰ تَجْرِے بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَي اَ۬لَارْضِ اِ۬لتِے بَٰرَكْنَا فِيهَاۖ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عَٰلِمِينَۖ
21:81.en: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware

21:82.ar: وَمِنَ اَ۬لشَّيَٰطِينِ مَنْ يَّغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلاࣰ دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَۖ
21:82.en: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them

21:83.ar: وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَاد۪يٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّے مَسَّنِيَ اَ۬لضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ اُ۬لرَّٰحِمِينَۖ
21:83.en: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy

21:84.ar: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرࣲّۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةࣰ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْر۪يٰ لِلْعَٰبِدِينَۖ
21:84.en: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers

21:85.ar: وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا اَ۬لْكِفْلِۖ كُلࣱّ مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰبِرِينَۖ
21:85.en: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast

21:86.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَٰهُمْ فِے رَحْمَتِنَآۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحِينَۖ
21:86.en: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous

21:87.ar: ۞وَذَا اَ۬لنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَٰضِباࣰ فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَاد۪يٰ فِے اِ۬لظُّلُمَٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّے كُنتُ مِنَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
21:87.en: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer

21:88.ar: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ مِنَ اَ۬لْغَمِّۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُۨجِے اِ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
21:88.en: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers

21:89.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّآءَ ا۪ذْ نَاد۪يٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِے فَرْداࣰ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لْوَٰرِثِينَۖ
21:89.en: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors

21:90.ar: فَاسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْي۪يٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِے اِ۬لْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَباࣰ وَرَهَباࣰ وَكَانُواْ لَنَا خَٰشِعِينَۖ
21:90.en: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us

21:91.ar: وَالتِےٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا وَابْنَهَآ ءَايَةࣰ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
21:91.en: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples

21:92.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمُۥٓ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰۖ وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِۖ
21:92.en: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me

21:93.ar: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْۖ كُلٌّ اِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَۖ
21:93.en: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us

21:94.ar: فَمَنْ يَّعْمَلْ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُومِنࣱ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَۖ
21:94.en: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him

21:95.ar: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَيٰ قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَۖ
21:95.en: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return

21:96.ar: حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَاجُوجُ وَمَاجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبࣲ يَنسِلُونَ
21:96.en: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound

21:97.ar: وَاقْتَرَبَ اَ۬لْوَعْدُ اُ۬لْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِيَ شَٰخِصَةٌ اَبْصَٰرُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِے غَفْلَةࣲ مِّنْ هَٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَۖ
21:97.en: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers

21:98.ar: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَۖ
21:98.en: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come

21:99.ar: لَوْ كَانَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ اَ۟لِهَةࣰ مَّا وَرَدُوهَاۖ وَكُلࣱّ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَۖ
21:99.en: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein

21:100.ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرࣱ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَۖ
21:100.en: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not

21:101.ar: ۞إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا اَ۬لْحُسْن۪يٰٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَۖ
21:101.en: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence

21:102.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا وَهُمْ فِے مَا اَ۪شْتَهَتَ اَنفُسُهُمْ خَٰلِدُونَۖ
21:102.en: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire

21:103.ar: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ اُ۬لْفَزَعُ اُ۬لَاكْبَرُۖ وَتَتَلَقّ۪يٰهُمُ اُ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ هَٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ اُ۬لذِے كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَۖ
21:103.en: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised

21:104.ar: يَوْمَ نَطْوِے اِ۬لسَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ اِ۬لسِّجِلِّ لِلْكِتَٰبِۖ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقࣲ نُّعِيدُهُۥۖ وَعْداً عَلَيْنَآۖ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَۖ
21:104.en: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it

21:105.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِے اِ۬لزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ اِ۬لذِّكْرِ أَنَّ اَ۬لَارْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِيَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحُونَۖ
21:105.en: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth

21:106.ar: إِنَّ فِے هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغاࣰ لِّقَوْمٍ عَٰبِدِينَۖ
21:106.en: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout

21:107.en: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples

21:108.ar: قُلِ اِنَّمَا يُوح۪يٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُۥٓ إِلَٰهࣱ وَٰحِدࣱۖ فَهَلَ اَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَۖ
21:108.en: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)

21:109.ar: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْاْ فَقُلَ اٰذَنتُكُمْ عَلَيٰ سَوَآءࣲۖ وَإِنَ اَدْرِےٓ أَقَرِيبٌ اَم بَعِيدࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَۖ
21:109.en: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised

21:110.ar: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ اُ۬لْجَهْرَ مِنَ اَ۬لْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَۖ
21:110.en: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal

21:111.ar: وَإِنَ اَدْرِے لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةࣱ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَٰعٌ اِلَيٰ حِينࣲۖ
21:111.en: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while

21:112.ar: قُل رَّبِّ اِ۟حْكُم بِالْحَقِّۖ وَرَبُّنَا اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ اُ۬لْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَيٰ مَا تَصِفُونَۖ
21:112.en: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

22:1.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لنَّاسُ اُ۪تَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ اَ۬لسَّاعَةِ شَےْءٌ عَظِيمࣱۖ
22:1.en: O mankind! Fear your Lord. Lo! the earthquake of the Hour (of Doom) is a tremendous thing

22:2.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَوْنَهَا تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ مُرْضِعَةٍ عَمَّآ أَرْضَعَتْ وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ ذَاتِ حَمْلٍ حَمْلَهَا وَتَرَي اَ۬لنَّاسَ سُكَٰر۪يٰ وَمَا هُم بِسُكَٰر۪يٰ وَلَٰكِنَّ عَذَابَ اَ۬للَّهِ شَدِيدࣱۖ
22:2.en: On the day when ye behold it, every nursing mother will forget her nursling and every pregnant one will be delivered of her burden, and thou (Muhammad) wilt see mankind as drunken, yet they will not be drunken, but the Doom of Allah will be strong (upon them)

22:3.ar: وَمِنَ اَ۬لنَّاسِ مَنْ يُّجَٰدِلُ فِے اِ۬للَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمࣲ وَيَتَّبِعُ كُلَّ شَيْطَٰنࣲ مَّرِيدࣲ‏
22:3.en: Among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge, and followeth each froward devil

22:4.ar: كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ مَن تَوَلّ۪اهُ فَأَنَّهُۥ يُضِلُّهُۥ وَيَهْدِيهِ إِلَيٰ عَذَابِ اِ۬لسَّعِيرِۖ
22:4.en: For him it is decreed that whoso taketh him for friend, he verily will mislead him and will guide him to the punishment of the Flame

22:5.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لنَّاسُ إِن كُنتُمْ فِے رَيْبࣲ مِّنَ اَ۬لْبَعْثِ فَإِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن تُرَابࣲ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةࣲ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةࣲ ثُمَّ مِن مُّضْغَةࣲ مُّخَلَّقَةࣲ وَغَيْرِ مُخَلَّقَةࣲ لِّنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْۖ وَنُقِرُّ فِے اِ۬لَارْحَامِ مَا نَشَآءُ اِ۪لَيٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمّيࣰۖ ثُمَّ نُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلاࣰ ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓاْ أَشُدَّكُمْۖ وَمِنكُم مَّنْ يُّتَوَفّ۪يٰ وَمِنكُم مَّنْ يُّرَدُّ إِلَيٰٓ أَرْذَلِ اِ۬لْعُمُرِ لِكَيْلَا يَعْلَمَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ عِلْمࣲ شَئْاࣰۖ وَتَرَي اَ۬لَارْضَ هَامِدَةࣰ فَإِذَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا اَ۬لْمَآءَ اَ۪هْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ وَأَنۢبَتَتْ مِن كُلِّ زَوْجِۢ بَهِيجࣲۖ
22:5.en: O mankind! if ye are in doubt concerning the Resurrection, then lo! We have created you from dust, then from a drop of seed, then from a clot, then from a little lump of flesh shapely and shapeless, that We may make (it) clear for you. And We cause what We will to remain in the wombs for an appointed time, and afterward We bring you forth as infants, then (give you growth) that ye attain your full strength. And among you there is he who dieth (young), and among you there is he who is brought back to the most abject time of life, so that, after knowledge, he knoweth naught. And thou (Muhammad) seest the earth barren, but when We send down water thereon, it doth thrill and swell and put forth every lovely kind (of growth)

22:6.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لْحَقُّ وَأَنَّهُۥ يُحْيِ اِ۬لْمَوْت۪يٰ وَأَنَّهُۥ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ‏
22:6.en: That is because Allah, He is the Truth and because He quickeneth the dead, and because He is Able to do all things

22:7.ar: وَأَنَّ اَ۬لسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةࣱ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَبْعَثُ مَن فِے اِ۬لْقُبُورِۖ
22:7.en: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves

22:8.ar: وَمِنَ اَ۬لنَّاسِ مَنْ يُّجَٰدِلُ فِے اِ۬للَّهِ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمࣲ وَلَا هُديࣰ وَلَا كِتَٰبࣲ مُّنِيرࣲ‏
22:8.en: And among mankind is he who disputeth concerning Allah without knowledge or guidance or a scripture giving light

22:9.ar: ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِۦ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ لَهُۥ فِے اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا خِزْيࣱۖ وَنُذِيقُهُۥ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ عَذَابَ اَ۬لْحَرِيقِۖ
22:9.en: Turning away in pride to beguile (men) from the way of Allah. For him in this world is ignominy, and on the Day of Resurrection We make him taste the doom of burning

22:10.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَٰكَ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَيْسَ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلْعَبِيدِۖ
22:10.en: (And unto him it will be said): This is for that which thy two hands have sent before, and because Allah is no oppressor of His slaves

22:11.ar: ۞وَمِنَ اَ۬لنَّاسِ مَنْ يَّعْبُدُ اُ۬للَّهَ عَلَيٰ حَرْفࣲ فَإِنَ اَصَابَهُۥ خَيْرٌ اِ۪طْمَأَنَّ بِهِۦ وَإِنَ اَصَابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ اِ۪نقَلَبَ عَلَيٰ وَجْهِهِۦ خَسِرَ اَ۬لدُّنْي۪ا وَالَاخِرَةَۖ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ اَ۬لْخُسْرَانُ اُ۬لْمُبِينُۖ
22:11.en: And among mankind is he who worshippeth Allah upon a narrow marge so that if good befalleth him he is content therewith, but if a trial befalleth him, he falleth away utterly. He loseth both the world and the Hereafter. That is the sheer loss

22:12.ar: يَدْعُواْ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ مَا لَا يَضُرُّهُۥ وَمَا لَا يَنفَعُهُۥۖ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ اَ۬لضَّلَٰلُ اُ۬لْبَعِيدُۖ
22:12.en: He calleth, beside Allah, unto that which hurteth him not nor benefiteth him. That is the far error

22:13.ar: يَدْعُواْۖ لَمَن ضَرُّهُۥٓ أَقْرَبُ مِن نَّفْعِهِۦ لَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَوْل۪يٰ وَلَبِيسَ اَ۬لْعَشِيرُۖ
22:13.en: He calleth unto him whose harm is nearer than his benefit; verily an evil patron and verily an evil friend

22:14.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُدْخِلُ اُ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يُرِيدُۖ
22:14.en: Lo! Allah causeth those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Lo! Allah doth what He intendeth

22:15.ar: مَن كَانَ يَظُنُّ أَن لَّنْ يَّنصُرَهُ اُ۬للَّهُ فِے اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا وَالَاخِرَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ اِلَي اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لِيَقْطَعْ فَلْيَنظُرْ هَلْ يُذْهِبَنَّ كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُۖ
22:15.en: Whoso is wont to think (through envy) that Allah will not give him (Muhammad) victory in the world and the Hereafter (and is enraged at the thought of his victory), let him stretch a rope up to the roof (of his dwelling), and let him hang himself. Then let him see whether his strategy dispelleth that whereat he rageth

22:16.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِۢ بَيِّنَٰتࣲۖ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَهْدِے مَنْ يُّرِيدُۖ
22:16.en: Thus We reveal it as plain revelations, and verily Allah guideth whom He will

22:17.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَالذِينَ هَادُواْ وَالصَّٰبِينَ وَالنَّصَٰر۪يٰ وَالْمَجُوسَ وَالذِينَ أَشْرَكُوٓاْ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ شَهِيدٌۖ
22:17.en: Lo! those who believe (this revelation), and those who are Jews, and the Sabaeans and the Christians and the Magians and the idolaters - Lo! Allah will decide between them on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! Allah is Witness over all things

22:18.ar: اَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَسْجُدُ لَهُۥ مَن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَالشَّمْسُ وَالْقَمَرُ وَالنُّجُومُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَالشَّجَرُ وَالدَّوَآبُّ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لنَّاسِۖ وَكَثِيرٌ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ اِ۬لْعَذَابُۖ وَمَنْ يُّهِنِ اِ۬للَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّكْرِمٍۖ اِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُۖ۩
22:18.en: Hast thou not seen that unto Allah payeth adoration whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is in the earth, and the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and the hills, and the trees, and the beasts, and many of mankind, while there are many unto whom the doom is justly due. He whom Allah scorneth, there is none to give him honour. Lo! Allah doeth what He will

22:19.ar: ۞هَٰذَٰنِ خَصْمَٰنِ اِ۪خْتَصَمُواْ فِے رَبِّهِمْۖ فَالذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قُطِّعَتْ لَهُمْ ثِيَابࣱ مِّن نّ۪ارࣲ يُصَبُّ مِن فَوْقِ رُءُوسِهِمُ اُ۬لْحَمِيمُ
22:19.en: These twain (the believers and the disbelievers) are two opponents who contend concerning their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, garments of fire will be cut out for them; boiling fluid will be poured down on their heads

22:20.ar: يُصْهَرُ بِهِۦ مَا فِے بُطُونِهِمْ وَالْجُلُودُۖ
22:20.en: Whereby that which is in their bellies, and their skins too, will be melted

22:21.en: And for them are hooked rods of iron

22:22.ar: كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓاْ أَنْ يَّخْرُجُواْ مِنْهَا مِنْ غَمٍّ ا۟عِيدُواْ فِيهَاۖ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ اَ۬لْحَرِيقِۖ
22:22.en: Whenever, in their anguish, they would go forth from thence they are driven back therein and (it is said unto them): Taste the doom of burning

22:23.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُدْخِلُ اُ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ يُحَلَّوْنَ فِيهَا مِنَ اَسَاوِرَ مِن ذَهَبࣲ وَلُؤْلُؤاࣰۖ وَلِبَاسُهُمْ فِيهَا حَرِيرࣱۖ
22:23.en: Lo! Allah will cause those who believe and do good works to enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will be allowed armlets of gold, and pearls, and their raiment therein will be silk

22:24.ar: وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَي اَ۬لطَّيِّبِ مِنَ اَ۬لْقَوْلِۖ وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ صِرَٰطِ اِ۬لْحَمِيدِۖ
22:24.en: They are guided unto gentle speech; they are guided unto the path of the Glorious One

22:25.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَيَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ اِ۬لْحَرَامِ اِ۬لذِے جَعَلْنَٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ سَوَآءٌ اِ۬لْعَٰكِفُ فِيهِ وَالْبَادِۦۖ وَمَنْ يُّرِدْ فِيهِ بِإِلْحَادِۢ بِظُلْمࣲ نُّذِقْهُ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمࣲۖ
22:25.en: Lo! those who disbelieve and bar (men) from the way of Allah and from the Inviolable Place of Worship, which We have appointed for mankind together, the dweller therein and the nomad: whosoever seeketh wrongful partiality therein, him We shall cause to taste a painful doom

22:26.ar: وَإِذْ بَوَّأْنَا لِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ مَكَانَ اَ۬لْبَيْتِ أَن لَّا تُشْرِكْ بِے شَئْاࣰۖ وَطَهِّرْ بَيْتِيَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَالْقَآئِمِينَ وَالرُّكَّعِ اِ۬لسُّجُودِۖ
22:26.en: And (remember) when We prepared for Abraham the place of the (holy) House, saying: Ascribe thou no thing as partner unto Me, and purify My House for those who make the round (thereof) and those who stand and those who bow and make prostration

22:27.ar: وَأَذِّن فِے اِ۬لنَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَاتُوكَ رِجَالاࣰ وَعَلَيٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرࣲ يَاتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقࣲ‏
22:27.en: And proclaim unto mankind the pilgrimage. They will come unto thee on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every deep ravine

22:28.ar: لِّيَشْهَدُواْ مَنَٰفِعَ لَهُمْ وَيَذْكُرُواْ اُ۪سْمَ اَ۬للَّهِ فِےٓ أَيَّامࣲ مَّعْلُومَٰتٍ عَلَيٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ اِ۬لَانْعَٰمِۖ فَكُلُواْ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُواْ اُ۬لْبَآئِسَ اَ۬لْفَقِيرَۖ
22:28.en: That they may witness things that are of benefit to them, and mention the name of Allah on appointed days over the beast of cattle that He hath bestowed upon them. Then eat thereof and feed therewith the poor unfortunate

22:29.ar: ثُمَّ لِيَقْضُواْ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُواْ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُواْ بِالْبَيْتِ اِ۬لْعَتِيقِۖ
22:29.en: Then let them make an end of their unkemptness and pay their vows and go around the ancient House

22:30.ar: ۞ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَنْ يُّعَظِّمْ حُرُمَٰتِ اِ۬للَّهِ فَهُوَ خَيْرࣱ لَّهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦۖ وَأُحِلَّتْ لَكُمُ اُ۬لَانْعَٰمُ إِلَّا مَا يُتْل۪يٰ عَلَيْكُمْۖ فَاجْتَنِبُواْ اُ۬لرِّجْسَ مِنَ اَ۬لَاوْثَٰنِ وَاجْتَنِبُواْ قَوْلَ اَ۬لزُّورِ
22:30.en: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech

22:31.ar: حُنَفَآءَ لِلهِ غَيْرَ مُشْرِكِينَ بِهِۦۖ وَمَنْ يُّشْرِكْ بِاللَّهِ فَكَأَنَّمَا خَرَّ مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ فَتَخَطَّفُهُ اُ۬لطَّيْرُ أَوْ تَهْوِے بِهِ اِ۬لرِّيحُ فِے مَكَانࣲ سَحِيقࣲۖ
22:31.en: Turning unto Allah (only), not ascribing partners unto Him; for whoso ascribeth partners unto Allah, it is as if he had fallen from the sky and the birds had snatched him or the wind had blown him to a far-off place

22:32.ar: ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَنْ يُّعَظِّمْ شَعَٰٓئِرَ اَ۬للَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِن تَقْوَي اَ۬لْقُلُوبِۖ
22:32.en: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the offerings consecrated to Allah, it surely is from devotion of the hearts

22:33.ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ إِلَيٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمّيࣰ ثُمَّ مَحِلُّهَآ إِلَي اَ۬لْبَيْتِ اِ۬لْعَتِيقِۖ
22:33.en: Therein are benefits for you for an appointed term; and afterward they are brought for sacrifice unto the ancient House

22:34.ar: وَلِكُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكاࣰ لِّيَذْكُرُواْ اُ۪سْمَ اَ۬للَّهِ عَلَيٰ مَا رَزَقَهُم مِّنۢ بَهِيمَةِ اِ۬لَانْعَٰمِۖ فَإِلَٰهُكُمُۥٓ إِلَٰهࣱ وَٰحِدࣱۖ فَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلِمُواْۖ وَبَشِّرِ اِ۬لْمُخْبِتِينَ
22:34.en: And for every nation have We appointed a ritual, that they may mention the name of Allah over the beast of cattle that He hath given them for food; and your god is One God, therefor surrender unto Him. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the humble

22:35.ar: اَ۬لذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اَ۬للَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَالصَّٰبِرِينَ عَلَيٰ مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ وَالْمُقِيمِے اِ۬لصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَۖ
22:35.en: Whose hearts fear when Allah is mentioned, and the patient of whatever may befall them, and those who establish worship and who spend of that We have bestowed on them

22:36.ar: وَالْبُدْنَ جَعَلْنَٰهَا لَكُم مِّن شَعَٰٓئِرِ اِ۬للَّهِ لَكُمْ فِيهَا خَيْرࣱۖ فَاذْكُرُواْ اُ۪سْمَ اَ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْهَا صَوَآفَّۖ فَإِذَا وَجَبَتْ جُنُوبُهَا فَكُلُواْ مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُواْ اُ۬لْقَانِعَ وَالْمُعْتَرَّۖ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرْنَٰهَا لَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَۖ
22:36.en: And the camels! We have appointed them among the ceremonies of Allah. Therein ye have much good. So mention the name of Allah over them when they are drawn up in lines. Then when their flanks fall (dead), eat thereof and feed the beggar and the suppliant. Thus have We made them subject unto you, that haply ye may give thanks

22:37.ar: لَنْ يَّنَالَ اَ۬للَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَآؤُهَا وَلَٰكِنْ يَّنَالُهُ اُ۬لتَّقْو۪يٰ مِنكُمْۖ كَذَٰلِكَ سَخَّرَهَا لَكُمْ لِتُكَبِّرُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ عَلَيٰ مَا هَد۪يٰكُمْۖ وَبَشِّرِ اِ۬لْمُحْسِنِينَۖ
22:37.en: Their flesh and their food reach not Allah, but the devotion from you reacheth Him. Thus have We made them subject unto you that ye may magnify Allah that He hath guided you. And give good tidings (O Muhammad) to the good

22:38.ar: ۞إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُدَٰفِعُ عَنِ اِ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ خَوَّانࣲ كَفُورٍۖ
22:38.en: Lo! Allah defendeth those who are true. Lo! Allah loveth not each treacherous ingrate

22:39.ar: ا۟ذِنَ لِلذِينَ يُقَٰتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُواْۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ عَلَيٰ نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِيرٌۖ
22:39.en: Sanction is given unto those who fight because they have been wronged; and Allah is indeed Able to give them victory

22:40.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ أُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيٰ۪رِهِم بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ اِلَّآ أَنْ يَّقُولُواْ رَبُّنَا اَ۬للَّهُۖ وَلَوْلَا دِفَٰعُ اُ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لنَّاسَ بَعْضَهُم بِبَعْضࣲ لَّهُدِمَتْ صَوَٰمِعُ وَبِيَعࣱ وَصَلَوَٰتࣱ وَمَسَٰجِدُ يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا اَ۪سْمُ اُ۬للَّهِ كَثِيراࣰۖ وَلَيَنصُرَنَّ اَ۬للَّهُ مَنْ يَّنصُرُهُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌۖ
22:40.en: Those who have been driven from their homes unjustly only because they said: Our Lord is Allah - For had it not been for Allah's repelling some men by means of others, cloisters and churches and oratories and mosques, wherein the name of Allah is oft mentioned, would assuredly have been pulled down. Verily Allah helpeth one who helpeth Him. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

22:41.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ إِن مَّكَّنَّٰهُمْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ أَقَامُواْ اُ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتَوُاْ اُ۬لزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَمَرُواْ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَنَهَوْاْ عَنِ اِ۬لْمُنكَرِۖ وَلِلهِ عَٰقِبَةُ اُ۬لُامُورِۖ
22:41.en: Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish worship and pay the poor-due and enjoin kindness and forbid iniquity. And Allah's is the sequel of events

22:42.ar: وَإِنْ يُّكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدْ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَثَمُودُ
22:42.en: If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers)

22:43.en: And the folk of Abraham and the folk of Lot

22:44.ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ مَدْيَنَۖ وَكُذِّبَ مُوس۪يٰۖ فَأَمْلَيْتُ لِلْكٰ۪فِرِينَ ثُمَّ أَخَذتُّهُمْۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِۦۖ
22:44.en: (And) the dwellers in Midian. And Moses was denied; but I indulged the disbelievers a long while, then I seized them, and how (terrible) was My abhorrence

22:45.ar: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةࣱ فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَيٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِيرࣲ مُّعَطَّلَةࣲ وَقَصْرࣲ مَّشِيدٍۖ
22:45.en: How many a township have We destroyed while it was sinful, so that it lieth (to this day) in ruins, and (how many) a deserted well and lofty tower

22:46.ar: اَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ فَتَكُونَ لَهُمْ قُلُوبࣱ يَعْقِلُونَ بِهَآ أَوَ اٰذَانࣱ يَسْمَعُونَ بِهَاۖ فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَعْمَي اَ۬لَابْصَٰرُ وَلَٰكِن تَعْمَي اَ۬لْقُلُوبُ اُ۬لتِے فِے اِ۬لصُّدُورِۖ
22:46.en: Have they not travelled in the land, and have they hearts wherewith to feel and ears wherewith to hear? For indeed it is not the eyes that grow blind, but it is the hearts, which are within the bosoms, that grow blind

22:47.ar: وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ بِالْعَذَابِۖ وَلَنْ يُّخْلِفَ اَ۬للَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥۖ وَإِنَّ يَوْماً عِندَ رَبِّكَ كَأَلْفِ سَنَةࣲ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَۖ
22:47.en: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon

22:48.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ اَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةࣱ ثُمَّ أَخَذتُّهَاۖ وَإِلَيَّ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
22:48.en: And how many a township did I suffer long though it was sinful! Then I grasped it. Unto Me is the return

22:49.ar: ۞قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا لَكُمْ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱۖ
22:49.en: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you

22:50.ar: فَالذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةࣱ وَرِزْقࣱ كَرِيمࣱۖ
22:50.en: Those who believe and do good works, for them is pardon and a rich provision

22:51.ar: وَالذِينَ سَعَوْاْ فِےٓ ءَايَٰتِنَا مُعَٰجِزِينَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لْجَحِيمِۖ
22:51.en: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire

22:52.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولࣲ وَلَا نَبِےٓءٍ اِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنّ۪يٰٓ أَلْقَي اَ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ فِےٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ اُ۬للَّهُ مَا يُلْقِے اِ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ اُ۬للَّهُ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱ‏
22:52.en: Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise

22:53.ar: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِے اِ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةࣰ لِّلذِينَ فِے قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَالْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِے شِقَاقِۢ بَعِيدࣲۖ
22:53.en: That He may make that which the devil proposeth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease, and those whose hearts are hardened - Lo! the evil-doers are in open schism

22:54.ar: وَلِيَعْلَمَ اَ۬لذِينَ أُوتُواْ اُ۬لْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ اُ۬لْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُومِنُواْ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَهَادِ اِ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسْتَقِيمࣲۖ
22:54.en: And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from thy Lord, so that they may believe therein and their hearts may submit humbly unto Him. Lo! Allah verily is guiding those who believe unto a right path

22:55.ar: وَلَا يَزَالُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِے مِرْيَةࣲ مِّنْهُ حَتَّيٰ تَاتِيَهُمُ اُ۬لسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً اَوْ يَاتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍۖ
22:55.en: And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt thereof until the Hour come upon them unawares, or there come unto them the doom of a disastrous day

22:56.ar: اِ۬لْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذࣲ لِّلهِۖ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْۖ فَالذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِے جَنَّٰتِ اِ۬لنَّعِيمِۖ
22:56.en: The Sovereignty on that day will be Allah's, He will judge between them. Then those who believed and did good works will be in Gardens of Delight

22:57.ar: وَالذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِينࣱۖ
22:57.en: While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom

22:58.ar: وَالذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓاْ أَوْ مَاتُواْ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ رِزْقاً حَسَناࣰۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لرَّٰزِقِينَۖ
22:58.en: Those who fled their homes for the cause of Allah and then were slain or died, Allah verily will provide for them a good provision. Lo! Allah, He verily is Best of all who make provision

22:59.ar: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مَّدْخَلاࣰ يَرْضَوْنَهُۥۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمࣱۖ
22:59.en: Assuredly He will cause them to enter by an entry that they will love. Lo! Allah verily is Knower, Indulgent

22:60.ar: ۞ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِيَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ اُ۬للَّهُۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورࣱۖ
22:60.en: That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving

22:61.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُولِجُ اُ۬ليْلَ فِے اِ۬لنَّه۪ارِ وَيُولِجُ اُ۬لنَّهَارَ فِے اِ۬ليْلِ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرࣱۖ
22:61.en: That is because Allah maketh the night to pass into the day and maketh the day to pass into the night, and because Allah is Hearer, Seer

22:62.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ اَ۬لْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لْعَلِيُّ اُ۬لْكَبِيرُۖ
22:62.en: That is because Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false, and because Allah, He is the High, the Great

22:63.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَتُصْبِحُ اُ۬لَارْضُ مُخْضَرَّةًۖ اِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرࣱۖ
22:63.en: Seest thou not how Allah sendeth down water from the sky and then the earth becometh green upon the morrow? Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware

22:64.ar: لَّهُۥ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَهُوَ اَ۬لْغَنِيُّ اُ۬لْحَمِيدُۖ
22:64.en: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Lo! Allah, He verily is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

22:65.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَالْفُلْكَ تَجْرِے فِے اِ۬لْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۖۦ وَيُمْسِكُ اُ۬لسَّمَآءَ ان تَقَعَ عَلَي اَ۬لَارْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ بِالنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
22:65.en: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath made all that is in the earth subservient unto you? And the ship runneth upon the sea by His command, and He holdeth back the heaven from falling on the earth unless by His leave. Lo! Allah is, for mankind, Full of Pity, Merciful

22:66.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَحْي۪اكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْۖ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬لِانسَٰنَ لَكَفُورࣱۖ
22:66.en: And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate

22:67.ar: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةࣲ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكاً هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُۖ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِے اِ۬لَامْرِۖ وَادْعُ إِلَيٰ رَبِّكَۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَيٰ هُديࣰ مُّسْتَقِيمࣲۖ
22:67.en: Unto each nation have We given sacred rites which they are to perform; so let them not dispute with thee of the matter, but summon thou unto thy Lord. Lo! thou indeed followest right guidance

22:68.ar: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ اِ۬للَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَۖ
22:68.en: And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do

22:69.ar: اَ۬للَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَۖ
22:69.en: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ

22:70.ar: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمَ اَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَآءِ وَالَارْضِۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِے كِتَٰبٍۖ اِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ يَسِيرࣱۖ
22:70.en: Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah

22:71.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰناࣰ وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمࣱۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرࣲۖ
22:71.en: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper

22:72.ar: ۞وَإِذَا تُتْل۪يٰ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتࣲ تَعْرِفُ فِے وُجُوهِ اِ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ اُ۬لْمُنكَرَ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِالذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِنَاۖ قُلَ اَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرࣲّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُۖ اُ۬لنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ وَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
22:72.en: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end

22:73.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلࣱ فَاسْتَمِعُواْ لَهُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ لَنْ يَّخْلُقُواْ ذُبَاباࣰ وَلَوِ اِ۪جْتَمَعُواْ لَهُۥۖ وَإِنْ يَّسْلُبْهُمُ اُ۬لذُّبَابُ شَئْاࣰ لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُۖ ضَعُفَ اَ۬لطَّالِبُ وَالْمَطْلُوبُۖ
22:73.en: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought

22:74.ar: مَا قَدَرُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌۖ
22:74.en: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

22:75.ar: اِ۬للَّهُ يَصْطَفِے مِنَ اَ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلاࣰ وَمِنَ اَ۬لنَّاسِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرࣱۖ
22:75.en: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer

22:76.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْۖ وَإِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ تُرْجَعُ اُ۬لُامُورُۖ
22:76.en: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A

22:77.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اُ۪رْكَعُواْ وَاسْجُدُواْ وَاعْبُدُواْ رَبَّكُمْ وَافْعَلُواْ اُ۬لْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَۖ
22:77.en: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper

22:78.ar: وَجَٰهِدُواْ فِے اِ۬للَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦۖ هُوَ اَ۪جْتَب۪يٰكُمْۖ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِے اِ۬لدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجࣲۖ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَۖ هُوَ سَمّ۪يٰكُمُ اُ۬لْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِے هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ اَ۬لرَّسُولُ شَهِيداً عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُواْ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَي اَ۬لنَّاسِۖ فَأَقِيمُواْ اُ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ اُ۬لزَّكَوٰةَۖ وَاعْتَصِمُواْ بِاللَّهِۖ هُوَ مَوْل۪يٰكُمْۖ فَنِعْمَ اَ۬لْمَوْل۪يٰۖ وَنِعْمَ اَ۬لنَّصِيرُۖ
22:78.en: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper

23:2.en: Who are humble in their prayers

23:4.en: And who are payers of the poor-due

23:6.ar: إِلَّا عَلَيٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمُۥٓ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتَ اَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَۖ
23:6.en: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy

23:7.ar: فَمَنِ اِ۪بْتَغ۪يٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْعَادُونَۖ
23:7.en: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors

23:8.en: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant

23:9.en: And who pay heed to their prayers

23:11.ar: اَ۬لذِينَ يَرِثُونَ اَ۬لْفِرْدَوْسَۖ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَۖ
23:11.en: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide

23:12.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا اَ۬لِانسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةࣲ مِّن طِينࣲۖ
23:12.en: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth

23:13.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةࣰ فِے قَر۪ارࣲ مَّكِينࣲۖ
23:13.en: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging

23:14.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا اَ۬لنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةࣰ فَخَلَقْنَا اَ۬لْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةࣰ فَخَلَقْنَا اَ۬لْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰماࣰ فَكَسَوْنَا اَ۬لْعِظَٰمَ لَحْماࣰ ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقاً اٰخَرَۖ فَتَبَٰرَكَ اَ۬للَّهُ أَحْسَنُ اُ۬لْخَٰلِقِينَۖ
23:14.en: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators

23:15.en: Then lo! after that ye surely die

23:16.en: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again)

23:17.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَۖ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ اِ۬لْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَۖ
23:17.en: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation

23:18.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ مَآءَۢ بِقَدَرࣲ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَيٰ ذَهَابِۢ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَۖ
23:18.en: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it

23:19.ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعْنَٰبࣲ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةࣱ وَمِنْهَا تَاكُلُونَ
23:19.en: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat

23:20.ar: وَشَجَرَةࣰ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سِينَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغࣲ لِّلَاكِلِينَۖ
23:20.en: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters

23:21.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِے اِ۬لَانْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةࣰۖ نَّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِے بُطُونِهَاۖ وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةࣱ وَمِنْهَا تَاكُلُونَ
23:21.en: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat

23:22.en: And on them and on the ship ye are carried

23:23.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحاً اِلَيٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ اِ۟عْبُدُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنِ اِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَۖ
23:23.en: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)

23:24.ar: ۞فَقَالَ اَ۬لْمَلَؤُاْ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَّتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِےٓ ءَابَآئِنَا اَ۬لَاوَّلِينَ
23:24.en: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old

23:25.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلُۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةࣱ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ بِهِۦ حَتَّيٰ حِينࣲۖ
23:25.en: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while

23:26.en: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me

23:27.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ اِ۪صْنَعِ اِ۬لْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَاۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ امْرُنَا وَفَارَ اَ۬لتَّنُّورُ فَاسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجَيْنِ اِ۪ثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ اِ۬لْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِے فِے اِ۬لذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَۖ
23:27.en: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned

23:28.ar: فَإِذَا اَ۪سْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَي اَ۬لْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ اِ۬لْحَمْدُ لِلهِ اِ۬لذِے نَجّ۪يٰنَا مِنَ اَ۬لْقَوْمِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
23:28.en: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk

23:29.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِے مُنزَلاࣰ مُّبَٰرَكاࣰ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لْمُنزِلِينَۖ
23:29.en: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land

23:30.ar: إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲۖ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَۖ
23:30.en: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test

23:31.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْناً اٰخَرِينَ
23:31.en: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation

23:32.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولاࣰ مِّنْهُمُۥٓ أَنُ اُ۟عْبُدُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنِ اِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَۖ
23:32.en: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)

23:33.ar: وَقَالَ اَ۬لْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ اِ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ اِ۬لَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِے اِ۬لْحَيَوٰةِ اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَاكُلُ مِمَّا تَاكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
23:33.en: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink

23:34.ar: وَلَئِنَ اَطَعْتُم بَشَراࣰ مِّثْلَكُمُۥٓ إِنَّكُمُۥٓ إِذاࣰ لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
23:34.en: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers

23:35.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمُۥٓ أَنَّكُمُۥٓ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَاباࣰ وَعِظَٰماً اَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
23:35.en: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth

23:36.en: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised

23:37.ar: إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا اَ۬لدُّنْي۪ا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْي۪ا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
23:37.en: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again)

23:38.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ اِ۪فْتَر۪يٰ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ كَذِباࣰ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُومِنِينَۖ
23:38.en: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him

23:39.en: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me

23:40.en: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant

23:41.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ اُ۬لصَّيْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءࣰۖ فَبُعْداࣰ لِّلْقَوْمِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
23:41.en: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk

23:42.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُوناً اٰخَرِينَۖ
23:42.en: Then after them We brought forth other generations

23:43.ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنُ ا۟مَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَٰخِرُونَۖ
23:43.en: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it

23:44.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْر۪اۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ اُ۟مَّةࣰ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُۖ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضاࣰ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُۥٓ أَحَادِيثَۖ فَبُعْداࣰ لِّقَوْمࣲ لَّا يُومِنُونَۖ
23:44.en: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not

23:45.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوس۪يٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
23:45.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant

23:46.ar: اِلَيٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِيْهِۦ فَاسْتَكْبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوْماً عَالِينَۖ
23:46.en: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk

23:47.ar: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُومِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَۖ
23:47.en: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us

23:48.en: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed

23:49.ar: وَلَقَدَ اٰتَيْنَا مُوسَي اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَۖ
23:49.en: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright

23:50.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا اَ۪بْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةࣰۖ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَيٰ رُبْوَةࣲ ذَاتِ قَر۪ارࣲ وَمَعِينࣲۖ
23:50.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings

23:51.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ اَ۬لطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَاعْمَلُواْ صَٰلِحاًۖ اِنِّے بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمࣱۖ
23:51.en: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do

23:52.ar: وَأَنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمُۥٓ أُمَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰۖ وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُونِۖ
23:52.en: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me

23:53.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓاْ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُراࣰۖ كُلُّ حِزْبِۢ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَۖ
23:53.en: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets

23:54.en: So leave them in their error till a time

23:55.ar: اَيَحْسِبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالࣲ وَبَنِينَ
23:55.en: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them

23:56.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِے اِ۬لْخَيْرَٰتِۖ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَۖ
23:56.en: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not

23:57.ar: ۞إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
23:57.en: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord

23:58.en: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord

23:59.en: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord

23:60.ar: وَالذِينَ يُوتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمُۥٓ إِلَيٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
23:60.en: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord

23:61.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِے اِ۬لْخَيْرَٰتِۖ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَۖ
23:61.en: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race

23:62.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْساً اِلَّا وُسْعَهَاۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبࣱ يَنطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَۖ
23:62.en: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged

23:63.ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِے غَمْرَةࣲ مِّنْ هَٰذَاۖ وَلَهُمُۥٓ أَعْمَٰلࣱ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَۖ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَۖ
23:63.en: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing

23:64.ar: حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِالْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَۖ
23:64.en: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate

23:65.ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُواْ اُ۬لْيَوْمَۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَۖ
23:65.en: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us

23:66.ar: قَدْ كَانَتَ اٰيَٰتِے تُتْل۪يٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَيٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
23:66.en: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels

23:67.en: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together

23:68.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُواْ اُ۬لْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَاتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ اُ۬لَاوَّلِينَۖ
23:68.en: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old

23:69.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَۖ
23:69.en: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him

23:70.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةُۢۖ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِالْحَقِّۖ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَۖ
23:70.en: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth

23:71.ar: وَلَوِ اِ۪تَّبَعَ اَ۬لْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَالَارْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّۖ بَلَ اَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْۖ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَۖ
23:71.en: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away

23:72.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجاࣰۖ فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرࣱۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لرَّٰزِقِينَۖ
23:72.en: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision

23:73.en: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path

23:74.ar: وَإِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ لَا يُومِنُونَ بِالَاخِرَةِ عَنِ اِ۬لصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَۖ
23:74.en: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path

23:75.ar: ۞وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرࣲّ لَّلَجُّواْ فِے طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَۖ
23:75.en: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy

23:76.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَخَذْنَٰهُم بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اَ۪سْتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَۖ
23:76.en: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray

23:77.ar: حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَاباࣰ ذَا عَذَابࣲ شَدِيدٍ اِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَۖ
23:77.en: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat

23:78.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ اُ۬لسَّمْعَ وَالَابْصَٰرَ وَالَافْـِٕدَةَۖ قَلِيلاࣰ مَّا تَشْكُرُونَۖ
23:78.en: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

23:79.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے ذَرَأَكُمْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَۖ
23:79.en: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered

23:80.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے يُحْيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَلَهُ اُ۪خْتِلَٰفُ اُ۬ليْلِ وَالنَّه۪ارِۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَۖ
23:80.en: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense

23:81.ar: بَلْ قَالُواْ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ اَ۬لَاوَّلُونَ
23:81.en: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old

23:82.ar: قَالُوٓاْ أَ۟ذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباࣰ وَعِظَٰماً اِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَۖ
23:82.en: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again

23:83.ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُۖ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ اُ۬لَاوَّلِينَۖ
23:83.en: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old

23:84.ar: قُل لِّمَنِ اِ۬لَارْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
23:84.en: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge

23:85.en: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember

23:86.ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ اِ۬لسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ اُ۬لْعَرْشِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِۖ
23:86.en: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne

23:87.en: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)

23:88.ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
23:88.en: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge

23:89.en: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched

23:90.en: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars

23:91.ar: مَا اَ۪تَّخَذَ اَ۬للَّهُ مِنْ وَّلَدࣲۖ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنِ اِلَٰهٍۖ اِذاࣰ لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهِۢ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَيٰ بَعْضࣲۖ سُبْحَٰنَ اَ۬للَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَۖ
23:91.en: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege

23:92.ar: عَٰلِمُ اُ۬لْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَٰدَةِۖ فَتَعَٰل۪يٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَۖ
23:92.en: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)

23:93.en: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised

23:94.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِے فِے اِ۬لْقَوْمِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
23:94.en: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk

23:95.ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَيٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَۖ
23:95.en: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them

23:96.ar: اَ۪دْفَعْ بِالتِے هِيَ أَحْسَنُ اُ۬لسَّيِّئَةَۖ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَۖ
23:96.en: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege

23:97.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ اِ۬لشَّيَٰطِينِ
23:97.en: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones

23:98.en: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me

23:99.ar: حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ احَدَهُمُ اُ۬لْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ اِ۪رْجِعُونِ
23:99.en: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back

23:100.ar: لَعَلِّيَ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحاࣰ فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَاۖ وَمِنْ وَّرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ اِلَيٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَۖ
23:100.en: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised

23:101.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِے اِ۬لصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذࣲ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَۖ
23:101.en: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another

23:102.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْمُفْلِحُونَۖ
23:102.en: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful

23:103.ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِے جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
23:103.en: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding

23:104.ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ اُ۬لنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَۖ
23:104.en: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein

23:105.ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنَ اٰيَٰتِے تُتْل۪يٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَۖ
23:105.en: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them

23:106.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْماࣰ ضَآلِّينَۖ
23:106.en: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk

23:107.ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَۖ
23:107.en: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers

23:108.en: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me

23:109.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقࣱ مِّنْ عِبَادِے يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لرَّٰحِمِينَ
23:109.en: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy

23:110.ar: فَاتَّخَذتُّمُوهُمْ سُخْرِيّاً حَتَّيٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِے وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَۖ
23:110.en: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them

23:111.ar: إِنِّے جَزَيْتُهُمُ اُ۬لْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ اُ۬لْفَآئِزُونَۖ
23:111.en: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant

23:112.ar: قَالَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَۖ
23:112.en: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years

23:113.ar: قَالُواْ لَبِثْنَا يَوْماً اَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمࣲۖ فَسْـَٔلِ اِ۬لْعَآدِّينَۖ
23:113.en: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count

23:114.ar: قَالَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلاࣰ لَّوَ اَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَۖ
23:114.en: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew

23:115.ar: ۞أَفَحَسِبْتُمُۥٓ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثاࣰ وَأَنَّكُمُۥٓ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَۖ
23:115.en: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us

23:116.ar: فَتَعَٰلَي اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْمَلِكُ اُ۬لْحَقُّۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ رَبُّ اُ۬لْعَرْشِ اِ۬لْكَرِيمِۖ
23:116.en: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace

23:117.ar: وَمَنْ يَّدْعُ مَعَ اَ۬للَّهِ إِلَٰهاً اٰخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ اُ۬لْكَٰفِرُونَۖ
23:117.en: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful

23:118.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ اِ۪غْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ اُ۬لرَّٰحِمِينَۖ
23:118.en: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy

24:1.ar: سُورَةٌ اَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتِۢ بَيِّنَٰتࣲ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَّكَّرُونَۖ
24:1.en: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed

24:2.ar: اَ۬لزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِے فَاجْلِدُواْ كُلَّ وَٰحِدࣲ مِّنْهُمَا مِاْئَةَ جَلْدَةࣲۖ وَلَا تَاخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةࣱ فِے دِينِ اِ۬للَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُومِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ اِ۬لَاخِرِۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
24:2.en: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment

24:3.ar: اَ۬لزَّانِے لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً اَوْ مُشْرِكَةࣰۖ وَالزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ اَوْ مُشْرِكࣱۖ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَي اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
24:3.en: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers

24:4.ar: وَالذِينَ يَرْمُونَ اَ۬لْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَاتُواْ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةࣰۖ وَلَا تَقْبَلُواْ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً اَبَداࣰ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْفَٰسِقُونَ
24:4.en: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers

24:5.ar: إِلَّا اَ۬لذِينَ تَابُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُواْ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
24:5.en: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

24:6.ar: وَالذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ اِ۪لَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمُۥٓ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتِۢ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰدِقِينَ
24:6.en: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth

24:7.ar: وَالْخَٰمِسَةُ أَن لَّعْنَتُ اُ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لْكَٰذِبِينَۖ
24:7.en: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie

24:8.ar: وَيَدْرَؤُاْ عَنْهَا اَ۬لْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتِۢ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ اَ۬لْكَٰذِبِينَ
24:8.en: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false

24:9.ar: وَالْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنْ غَضِبَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰدِقِينَۖ
24:9.en: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth

24:10.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اُ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌۖ
24:10.en: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone)

24:11.ar: ۞اِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ جَآءُو بِالِافْكِ عُصْبَةࣱ مِّنكُمْ لَا تَحْسِبُوهُ شَرّاࣰ لَّكُمۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرࣱ لَّكُمْۖ لِكُلِّ اِ۪مْرِےࣲٕ مِّنْهُم مَّا اَ۪كْتَسَبَ مِنَ اَ۬لِاثْمِۖ وَالذِے تَوَلّ۪يٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمࣱۖ
24:11.en: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom

24:12.ar: لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ اَ۬لْمُومِنُونَ وَالْمُومِنَٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْراࣰ وَقَالُواْ هَٰذَآ إِفْكࣱ مُّبِينࣱۖ
24:12.en: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth

24:13.ar: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَۖ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَاتُواْ بِالشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ هُمُ اُ۬لْكَٰذِبُونَۖ
24:13.en: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah

24:14.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اُ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِے اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا وَالَاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِے مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
24:14.en: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured

24:15.ar: اِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمࣱ وَتَحْسِبُونَهُۥ هَيِّناࣰ وَهُوَ عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ عَظِيمࣱۖ
24:15.en: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great

24:16.ar: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَٰذَا سُبْحَٰنَكَ هَٰذَا بُهْتَٰنٌ عَظِيمࣱۖ
24:16.en: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny

24:17.ar: يَعِظُكُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ أَن تَعُودُواْ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَداً اِن كُنتُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
24:17.en: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers

24:18.ar: وَيُبَيِّنُ اُ۬للَّهُ لَكُمُ اُ۬لَايَٰتِۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۖ
24:18.en: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise

24:19.ar: اِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ اَ۬لْفَٰحِشَةُ فِے اِ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمࣱ فِے اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا وَالَاخِرَةِۖ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُۖ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَۖ
24:19.en: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not

24:20.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اُ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ رَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
24:20.en: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone)
