24:21.ar: ۞يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّبِعُواْ خُطْوَٰتِ اِ۬لشَّيْطَٰنِۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَّبِعْ خُطْوَٰتِ اِ۬لشَّيْطَٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَامُرُ بِالْفَحْشَآءِ وَالْمُنكَرِۖ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ اُ۬للَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَيٰ مِنكُم مِّنَ اَحَدٍ اَبَداࣰۖ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُزَكِّے مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمࣱۖ
24:21.en: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower

24:22.ar: وَلَا يَاتَلِ أُوْلُواْ اُ۬لْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَنْ يُّوتُوٓاْ أُوْلِے اِ۬لْقُرْب۪يٰ وَالْمَسَٰكِينَ وَالْمُهَٰجِرِينَ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ وَلْيَعْفُواْ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓاْۖ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَنْ يَّغْفِرَ اَ۬للَّهُ لَكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌۖ
24:22.en: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

24:23.ar: اِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يَرْمُونَ اَ۬لْمُحْصَنَٰتِ اِ۬لْغَٰفِلَٰتِ اِ۬لْمُومِنَٰتِ لُعِنُواْ فِے اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا وَالَاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمࣱ‏
24:23.en: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom

24:24.ar: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَۖ
24:24.en: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do

24:25.ar: يَوْمَئِذࣲ يُوَفِّيهِمُ اُ۬للَّهُ دِينَهُمُ اُ۬لْحَقَّۖ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لْحَقُّ اُ۬لْمُبِينُۖ
24:25.en: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth

24:26.ar: اُ۬لْخَبِيثَٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَالْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَٰتِۖ وَالطَّيِّبَٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَالطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَٰتِۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةࣱ وَرِزْقࣱ كَرِيمࣱۖ
24:26.en: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision

24:27.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَدْخُلُواْ بُيُوتاً غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّيٰ تَسْتَانِسُواْ وَتُسَلِّمُواْ عَلَيٰٓ أَهْلِهَاۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرࣱ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَّكَّرُونَۖ
24:27.en: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful

24:28.ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُواْ فِيهَآ أَحَداࣰ فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّيٰ يُوذَنَ لَكُمْۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ اُ۪رْجِعُواْ فَارْجِعُواْ هُوَ أَزْك۪يٰ لَكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمࣱۖ
24:28.en: And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do

24:29.ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَن تَدْخُلُواْ بُيُوتاً غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةࣲ فِيهَا مَتَٰعࣱ لَّكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَۖ
24:29.en: (It is) no sin for you to enter uninhabited houses wherein is comfort for you. Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide

24:30.ar: ۞قُل لِّلْمُومِنِينَ يَغُضُّواْ مِنَ اَبْصٰ۪رِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُواْ فُرُوجَهُمْ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْك۪يٰ لَهُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَۖ
24:30.en: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do

24:31.ar: وَقُل لِّلْمُومِنَٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنَ اَبْصٰ۪رِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَاۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَيٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوَ اٰبَآئِهِنَّ أَوَ اٰبَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوَ اَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوَ اَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوِ اِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِےٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِےٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتَ اَيْمَٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ اِ۬لتَّٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُوْلِے اِ۬لِارْبَةِ مِنَ اَ۬لرِّجَالِ أَوِ اِ۬لطِّفْلِ اِ۬لذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُواْ عَلَيٰ عَوْرَٰتِ اِ۬لنِّسَآءِۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّۖ وَتُوبُوٓاْ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ جَمِيعاً اَيُّهَ اَ۬لْمُومِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَۖ
24:31.en: And tell the believing women to lower their gaze and be modest, and to display of their adornment only that which is apparent, and to draw their veils over their bosoms, and not to reveal their adornment save to their own husbands or fathers or husbands' fathers, or their sons or their husbands' sons, or their brothers or their brothers' sons or sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male attendants who lack vigour, or children who know naught of women's nakedness. And let them not stamp their feet so as to reveal what they hide of their adornment. And turn unto Allah together, O believers, in order that ye may succeed

24:32.ar: وَأَنكِحُواْ اُ۬لَايَٰم۪يٰ مِنكُمْ وَالصَّٰلِحِينَ مِنْ عِبَادِكُمْ وَإِمَآئِكُمُۥٓۖ إِنْ يَّكُونُواْ فُقَرَآءَ يُغْنِهِمُ اُ۬للَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦۖ وَاللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمࣱۖ
24:32.en: And marry such of you as are solitary and the pious of your slaves and maid-servants. If they be poor, Allah will enrich them of His bounty. Allah is of ample means, Aware

24:33.ar: وَلْيَسْتَعْفِفِ اِ۬لذِينَ لَا يَجِدُونَ نِكَاحاً حَتَّيٰ يُغْنِيَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦۖ وَالذِينَ يَبْتَغُونَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ مِمَّا مَلَكَتَ اَيْمَٰنُكُمْ فَكَاتِبُوهُمُۥٓ إِنْ عَلِمْتُمْ فِيهِمْ خَيْراࣰۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مِّن مَّالِ اِ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لذِےٓ ءَات۪يٰكُمْۖ وَلَا تُكْرِهُواْ فَتَيَٰتِكُمْ عَلَي اَ۬لْبِغَآءِ انَ اَرَدْنَ تَحَصُّناࣰ لِّتَبْتَغُواْ عَرَضَ اَ۬لْحَيَوٰةِ اِ۬لدُّنْي۪اۖ وَمَنْ يُّكْرِههُّنَّ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ إِكْرَٰهِهِنَّ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
24:33.en: And let those who cannot find a match keep chaste till Allah give them independence by His grace. And such of your slaves as seek a writing (of emancipation), write it for them if ye are aware of aught of good in them, and bestow upon them of the wealth of Allah which He hath bestowed upon you. Force not your slave-girls to whoredom that ye may seek enjoyment of the life of the world, if they would preserve their chastity. And if one force them, then (unto them), after their compulsion, lo! Allah will be Forgiving, Merciful

24:34.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتࣲ مُّبَيَّنَٰتࣲ وَمَثَلاࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لذِينَ خَلَوْاْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ وَمَوْعِظَةࣰ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَۖ
24:34.en: And verily We have sent down for you revelations that make plain, and the example of those who passed away before you. An admonition unto those who ward off (evil)

24:35.ar: ۞اَ۬للَّهُ نُورُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشْكَوٰةࣲ فِيهَا مِصْبَاحٌۖ اِ۬لْمِصْبَاحُ فِے زُجَاجَةٍۖ اِ۬لزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوْكَبࣱ دُرِّيࣱّ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةࣲ زَيْتُونَةࣲ لَّا شَرْقِيَّةࣲ وَلَا غَرْبِيَّةࣲ يَكَادُ زَيْتُهَا يُضِےٓءُ وَلَوْ لَمْ تَمْسَسْهُ نَارࣱۖ نُّورٌ عَلَيٰ نُورࣲۖ يَهْدِے اِ۬للَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَيَضْرِبُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لَامْثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِۖ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عَلِيمࣱۖ
24:35.en: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things

24:36.ar: فِے بُيُوتٍ اَذِنَ اَ۬للَّهُ أَن تُرْفَعَ وَيُذْكَرَ فِيهَا اَ۪سْمُهُۥ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ فِيهَا بِالْغُدُوِّ وَالَاصَالِ
24:36.en: (This lamp is found) in houses which Allah hath allowed to be exalted and that His name shall be remembered therein. Therein do offer praise to Him at morn and evening

24:37.ar: رِجَالࣱ لَّا تُلْهِيهِمْ تِجَٰرَةࣱ وَلَا بَيْعٌ عَن ذِكْرِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَإِقَامِ اِ۬لصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءِ اِ۬لزَّكَوٰةِۖ يَخَافُونَ يَوْماࣰ تَتَقَلَّبُ فِيهِ اِ۬لْقُلُوبُ وَالَابْصَٰرُ
24:37.en: Men whom neither merchandise nor sale beguileth from remembrance of Allah and constancy in prayer and paying to the poor their due; who fear a day when hearts and eyeballs will be overturned

24:38.ar: لِيَجْزِيَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦۖ وَاللَّهُ يَرْزُقُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابࣲۖ
24:38.en: That Allah may reward them with the best of what they did, and increase reward for them of His bounty. Allah giveth blessings without stint to whom He will

24:39.ar: وَالذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ كَسَرَابِۢ بِقِيعَةࣲ يَحْسِبُهُ اُ۬لظَّمْـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمْ يَجِدْهُ شَئْاࣰ وَوَجَدَ اَ۬للَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفّ۪يٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥۖ وَاللَّهُ سَرِيعُ اُ۬لْحِسَابِۖ
24:39.en: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one supposeth it to be water till he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth, in the place thereof, Allah Who payeth him his due; and Allah is swift at reckoning

24:40.ar: أَوْ كَظُلُمَٰتࣲ فِے بَحْرࣲ لُّجِّيࣲّ يَغْش۪يٰهُ مَوْجࣱ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ مَوْجࣱ مِّن فَوْقِهِۦ سَحَابࣱۖ ظُلُمَٰتُۢ بَعْضُهَا فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۖ اِذَآ أَخْرَجَ يَدَهُۥ لَمْ يَكَدْ يَر۪يٰهَاۖ وَمَن لَّمْ يَجْعَلِ اِ۬للَّهُ لَهُۥ نُوراࣰ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن نُّورٍۖ
24:40.en: Or as darkness on a vast, abysmal sea. There covereth him a wave, above which is a wave, above which is a cloud. Layer upon layer of darkness. When he holdeth out his hand he scarce can see it. And he for whom Allah hath not appointed light, for him there is no light

24:41.ar: اَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَالطَّيْرُ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲۖ كُلࣱّ قَدْ عَلِمَ صَلَاتَهُۥ وَتَسْبِيحَهُۥۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَۖ
24:41.en: Hast thou not seen that Allah, He it is Whom all who are in the heavens and the earth praise, and the birds in their flight? Of each He knoweth verily the worship and the praise; and Allah is Aware of what they do

24:42.ar: وَلِلهِ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَإِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
24:42.en: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah is the journeying

24:43.ar: ۞أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُزْجِے سَحَاباࣰ ثُمَّ يُوَ۬لِّفُ بَيْنَهُۥ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ رُكَاماࣰ فَتَرَي اَ۬لْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَٰلِهِۖۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ مِن جِبَالࣲ فِيهَا مِنۢ بَرَدࣲ فَيُصِيبُ بِهِۦ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَيَصْرِفُهُۥ عَن مَّنْ يَّشَآءُۖ يَكَادُ سَنَا بَرْقِهِۦ يَذْهَبُ بِالَابْصٰ۪رِۖ
24:43.en: Hast thou not seen how Allah wafteth the clouds, then gathereth them, then maketh them layers, and thou seest the rain come forth from between them; He sendeth down from the heaven mountains wherein is hail, and smiteth therewith whom He will, and averteth it from whom He will. The flashing of His lightning all but snatcheth away the sight

24:44.ar: يُقَلِّبُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬ليْلَ وَالنَّهَارَۖ إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةࣰ لِّأُوْلِے اِ۬لَابْصٰ۪رِۖ
24:44.en: Allah causeth the revolution of the day and the night. Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for those who see

24:45.ar: وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَ كُلَّ دَآبَّةࣲ مِّن مَّآءࣲۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ يَّمْشِے عَلَيٰ بَطْنِهِۦۖ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ يَّمْشِے عَلَيٰ رِجْلَيْنِۖ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ يَّمْشِے عَلَيٰٓ أَرْبَعࣲۖ يَخْلُقُ اُ۬للَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُۖ اِ۪نَّ اَ۬للَّهَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرࣱۖ
24:45.en: Allah hath created every animal of water. Of them is (a kind) that goeth upon its belly and (a kind) that goeth upon two legs and (a kind) that goeth upon four. Allah createth what He will. Lo! Allah is Able to do all things

24:46.ar: لَّقَدَ اَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتࣲ مُّبَيَّنَٰتࣲۖ وَاللَّهُ يَهْدِے مَنْ يَّشَآءُ اِ۪لَيٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسْتَقِيمࣲۖ
24:46.en: Verily We have sent down revelations and explained them. Allah guideth whom He will unto a straight path

24:47.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِاللَّهِ وَبِالرَّسُولِ وَأَطَعْنَا ثُمَّ يَتَوَلّ۪يٰ فَرِيقࣱ مِّنْهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَمَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ بِالْمُومِنِينَۖ
24:47.en: And they say: We believe in Allah and the messenger, and we obey; then after that a faction of them turn away. Such are not believers

24:48.ar: وَإِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمُۥٓ إِذَا فَرِيقࣱ مِّنْهُم مُّعْرِضُونَۖ
24:48.en: And when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them, lo! a faction of them are averse

24:49.ar: وَإِنْ يَّكُن لَّهُمُ اُ۬لْحَقُّ يَاتُوٓاْ إِلَيْهِ مُذْعِنِينَۖ
24:49.en: But if right had been with them they would have come unto him willingly

24:50.ar: أَفِے قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ اَمِ اِ۪رْتَابُوٓاْ أَمْ يَخَافُونَ أَنْ يَّحِيفَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَرَسُولُهُۥۖ بَلُ ا۟وْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لظَّٰلِمُونَۖ
24:50.en: Is there in their hearts a disease, or have they doubts, or fear they lest Allah and His messenger should wrong them in judgment? Nay, but such are evil-doers

24:51.ar: إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَ إِذَا دُعُوٓاْ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمُۥٓ أَنْ يَّقُولُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَاۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْمُفْلِحُونَۖ
24:51.en: The saying of (all true) believers when they appeal unto Allah and His messenger to judge between them is only that they say: We hear and we obey. And such are the successful

24:52.ar: وَمَنْ يُّطِعِ اِ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَيَخْشَ اَ۬للَّهَ وَيَتَّقِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْفَآئِزُونَۖ
24:52.en: He who obeyeth Allah and His messenger, and feareth Allah, and keepeth duty (unto Him): such indeed are the victorious

24:53.ar: ۞وَأَقْسَمُواْ بِاللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِنَ اَمَرْتَهُمْ لَيَخْرُجُنَّۖ قُل لَّا تُقْسِمُواْۖ طَاعَةࣱ مَّعْرُوفَةٌۖ اِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَۖ
24:53.en: They swear by Allah solemnly that, if thou order them, they will go forth. Say: Swear not; known obedience (is better). Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do

24:54.ar: قُلَ اَطِيعُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ اُ۬لرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْاْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْهِ مَا حُمِّلَ وَعَلَيْكُم مَّا حُمِّلْتُمْۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوهُ تَهْتَدُواْۖ وَمَا عَلَي اَ۬لرَّسُولِ إِلَّا اَ۬لْبَلَٰغُ اُ۬لْمُبِينُۖ
24:54.en: Say: Obey Allah and obey the messenger. But if ye turn away, then (it is) for him (to do) only that wherewith he hath been charged, and for you (to do) only that wherewith ye have been charged. If ye obey him, ye will go aright. But the messenger hath no other charge than to convey (the message) plainly

24:55.ar: وَعَدَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَيَسْتَخْلِفَنَّهُمْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ كَمَا اَ۪سْتَخْلَفَ اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَلَيُمَكِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ دِينَهُمُ اُ۬لذِے اِ۪رْتَض۪يٰ لَهُمْ وَلَيُبَدِّلَنَّهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَوْفِهِمُۥٓ أَمْناࣰۖ يَعْبُدُونَنِے لَا يُشْرِكُونَ بِے شَئْاࣰۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْفَٰسِقُونَۖ
24:55.en: Allah hath promised such of you as believe and do good work that He will surely make them to succeed (the present rulers) in the earth even as He caused those who were before them to succeed (others); and that He will surely establish for them their religion which He hath approved for them, and will give them in exchange safety after their fear. They serve Me. They ascribe no thing as partner unto Me. Those who disbelieve henceforth, they are the miscreants

24:56.ar: وَأَقِيمُواْ اُ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ اُ۬لزَّكَوٰةَۖ وَأَطِيعُواْ اُ۬لرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَۖ
24:56.en: Establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey the messenger, that haply ye may find mercy

24:57.ar: لَا تَحْسِبَنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مُعْجِزِينَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ وَمَأْو۪يٰهُمُ اُ۬لنَّارُۖ وَلَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
24:57.en: Think not that the disbelievers can escape in the land. Fire will be their home - a hapless journey's end

24:58.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِيَسْتَٰذِنكُمُ اُ۬لذِينَ مَلَكَتَ اَيْمَٰنُكُمْ وَالذِينَ لَمْ يَبْلُغُواْ اُ۬لْحُلُمَ مِنكُمْ ثَلَٰثَ مَرَّٰتࣲ مِّن قَبْلِ صَلَوٰةِ اِ۬لْفَجْرِ وَحِينَ تَضَعُونَ ثِيَابَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لظَّهِيرَةِ وَمِنۢ بَعْدِ صَلَوٰةِ اِ۬لْعِشَآءِۖ ثَلَٰثُ عَوْرَٰتࣲ لَّكُمْۖ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَا عَلَيْهِمْ جُنَاحُۢ بَعْدَهُنَّۖ طَوَّٰفُونَ عَلَيْكُمۖ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَيٰ بَعْضࣲۖ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اُ۬للَّهُ لَكُمُ اُ۬لَايَٰتِۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱۖ
24:58.en: O ye who believe! Let your slaves, and those of you who have not come to puberty, ask leave of you at three times (before they come into your presence): Before the prayer of dawn, and when ye lay aside your raiment for the heat of noon, and after the prayer of night. Three times of privacy for you. It is no sin for them or for you at other times, when some of you go round attendant upon others (if they come into your presence without leave). Thus Allah maketh clear the revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise

24:59.ar: وَإِذَا بَلَغَ اَ۬لَاطْفَٰلُ مِنكُمُ اُ۬لْحُلُمَ فَلْيَسْتَٰذِنُواْ كَمَا اَ۪سْتَٰذَنَ اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْۖ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اُ۬للَّهُ لَكُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِهِۦۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱۖ
24:59.en: And when the children among you come to puberty then let them ask leave even as those before them used to ask it. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you. Allah is Knower, Wise

24:60.ar: ۞وَالْقَوَٰعِدُ مِنَ اَ۬لنِّسَآءِ اِ۬لتِے لَا يَرْجُونَ نِكَاحاࣰ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جُنَاحٌ اَنْ يَّضَعْنَ ثِيَابَهُنَّ غَيْرَ مُتَبَرِّجَٰتِۢ بِزِينَةࣲۖ وَأَنْ يَّسْتَعْفِفْنَ خَيْرࣱ لَّهُنَّۖ وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمࣱۖ
24:60.en: As for women past child-bearing, who have no hope of marriage, it is no sin for them if they discard their (outer) clothing in such a way as not to show adornment. But to refrain is better for them. Allah is Hearer, Knower

24:61.ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَي اَ۬لَاعْم۪يٰ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَي اَ۬لَاعْرَجِ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَي اَ۬لْمَرِيضِ حَرَجࣱ وَلَا عَلَيٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمُۥٓ أَن تَاكُلُواْ مِنۢ بُيُوتِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ ءَابَآئِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ إِخْوَٰنِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخَوَٰتِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَعْمَٰمِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ عَمَّٰتِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ أَخْوَٰلِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ بُيُوتِ خَٰلَٰتِكُمُۥٓ أَوْ مَا مَلَكْتُم مَّفَاتِحَهُۥٓ أَوْ صَدِيقِكُمْۖ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ اَن تَاكُلُواْ جَمِيعاً اَوَ اَشْتَاتاࣰۖ فَإِذَا دَخَلْتُم بُيُوتاࣰ فَسَلِّمُواْ عَلَيٰٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ تَحِيَّةࣰ مِّنْ عِندِ اِ۬للَّهِ مُبَٰرَكَةࣰ طَيِّبَةࣰۖ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اُ۬للَّهُ لَكُمُ اُ۬لَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَۖ
24:61.en: No blame is there upon the blind nor any blame upon the lame nor any blame upon the sick nor on yourselves if ye eat from your houses, or the houses of your fathers, or the houses of your mothers, or the houses of your brothers, or the houses of your sisters, or the houses of your fathers' brothers, or the houses of your fathers' sisters, or the houses of your mothers' brothers, or the houses of your mothers' sisters, or (from that) whereof ye hold the keys, or (from the house) of a friend. No sin shall it be for you whether ye eat together or apart. But when ye enter houses, salute one another with a greeting from Allah, blessed and sweet. Thus Allah maketh clear His revelations for you, that haply ye may understand

24:62.ar: إِنَّمَا اَ۬لْمُومِنُونَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَإِذَا كَانُواْ مَعَهُۥ عَلَيٰٓ أَمْرࣲ جَامِعࣲ لَّمْ يَذْهَبُواْ حَتَّيٰ يَسْتَٰذِنُوهُۖ إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يَسْتَٰذِنُونَكَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لذِينَ يُومِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ فَإِذَا اَ۪سْتَٰذَنُوكَ لِبَعْضِ شَأْنِهِمْ فَاذَن لِّمَن شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
24:62.en: They only are the true believers who believe in Allah and His messenger and, when they are with him on some common errand, go not away until they have asked leave of him. Lo! those who ask leave of thee, those are they who believe in Allah and His messenger. So, if they ask thy leave for some affair of theirs, give leave to whom thou wilt of them, and ask for them forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

24:63.ar: ۞لَّا تَجْعَلُواْ دُعَآءَ اَ۬لرَّسُولِ بَيْنَكُمْ كَدُعَآءِ بَعْضِكُم بَعْضاࣰۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ يَتَسَلَّلُونَ مِنكُمْ لِوَاذاࣰۖ فَلْيَحْذَرِ اِ۬لذِينَ يُخَالِفُونَ عَنَ اَمْرِهِۦٓ أَن تُصِيبَهُمْ فِتْنَةٌ اَوْ يُصِيبَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۖ
24:63.en: Make not the calling of the messenger among you as your calling one of another. Allah knoweth those of you who steal away, hiding themselves. And let those who conspire to evade orders beware lest grief or painful punishment befall them

24:64.ar: اَلَآ إِنَّ لِلهِ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِۖ وَيَوْمَ يُرْجَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْۖ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عَلِيمࣱۖ
24:64.en: Lo! verily unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth. He knoweth your condition. And (He knoweth) the Day when they are returned unto Him so that He may inform them of what they did. Allah is Knower of all things

25:1.ar: تَبَٰرَكَ اَ۬لذِے نَزَّلَ اَ۬لْفُرْقَانَ عَلَيٰ عَبْدِهِۦ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَٰلَمِينَ نَذِيراًۖ
25:1.en: Blessed is He Who hath revealed unto His slave the Criterion (of right and wrong), that he may be a warner to the peoples

25:2.ar: اِ۬لذِے لَهُۥ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَلَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداࣰ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكࣱ فِے اِ۬لْمُلْكِۖ وَخَلَقَ كُلَّ شَےْءࣲ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ تَقْدِيراࣰۖ
25:2.en: He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, He hath chosen no son nor hath He any partner in the Sovereignty. He hath created everything and hath meted out for it a measure

25:3.ar: وَاتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّا يَخْلُقُونَ شَئْاࣰ وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ ضَرّاࣰ وَلَا نَفْعاࣰ وَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ مَوْتاࣰ وَلَا حَيَوٰةࣰ وَلَا نُشُوراࣰۖ
25:3.en: Yet they choose beside Him other gods who create naught but are themselves created, and possess not hurt nor profit for themselves, and possess not death nor life, nor power to raise the dead

25:4.ar: وَقَالَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ إِفْكٌ اِ۪فْتَر۪يٰهُ وَأَعَانَهُۥ عَلَيْهِ قَوْمٌ اٰخَرُونَۖ فَقَدْ جَآءُو ظُلْماࣰ وَزُوراࣰ‏
25:4.en: Those who disbelieve say: This is naught but a lie that he hath invented, and other folk have helped him with it, so that they have produced a slander and a lie

25:5.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ أَسَٰطِيرُ اُ۬لَاوَّلِينَ اَ۪كْتَتَبَهَا فَهِيَ تُمْل۪يٰ عَلَيْهِ بُكْرَةࣰ وَأَصِيلاࣰۖ
25:5.en: And they say: Fables of the men of old which he hath had written down so that they are dictated to him morn and evening

25:6.ar: قُلَ اَنزَلَهُ اُ۬لذِے يَعْلَمُ اُ۬لسِّرَّ فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفُوراࣰ رَّحِيماࣰۖ
25:6.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He who knoweth the secret of the heavens and the earth hath revealed it. Lo! He ever is Forgiving, Merciful

25:7.ar: وَقَالُواْ مَالِ هَٰذَا اَ۬لرَّسُولِ يَاكُلُ اُ۬لطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشِے فِے اِ۬لَاسْوَاقِ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مَلَكࣱ فَيَكُونَ مَعَهُۥ نَذِيراً
25:7.en: And they say: What aileth this messenger (of Allah) that he eateth food and walketh in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down unto him, to be a warner with him

25:8.ar: اَوْ يُلْق۪يٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ اَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةࣱ يَاكُلُ مِنْهَاۖ وَقَالَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلاࣰ مَّسْحُوراًۖ
25:8.en: Or (why is not) treasure thrown down unto him, or why hath he not a paradise from whence to eat? And the evil-doers say: Ye are but following a man bewitched

25:9.ar: اُ۟نظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ اَ۬لَامْثَٰلَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلاࣰۖ
25:9.en: See how they coin similitudes for thee, so that they are all astray and cannot find a road

25:10.ar: ۞تَبَٰرَكَ اَ۬لذِےٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْراࣰ مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُوراَۢۖ
25:10.en: Blessed is He Who, if He will, will assign thee better than (all) that - Gardens underneath which rivers flow - and will assign thee mansions

25:11.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُواْ بِالسَّاعَةِۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِالسَّاعَةِ سَعِيراً
25:11.en: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame

25:12.ar: اِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانِۢ بَعِيدࣲ سَمِعُواْ لَهَا تَغَيُّظاࣰ وَزَفِيراࣰۖ
25:12.en: When it seeth them from afar, they hear the crackling and the roar thereof

25:13.ar: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُواْ مِنْهَا مَكَاناࣰ ضَيِّقاࣰ مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْاْ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُوراࣰۖ
25:13.en: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof, chained together, they pray for destruction there

25:14.ar: لَّا تَدْعُواْ اُ۬لْيَوْمَ ثُبُوراࣰ وَٰحِداࣰ وَادْعُواْ ثُبُوراࣰ كَثِيراࣰۖ
25:14.en: Pray not that day for one destruction, but pray for many destructions

25:15.ar: قُلَ اَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ اَمْ جَنَّةُ اُ۬لْخُلْدِ اِ۬لتِے وُعِدَ اَ۬لْمُتَّقُونَۖ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَمَصِيراࣰۖ
25:15.en: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end

25:16.ar: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَٰلِدِينَۖ كَانَ عَلَيٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْداࣰ مَّسْـُٔولاࣰۖ
25:16.en: Therein abiding, they have all that they desire. It is for thy Lord a promise that must be fulfilled

25:17.ar: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَآنتُمُۥٓ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِے هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ اَ۬مْ هُمْ ضَلُّواْ اُ۬لسَّبِيلَۖ
25:17.en: And on the day when He will assemble them and that which they worship instead of Allah and will say: Was it ye who misled these my slaves or did they (themselves) wander from the way

25:18.ar: قَالُواْ سُبْحَٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِے لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنَ اَوْلِيَآءَۖ وَلَٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّيٰ نَسُواْ اُ۬لذِّكْرَ وَكَانُواْ قَوْماَۢ بُوراࣰۖ
25:18.en: They will say: Be Thou Glorified! it was not for us to choose any protecting friends beside thee; but Thou didst give them and their fathers ease till they forgot the warning and became lost folk

25:19.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفاࣰ وَلَا نَصْراࣰۖ وَمَنْ يَّظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَاباࣰ كَبِيراࣰۖ
25:19.en: Thus they will give you the lie regarding what ye say, then ye can neither avert (the doom) nor obtain help. And whoso among you doeth wrong, We shall make him taste great torment

25:20.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَاكُلُونَ اَ۬لطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِے اِ۬لَاسْوَاقِۖ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضࣲ فِتْنَةًۖ اَتَصْبِرُونَۖ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيراࣰۖ
25:20.en: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer

25:21.ar: ۞وَقَالَ اَ۬لذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا اَ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَر۪يٰ رَبَّنَاۖ لَقَدِ اِ۪سْتَكْبَرُواْ فِےٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوّاࣰ كَبِيراࣰۖ
25:21.en: And those who look not for a meeting with Us say: Why are angels not sent down unto us and (Why) do we not see our Lord! Assuredly they think too highly of themselves and are scornful with great pride

25:22.ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ اَ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْر۪يٰ يَوْمَئِذࣲ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَۖ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْراࣰۖ مَّحْجُوراࣰۖ
25:22.en: On the day when they behold the angels, on that day there will be no good tidings for the guilty; and they will cry: A forbidding ban

25:23.ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَيٰ مَا عَمِلُواْ مِنْ عَمَلࣲ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هَبَآءࣰ مَّنثُوراًۖ
25:23.en: And We shall turn unto the work they did and make it scattered motes

25:24.ar: اَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرࣱ مُّسْتَقَرّاࣰ وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلاࣰۖ
25:24.en: Those who have earned the Garden on that day will be better in their home and happier in their place of noonday rest

25:25.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَّقَّقُ اُ۬لسَّمَآءُ بِالْغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ اَ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلاًۖ
25:25.en: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent

25:26.ar: اِ۬لْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ اِ۬لْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِۖ وَكَانَ يَوْماً عَلَي اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَ عَسِيراࣰۖ
25:26.en: The Sovereignty on that day will be the True (Sovereignty) belonging to the Beneficent One, and it will be a hard day for disbelievers

25:27.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ اُ۬لظَّالِمُ عَلَيٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِے اِ۪تَّخَذتُّ مَعَ اَ۬لرَّسُولِ سَبِيلاࣰ‏
25:27.en: On the day when the wrong-doer gnaweth his hands, he will say: Ah, would that I had chosen a way together with the messenger (of Allah)

25:28.ar: يَٰوَيْلَت۪يٰ لَيْتَنِے لَمَ اَتَّخِذْ فُلَٰناً خَلِيلاࣰ‏
25:28.en: Alas for me! Ah, would that I had never taken such an one for friend

25:29.ar: لَّقَدَ اَضَلَّنِے عَنِ اِ۬لذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِےۖ وَكَانَ اَ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ لِلِانسَٰنِ خَذُولاࣰۖ
25:29.en: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need

25:30.ar: وَقَالَ اَ۬لرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِيَ اَ۪تَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُوراࣰۖ
25:30.en: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account

25:31.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِےٓءٍ عَدُوّاࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لْمُجْرِمِينَۖ وَكَف۪يٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِياࣰ وَنَصِيراࣰۖ
25:31.en: Even so have We appointed unto every prophet an opponent from among the guilty; but Allah sufficeth for a Guide and Helper

25:32.ar: وَقَالَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ اِ۬لْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰۖ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۖ وَرَتَّلْنَٰهُ تَرْتِيلاࣰۖ
25:32.en: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order

25:33.ar: وَلَا يَاتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ اِلَّا جِئْنَٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيراًۖ
25:33.en: And they bring thee no similitude but We bring thee the Truth (as against it), and better (than their similitude) as argument

25:34.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَيٰ وُجُوهِهِمُۥٓ إِلَيٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ شَرࣱّ مَّكَاناࣰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلاࣰۖ
25:34.en: Those who will be gathered on their faces unto hell: such are worse in plight and further from the right road

25:35.ar: ۞وَلَقَدَ اٰتَيْنَا مُوسَي اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ وَزِيراࣰۖ
25:35.en: We verily gave Moses the Scripture and placed with him his brother Aaron as henchman

25:36.ar: فَقُلْنَا اَ۪ذْهَبَآ إِلَي اَ۬لْقَوْمِ اِ۬لذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۖ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ تَدْمِيراࣰۖ
25:36.en: Then We said: Go together unto the folk who have denied Our revelations. Then We destroyed them, a complete destruction

25:37.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحࣲ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُواْ اُ۬لرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةࣰۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ عَذَاباً اَلِيماࣰۖ
25:37.en: And Noah's folk, when they denied the messengers, We drowned them and made of them a portent for mankind. We have prepared a painful doom for evil-doers

25:38.ar: وَعَاداࣰ وَثَمُوداࣰ وَأَصْحَٰبَ اَ۬لرَّسِّ وَقُرُوناَۢ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيراࣰۖ
25:38.en: And (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, and the dwellers in Ar-Rass, and many generations in between

25:39.ar: وَكُلّاࣰ ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ اُ۬لَامْثَٰلَۖ وَكُلّاࣰ تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيراࣰۖ
25:39.en: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin

25:40.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَتَوْاْ عَلَي اَ۬لْقَرْيَةِ اِ۬لتِےٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ اَ۬لسَّوْءِۖ اَ۬فَلَمْ يَكُونُواْ يَرَوْنَهَاۖ بَلْ كَانُواْ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُوراࣰۖ
25:40.en: And indeed they have passed by the township whereon was rained the fatal rain. Can it be that they have not seen it? Nay, but they hope for no resurrection

25:41.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِنْ يَّتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُؤاًۖ اَهَٰذَا اَ۬لذِے بَعَثَ اَ۬للَّهُ رَسُولاً
25:41.en: And when they see thee (O Muhammad) they treat thee only as a jest (saying): Is this he whom Allah sendeth as a messenger

25:42.ar: اِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنَ اٰلِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَاۖ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ اَ۬لْعَذَابَ مَنَ اَضَلُّ سَبِيلاًۖ
25:42.en: He would have led us far away from our gods if we had not been staunch to them. They will know, when they behold the doom, who is more astray as to the road

25:43.ar: اَرَٰٓيْتَ مَنِ اِ۪تَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَو۪يٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلاًۖ
25:43.en: Hast thou seen him who chooseth for his god his own lust? Wouldst thou then be guardian over him

25:44.ar: اَمْ تَحْسِبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَۖ إِنْ هُمُۥٓ إِلَّا كَالَانْعَٰمِ بَلْ هُمُۥٓ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلاًۖ
25:44.en: Or deemest thou that most of them hear or understand? They are but as the cattle - nay, but they are farther astray

25:45.ar: ۞اَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَيٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ اَ۬لظِّلَّۖ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِناࣰۖ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا اَ۬لشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلاࣰ‏
25:45.en: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord hath spread the shade - And if He willed He could have made it still - then We have made the sun its pilot

25:46.en: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal

25:47.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اُ۬ليْلَ لِبَاساࣰ وَالنَّوْمَ سُبَاتاࣰ وَجَعَلَ اَ۬لنَّهَارَ نُشُوراࣰۖ
25:47.en: And He it is Who maketh night a covering for you, and sleep repose, and maketh day a resurrection

25:48.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَرْسَلَ اَ۬لرِّيَٰحَ نُشُراَۢ بَيْنَ يَدَےْ رَحْمَتِهِۦۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ طَهُوراࣰ‏
25:48.en: And He it is Who sendeth the winds, glad tidings heralding His mercy, and We send down purifying water from the sky

25:49.ar: لِّنُحْـِۧيَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةࣰ مَّيْتاࣰ وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰماࣰ وَأَنَاسِيَّ كَثِيراࣰۖ
25:49.en: That We may give life thereby to a dead land, and We give many beasts and men that We have created to drink thereof

25:50.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُواْ فَأَب۪يٰٓ أَكْثَرُ اُ۬لنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُوراࣰۖ
25:50.en: And verily We have repeated it among them that they may remember, but most of mankind begrudge aught save ingratitude

25:51.ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِے كُلِّ قَرْيَةࣲ نَّذِيراࣰۖ
25:51.en: If We willed, We could raise up a warner in every village

25:52.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ اِ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَاداࣰ كَبِيراࣰۖ
25:52.en: So obey not the disbelievers, but strive against them herewith with a great endeavour

25:53.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے مَرَجَ اَ۬لْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبࣱ فُرَاتࣱ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ ا۟جَاجࣱۖ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخاࣰ وَحِجْراࣰ مَّحْجُوراࣰۖ
25:53.en: And He it is Who hath given independence to the two seas (though they meet); one palatable, sweet, and the other saltish, bitter; and hath set a bar and a forbidding ban between them

25:54.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمَآءِ بَشَراࣰ فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَباࣰ وَصِهْراࣰۖ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيراࣰۖ
25:54.en: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful

25:55.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْۖ وَكَانَ اَ۬لْكَافِرُ عَلَيٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيراࣰۖ
25:55.en: Yet they worship instead of Allah that which can neither benefit them nor hurt them. The disbeliever was ever a partisan against his Lord

25:56.en: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner

25:57.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرٍ اِلَّا مَن شَآءَ انْ يَّتَّخِذَ إِلَيٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلاࣰۖ
25:57.en: Say: I ask of you no reward for this, save that whoso will may choose a way unto his Lord

25:58.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَي اَ۬لْحَيِّ اِ۬لذِے لَا يَمُوتُۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦۖ وَكَف۪يٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيراًۖ
25:58.en: And trust thou in the Living One Who dieth not, and hymn His praise. He sufficeth as the Knower of His bondmen's sins

25:59.ar: اِ۬لذِے خَلَقَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِے سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ اَ۪سْتَو۪يٰ عَلَي اَ۬لْعَرْشِۖ اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيراࣰۖ
25:59.en: Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six Days, then He mounted the Throne. The Beneficent! Ask anyone informed concerning Him

25:60.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اُ۟سْجُدُواْ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُواْ وَمَا اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُۖ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَامُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُوراࣰۖ۩
25:60.en: And when it is said unto them: Prostrate to the Beneficent! they say: And what is the Beneficent? Are we to prostrate to whatever thou (Muhammad) biddest us? And it increaseth aversion in them

25:61.ar: ۞تَبَٰرَكَ اَ۬لذِے جَعَلَ فِے اِ۬لسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجاࣰ وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجاࣰ وَقَمَراࣰ مُّنِيراࣰۖ
25:61.en: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light

25:62.ar: وَهُوَ اَ۬لذِے جَعَلَ اَ۬ليْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةࣰ لِّمَنَ اَرَادَ أَنْ يَّذَّكَّرَ أَوَ اَرَادَ شُكُوراࣰۖ
25:62.en: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness

25:63.ar: وَعِبَادُ اُ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ اِ۬لذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَي اَ۬لَارْضِ هَوْناࣰ وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ اُ۬لْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُواْ سَلَٰماࣰۖ
25:63.en: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace

25:64.en: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing

25:65.ar: وَالذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اَ۪صْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَاماًۖ
25:65.en: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish

25:66.en: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station

25:67.ar: وَالذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُواْ لَمْ يُسْرِفُواْ وَلَمْ يُقْتِرُواْ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَاماࣰۖ
25:67.en: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two

25:68.ar: وَالذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ اَ۬للَّهِ إِلَٰهاً اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ اَ۬لنَّفْسَ اَ۬لتِے حَرَّمَ اَ۬للَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَۖ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَاماࣰ‏
25:68.en: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty

25:69.ar: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ اُ۬لْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِ مُهَاناً
25:69.en: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever

25:70.ar: اِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلاࣰ صَٰلِحاࣰ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ اُ۬للَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتࣲۖ وَكَانَ اَ۬للَّهُ غَفُوراࣰ رَّحِيماࣰۖ
25:70.en: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

25:71.ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحاࣰ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ مَتَاباࣰۖ
25:71.en: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance

25:72.ar: وَالذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ اَ۬لزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِاللَّغْوِ مَرُّواْ كِرَاماࣰۖ
25:72.en: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity

25:73.ar: وَالذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّواْ عَلَيْهَا صُمّاࣰ وَعُمْيَاناࣰۖ
25:73.en: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat

25:74.ar: وَالذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنَ اَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنࣲ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماًۖ
25:74.en: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil)

25:75.ar: ا۟وْلَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ اَ۬لْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةࣰ وَسَلَٰماً
25:75.en: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace

25:76.en: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station

25:77.ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُاْ بِكُمْ رَبِّے لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَاماࣰۖ
25:77.en: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment

26:2.en: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain

26:3.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعࣱ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُومِنِينَۖ
26:3.en: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not

26:4.ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ اَ۟يَةࣰ فَظَلَّتَ اَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَۖ
26:4.en: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it

26:5.ar: وَمَا يَاتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرࣲ مِّنَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ اِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَۖ
26:5.en: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it

26:6.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُواْ فَسَيَاتِيهِمُۥٓ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُاْ مَا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَۖ
26:6.en: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff

26:7.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوِاْ اِلَي اَ۬لَارْضِ كَمَ اَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجࣲ كَرِيمٍۖ
26:7.en: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein

26:8.ar: اِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:8.en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers

26:9.en: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:10.ar: وَإِذْ نَاد۪يٰ رَبُّكَ مُوس۪يٰٓ أَنِ اِ۪يتِ اِ۬لْقَوْمَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَ
26:10.en: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk

26:11.en: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)

26:12.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّيَ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُّكَذِّبُونِ
26:12.en: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me

26:13.ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِے وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِے فَأَرْسِلِ اِلَيٰ هَٰرُونَ
26:13.en: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me)

26:14.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَيَّ ذَنۢبࣱ فَأَخَافُ أَنْ يَّقْتُلُونِۖ
26:14.en: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me

26:15.ar: قَالَ كَلَّاۖ فَاذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَۖ
26:15.en: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing

26:16.ar: فَاتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَ
26:16.en: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds

26:17.en: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us

26:18.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيداࣰ وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
26:18.en: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us

26:19.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ اَ۬لتِے فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
26:19.en: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates

26:20.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذاࣰ وَأَنَا مِنَ اَ۬لضَّآلِّينَۖ
26:20.en: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray

26:21.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِے رَبِّے حُكْماࣰ وَجَعَلَنِے مِنَ اَ۬لْمُرْسَلِينَۖ
26:21.en: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him)

26:22.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةࣱ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِےٓ إِسْرَآءِيلَۖ
26:22.en: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel

26:23.en: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds

26:24.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَۖ
26:24.en: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief

26:25.en: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not

26:26.en: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers

26:27.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ اُ۬لذِےٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونࣱۖ
26:27.en: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman

26:28.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ اُ۬لْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَۖ
26:28.en: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand

26:29.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ اِ۪تَّخَذتَّ إِلَٰهاً غَيْرِے لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمَسْجُونِينَۖ
26:29.en: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners

26:30.en: He said: Even though I show thee something plain

26:31.ar: قَالَ فَاتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰدِقِينَۖ
26:31.en: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful

26:32.ar: فَأَلْق۪يٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ ثُعْبَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
26:32.en: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest

26:33.ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِيَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَۖ
26:33.en: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders

26:34.ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمࣱ‏
26:34.en: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard

26:35.ar: يُرِيدُ أَنْ يُّخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ اَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَامُرُونَۖ
26:35.en: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye

26:36.ar: قَالُوٓاْ أَرْجِهِۦ وَأَخَاهُ وَابْعَثْ فِے اِ۬لْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
26:36.en: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners

26:37.en: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard

26:38.en: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed

26:39.en: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering

26:40.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ اُ۬لسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ اُ۬لْغَٰلِبِينَۖ
26:40.en: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners

26:41.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ اَ۬لسَّحَرَةُ قَالُواْ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْراً اِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ اُ۬لْغَٰلِبِينَۖ
26:41.en: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners

26:42.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمُۥٓ إِذاࣰ لَّمِنَ اَ۬لْمُقَرَّبِينَۖ
26:42.en: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me)

26:43.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوس۪يٰٓ أَلْقُواْ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَۖ
26:43.en: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw

26:44.ar: فَأَلْقَوْاْ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُواْ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ اُ۬لْغَٰلِبُونَۖ
26:44.en: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners

26:45.ar: فَأَلْق۪يٰ مُوس۪يٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَلَقَّفُ مَا يَافِكُونَۖ
26:45.en: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show

26:46.en: And the wizards were flung prostrate

26:47.en: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds

26:48.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron

26:49.ar: قَالَ ءَاٰ۬مَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنَ اٰذَنَ لَكُمُۥٓ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ اُ۬لذِے عَلَّمَكُمُ اُ۬لسِّحْرَۖ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَۖ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفࣲ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَۖ
26:49.en: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one

26:50.ar: ۞قَالُواْ لَا ضَيْرَۖ إِنَّآ إِلَيٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَۖ
26:50.en: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return

26:51.ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيٰ۪نَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
26:51.en: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers

26:52.ar: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيٰ مُوس۪يٰٓ أَنِ اِ۪سْرِ بِعِبَادِيَ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَۖ
26:52.en: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued

26:53.en: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners

26:54.en: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop

26:55.en: And lo! they are offenders against us

26:56.en: And lo! we are a ready host

26:57.en: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings

26:58.en: And treasures and a fair estate

26:59.en: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them

26:60.en: And they overtook them at sunrise

26:61.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا اَ۬لْجَمْعَٰنِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوس۪يٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَۖ
26:61.en: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught

26:62.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِے رَبِّے سَيَهْدِينِۖ
26:62.en: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me

26:63.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيٰ مُوس۪يٰٓ أَنِ اِ۪ضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ اَ۬لْبَحْرَ فَانفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقࣲ كَالطَّوْدِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِۖ
26:63.en: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast

26:64.en: Then brought We near the others to that place

26:65.en: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one

26:67.ar: إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:67.en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers

26:68.en: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:69.en: Recite unto them the story of Abraham

26:70.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَۖ
26:70.en: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye

26:71.ar: قَالُواْ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَاماࣰ فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَۖ
26:71.en: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them

26:72.en: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry

26:73.en: Or do they benefit or harm you

26:74.ar: قَالُواْ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَۖ
26:74.en: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise

26:75.en: He said: See now that which ye worship

26:77.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوࣱّ لِّيَۖ إِلَّا رَبَّ اَ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَ
26:77.en: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds

26:78.en: Who created me, and He doth guide me

26:79.en: And Who feedeth me and watereth me

26:80.en: And when I sicken, then He healeth me

26:81.en: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again)

26:82.ar: ۞وَالذِےٓ أَطْمَعُ أَنْ يَّغْفِرَ لِے خَطِيَٓٔتِے يَوْمَ اَ۬لدِّينِۖ
26:82.en: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment

26:83.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِے حُكْماࣰ وَأَلْحِقْنِے بِالصَّٰلِحِينَۖ
26:83.en: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous

26:84.ar: وَاجْعَل لِّے لِسَانَ صِدْقࣲ فِے اِ۬لَاخِرِينَۖ
26:84.en: And give unto me a good report in later generations

26:85.en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight

26:86.ar: وَاغْفِرْ لِأَبِيَ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لضَّآلِّينَۖ
26:86.en: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err

26:87.en: And abase me not on the day when they are raised

26:88.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالࣱ وَلَا بَنُونَ
26:88.en: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)

26:89.ar: إِلَّا مَنَ اَتَي اَ۬للَّهَ بِقَلْبࣲ سَلِيمࣲۖ
26:89.en: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart

26:90.en: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil)

26:91.en: And hell will appear plainly to the erring

26:92.ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
26:92.en: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship

26:93.ar: مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمُۥٓ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَۖ
26:93.en: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves

26:94.en: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers

26:95.en: And the hosts of Iblis, together

26:96.en: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein

26:97.ar: تَاللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِے ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
26:97.en: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest

26:98.en: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds

26:99.en: It was but the guilty who misled us

26:102.ar: فَلَوَ اَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةࣰ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
26:102.en: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers

26:103.ar: إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:103.en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers

26:104.en: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:105.en: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah)

26:106.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:106.en: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)

26:107.en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

26:108.en: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me

26:109.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرٍۖ اِنَ اَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَيٰ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
26:109.en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

26:110.en: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me

26:111.en: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee

26:112.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِے بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَۖ
26:112.en: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)

26:113.ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمُۥٓ إِلَّا عَلَيٰ رَبِّے لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَۖ
26:113.en: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew

26:114.en: And I am not (here) to repulse believers

26:115.en: I am only a plain warner

26:116.ar: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ اَ۬لْمَرْجُومِينَۖ
26:116.en: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death)

26:117.en: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me

26:118.ar: فَافْتَحْ بَيْنِے وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحاࣰ وَنَجِّنِے وَمَن مَّعِيَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
26:118.en: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me

26:119.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِے اِ۬لْفُلْكِ اِ۬لْمَشْحُونِۖ
26:119.en: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship

26:120.en: Then afterward We drowned the others

26:121.ar: إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:121.en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers

26:122.en: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:123.en: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah)

26:124.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:124.en: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)

26:125.en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

26:126.en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26:127.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرٍۖ اِنَ اَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَيٰ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
26:127.en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

26:128.en: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight

26:129.en: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever

26:130.en: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants

26:131.en: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me

26:132.en: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know

26:133.en: Hath aided you with cattle and sons

26:135.ar: اِنِّيَ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمࣲۖ
26:135.en: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day

26:136.ar: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ اَ۬لْوَٰعِظِينَ
26:136.en: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach

26:137.en: This is but a fable of the men of old

26:138.en: And we shall not be doomed

26:139.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:139.en: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers

26:140.en: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:141.en: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)

26:142.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:142.en: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)

26:143.en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

26:144.en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26:145.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرٍۖ اِنَ اَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَيٰ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
26:145.en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

26:146.en: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us

26:148.en: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees

26:149.en: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful

26:150.en: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26:151.en: And obey not the command of the prodigal

26:152.ar: اَ۬لذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَۖ
26:152.en: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not

26:153.en: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched

26:154.ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثْلُنَا فَاتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ اِن كُنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰدِقِينَۖ
26:154.en: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful

26:155.ar: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةࣱ لَّهَا شِرْبࣱۖ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمࣲ مَّعْلُومࣲۖ
26:155.en: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day

26:156.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءࣲ فَيَاخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمࣲۖ
26:156.en: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day

26:157.en: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent

26:158.ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ اُ۬لْعَذَابُۖ إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:158.en: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers

26:159.en: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:160.en: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah)

26:161.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:161.en: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)

26:162.en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

26:163.en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26:164.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرٍۖ اِنَ اَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَيٰ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
26:164.en: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

26:165.en: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males

26:166.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنَ اَزْوَٰجِكُمۖ بَلَ اَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَۖ
26:166.en: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk

26:167.ar: قَالُواْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُخْرَجِينَۖ
26:167.en: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast

26:168.en: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct

26:169.en: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do

26:170.en: So We saved him and his household, every one

26:171.en: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind

26:172.en: Then afterward We destroyed the others

26:173.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَراࣰۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ اُ۬لْمُنذَرِينَۖ
26:173.en: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned

26:174.ar: إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:174.en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers

26:175.en: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:176.en: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah)

26:177.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ اَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26:177.en: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)

26:178.en: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you

26:179.en: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me

26:180.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرٍۖ اِنَ اَجْرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَيٰ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
26:180.en: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds

26:181.en: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due)

26:182.en: And weigh with the true balance

26:183.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُواْ اُ۬لنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْۖ وَلَا تَعْثَوْاْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ مُفْسِدِينَۖ
26:183.en: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth

26:184.en: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old

26:185.en: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched

26:186.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ اَ۬لْكَٰذِبِينَ
26:186.en: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars

26:187.ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسْفاࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ ان كُنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰدِقِينَۖ
26:187.en: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful

26:188.en: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do

26:189.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ اِ۬لظُّلَّةِۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۖ
26:189.en: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day

26:190.ar: اِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
26:190.en: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers

26:191.en: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful

26:192.en: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds

26:193.en: Which the True Spirit hath brought down

26:194.en: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners

26:196.en: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old

26:197.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمُۥٓ ءَايَةً اَنْ يَّعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُاْ بَنِےٓ إِسْرَآءِيلَۖ
26:197.en: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it

26:198.en: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs

26:199.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ مُومِنِينَۖ
26:199.en: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it

26:200.en: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty

26:201.ar: لَا يُومِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّيٰ يَرَوُاْ اُ۬لْعَذَابَ اَ۬لَالِيمَ
26:201.en: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom

26:202.en: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not

26:203.en: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved

26:204.en: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom

26:205.en: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years

26:206.en: And then cometh that which they were promised

26:207.ar: مَآ أَغْن۪يٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَۖ
26:207.en: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them

26:208.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
26:208.en: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners

26:209.en: For reminder, for We never were oppressors

26:210.en: The devils did not bring it down

26:211.en: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power

26:212.en: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing

26:213.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اَ۬للَّهِ إِلَٰهاً اٰخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُعَذَّبِينَۖ
26:213.en: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed

26:214.en: And warn thy tribe of near kindred

26:215.ar: وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ اِ۪تَّبَعَكَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
26:215.en: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee

26:216.ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلِ اِنِّے بَرِےٓءࣱ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَۖ
26:216.en: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do

26:217.en: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful

26:218.en: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)

26:219.en: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship)

26:220.en: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower

26:221.ar: هَلُ ا۟نَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَيٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ اُ۬لشَّيَٰطِينُ
26:221.en: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend

26:222.en: They descend on every sinful, false one

26:223.en: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars

26:224.en: As for poets, the erring follow them

26:225.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِے كُلِّ وَادࣲ يَهِيمُونَ
26:225.en: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley

26:226.en: And how they say that which they do not

26:227.ar: إِلَّا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ كَثِيراࣰ وَانتَصَرُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْۖ وَسَيَعْلَمُ اُ۬لذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبࣲ يَنقَلِبُونَۖ
26:227.en: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned

27:1.ar: طَسِٓۖ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ اُ۬لْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابࣲ مُّبِينٍۖ
27:1.en: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain

27:2.en: A guidance and good tidings for believers

27:3.ar: اَ۬لذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ اَ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُوتُونَ اَ۬لزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِالَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَۖ
27:3.en: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter

27:4.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ لَا يُومِنُونَ بِالَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمُۥٓ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَۖ
27:4.en: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray

27:5.ar: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ اُ۬لْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِے اِ۬لَاخِرَةِ هُمُ اُ۬لَاخْسَرُونَۖ
27:5.en: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers

27:6.ar: ۞وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّي اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍۖ
27:6.en: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware

27:7.ar: اِذْ قَالَ مُوس۪يٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّيَ ءَانَسْتُ نَاراࣰ سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوَ اٰتِيكُم بِشِهَابِ قَبَسࣲ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَۖ
27:7.en: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves

27:8.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِے اِ۬لنّ۪ارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَاۖ وَسُبْحَٰنَ اَ۬للَّهِ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
27:8.en: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

27:9.ar: يَٰمُوس۪يٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُ
27:9.en: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

27:10.ar: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَۖ فَلَمَّا ر۪ء۪اهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنࣱّ وَلّ۪يٰ مُدْبِراࣰ وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْۖ يَٰمُوس۪يٰ لَا تَخَفِۖ اِنِّے لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ اَ۬لْمُرْسَلُونَۖ
27:10.en: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence

27:11.ar: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْناَۢ بَعْدَ سُوٓءࣲ فَإِنِّے غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
27:11.en: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful

27:12.ar: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِے جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءࣲۖ فِے تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ اِلَيٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماࣰ فَٰسِقِينَۖ
27:12.en: And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe, it will come forth white but unhurt. (This will be one) among nine tokens unto Pharaoh and his people Lo! they were ever evil-living folk

27:13.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةࣰ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحْرࣱ مُّبِينࣱۖ
27:13.en: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic

27:14.ar: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْماࣰ وَعُلُوّاࣰۖ فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ اُ۬لْمُفْسِدِينَۖ
27:14.en: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers

27:15.ar: وَلَقَدَ اٰتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْماࣰ وَقَالَا اَ۬لْحَمْدُ لِلهِ اِ۬لذِے فَضَّلَنَا عَلَيٰ كَثِيرࣲ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ اِ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
27:15.en: And We verily gave knowledge unto David and Solomon, and they said: Praise be to Allah, Who hath preferred us above many of His believing slaves

27:16.ar: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ اَ۬لطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَےْءٍۖ اِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ اَ۬لْفَضْلُ اُ۬لْمُبِينُۖ
27:16.en: And Solomon was David's heir. And he said: O mankind! Lo! we have been taught the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things. This surely is evident favour

27:17.ar: ۞وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ اَ۬لْجِنِّ وَالِانسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَۖ
27:17.en: And there were gathered together unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order

27:18.ar: حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْاْ عَلَيٰ وَادِ اِ۬لنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةࣱ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لنَّمْلُ اُ۟دْخُلُواْ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَۖ
27:18.en: Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you, unperceiving

27:19.ar: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكاࣰ مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيَ أَنَ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ اَ۬لتِےٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَيٰ وَٰلِدَيَّ وَأَنَ اَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحاࣰ تَرْض۪يٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِے بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِے عِبَادِكَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحِينَۖ
27:19.en: And (Solomon) smiled, laughing at her speech, and said: My Lord, arouse me to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good that shall be pleasing unto Thee, and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves

27:20.ar: وَتَفَقَّدَ اَ۬لطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِے لَآ أَرَي اَ۬لْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لْغَآئِبِينَۖ
27:20.en: And he sought among the birds and said: How is it that I see not the hoopoe, or is he among the absent

27:21.ar: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَاباࣰ شَدِيداً اَوْ لَأَاْذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَاتِيَنِّے بِسُلْطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲۖ
27:21.en: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse

27:22.ar: فَمَكُثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدࣲۖ فَقَالَ أَحَطْتُّ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإِۢ بِنَبَإࣲ يَقِينٍۖ
27:22.en: But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not, and I come unto thee from Sheba with sure tidings

27:23.ar: اِنِّے وَجَدتُّ اُ۪مْرَأَةࣰ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَےْءࣲۖ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمࣱۖ
27:23.en: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne

27:24.ar: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ اُ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ اِ۬لسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
27:24.en: I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works fairseeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth), so that they go not aright

27:25.ar: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُواْ لِلهِ اِ۬لذِے يُخْرِجُ اُ۬لْخَبْءَ فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا يُخْفُونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَۖ
27:25.en: So that they worship not Allah, Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knoweth what ye hide and what ye proclaim

27:26.ar: اَ۬للَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ اُ۬لْعَرْشِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِ۩ۖ
27:26.en: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne

27:27.ar: ۞قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لْكَٰذِبِينَۖ
27:27.en: (Solomon) said: We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars

27:28.ar: اَ۪ذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِے هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهِۦٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَۖ
27:28.en: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away and see what (answer) they return

27:29.ar: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لْمَلَؤُاْ اِ۪نِّيَ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَٰبࣱ كَرِيمٌ
27:29.en: (The Queen of Sheba) said (when she received the letter): O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter

27:30.ar: اِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ اِ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ اِ۬لرَّحِيمِ
27:30.en: Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

27:31.en: Exalt not yourselves against me, but come unto me as those who surrender

27:32.ar: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لْمَلَؤُاْ اَ۬فْتُونِے فِےٓ أَمْرِے مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمْراً حَتَّيٰ تَشْهَدُونِۖ
27:32.en: She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case. I decide no case till ye are present with me

27:33.ar: قَالُواْ نَحْنُ أُوْلُواْ قُوَّةࣲ وَأُوْلُواْ بَأْسࣲ شَدِيدࣲ وَالَامْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَانظُرِے مَاذَا تَامُرِينَۖ
27:33.en: They said: We are lords of might and lords of great prowess, but it is for thee to command; so consider what thou wilt command

27:34.ar: قَالَتِ اِنَّ اَ۬لْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرْيَةً اَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةࣰۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَۖ
27:34.en: She said: Lo! kings, when they enter a township, ruin it and make the honour of its people shame. Thus will they do

27:35.ar: وَإِنِّے مُرْسِلَةٌ اِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةࣲ فَنَٰظِرَةُۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ اُ۬لْمُرْسَلُونَۖ
27:35.en: But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return

27:36.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِۦ بِمَالࣲ فَمَآ ءَات۪يٰنِۦَ اَ۬للَّهُ خَيْرࣱ مِّمَّآ ءَات۪يٰكُم بَلَ اَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَۖ
27:36.en: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon, (the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth? But that which Allah hath given me is better than that which He hath given you. Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift

27:37.ar: اَ۪رْجِعِ اِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَاتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودࣲ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةࣰ وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَۖ
27:37.en: Return unto them. We verily shall come unto them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from thence with shame, and they will be abased

27:38.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لْمَلَؤُاْ اَ۬يُّكُمْ يَاتِينِے بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَّاتُونِے مُسْلِمِينَۖ
27:38.en: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering

27:39.ar: قَالَ عِفْرِيتࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لْجِنِّ أَنَآ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ وَإِنِّے عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ اَمِينࣱۖ
27:39.en: A stalwart of the jinn said: I will bring it thee before thou canst rise from thy place. Lo! I verily am strong and trusty for such work

27:40.ar: قَالَ اَ۬لذِے عِندَهُۥ عِلْمࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبِ أَنَآ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَّرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَۖ فَلَمَّا ر۪ء۪اهُ مُسْتَقِرّاً عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّے لِيَبْلُوَنِيَ ءَآشْكُرُ أَمَ اَكْفُرُۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّے غَنِيࣱّ كَرِيمࣱۖ
27:40.en: One with whom was knowledge of the Scripture said: I will bring it thee before thy gaze returneth unto thee. And when he saw it set in his presence, (Solomon) said: This is of the bounty of my Lord, that He may try me whether I give thanks or am ungrateful. Whosoever giveth thanks he only giveth thanks for (the good of) his own soul; and whosoever is ungrateful (is ungrateful only to his own soul's hurt). For lo! my Lord is Absolute in independence, Bountiful

27:41.ar: ۞قَالَ نَكِّرُواْ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرَ اَتَهْتَدِےٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ اَ۬لذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَۖ
27:41.en: He said: Disguise her throne for her that we may see whether she will go aright or be of those not rightly guided

27:42.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَۖ وَأُوتِينَا اَ۬لْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَۖ
27:42.en: So, when she came, it was said (unto her): Is thy throne like this? She said: (It is) as though it were the very one. And (Solomon said): We were given the knowledge before her and we had surrendered (to Allah)

27:43.ar: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمࣲ كٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
27:43.en: And (all) that she was wont to worship instead of Allah hindered her, for she came of disbelieving folk

27:44.ar: قِيلَ لَهَا اَ۟دْخُلِے اِ۬لصَّرْحَۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةࣰ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَاۖ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحࣱ مُّمَرَّدࣱ مِّن قَوَارِيرَۖ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّے ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِے وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلهِ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
27:44.en: It was said unto her: Enter the hall. And when she saw it she deemed it a pool and bared her legs. (Solomon) said: Lo! it is a hall, made smooth, of glass. She said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged myself, and I surrender with Solomon unto Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

27:45.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحاً اَنُ اُ۟عْبُدُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَٰنِ يَخْتَصِمُونَۖ
27:45.en: And We verily sent unto Thamud their brother Salih, saying: Worship Allah. And lo! they (then became two parties quarrelling)

27:46.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ اَ۬لْحَسَنَةِ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اَ۬للَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَۖ
27:46.en: He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy

27:47.ar: قَالُواْ اُ۪طَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَۖ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِۖ بَلَ اَنتُمْ قَوْمࣱ تُفْتَنُونَۖ
27:47.en: They said: We augur evil of thee and those with thee. He said: Your evil augury is with Allah. Nay, but ye are folk that are being tested

27:48.ar: وَكَانَ فِے اِ۬لْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطࣲ يُفْسِدُونَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَۖ
27:48.en: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not

27:49.ar: قَالُواْ تَقَاسَمُواْ بِاللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مُهْلَكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَۖ
27:49.en: They said: Swear one to another by Allah that we verily will attack him and his household by night, and afterward we will surely say unto his friend: We witnessed not the destruction of his household. And lo! we are truthtellers

27:50.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْراࣰ وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْراࣰ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَۖ
27:50.en: So they plotted a plot: and We plotted a plot, while they perceived not

27:51.ar: فَانظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمُۥٓۖ إِنَّا دَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَۖ
27:51.en: Then see the nature of the consequence of their plotting, for lo! We destroyed them and their people, every one

27:52.ar: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةَۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓاْۖ إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةࣰ لِّقَوْمࣲ يَعْلَمُونَۖ
27:52.en: See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a people who have knowledge

27:53.en: And we saved those who believed and used to ward off (evil)

27:54.ar: وَلُوطاً اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَاتُونَ اَ۬لْفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَۖ
27:54.en: And Lot! when he said unto his folk: Will ye commit abomination knowingly

27:55.ar: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَاتُونَ اَ۬لرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةࣰ مِّن دُونِ اِ۬لنِّسَآءِۖ بَلَ اَنتُمْ قَوْمࣱ تَجْهَلُونَۖ
