36:6.en: That thou mayst warn a folk whose fathers were not warned, so they are heedless

36:7.ar: ۞لَقَدْ حَقَّ اَ۬لْقَوْلُ عَلَيٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُومِنُونَۖ
36:7.en: Already hath the judgment, (for their infidelity) proved true of most of them, for they believe not

36:8.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِےٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمُۥٓ أَغْلَٰلاࣰ فَهِيَ إِلَي اَ۬لَاذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَۖ
36:8.en: Lo! We have put on their necks carcans reaching unto the chins, so that they are made stiff-necked

36:9.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سُدّاࣰ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سُدّاࣰ فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَۖ
36:9.en: And We have set a bar before them and a bar behind them, and (thus) have covered them so that they see not

36:10.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ ءَآنذَرْتَهُمُۥٓ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُومِنُونَۖ
36:10.en: Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not, it is alike for them, for they believe not

36:11.ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ اِ۪تَّبَعَ اَ۬لذِّكْرَ وَخَشِيَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةࣲ وَأَجْرࣲ كَرِيمٍۖ
36:11.en: Thou warnest only him who followeth the Reminder and feareth the Beneficent in secret. To him bear tidings of forgiveness and a rich reward

36:12.ar: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِ اِ۬لْمَوْت۪يٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْۖ وَكُلَّ شَےْءٍ اَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِےٓ إِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲۖ
36:12.en: Lo! We it is Who bring the dead to life. We record that which they send before (them, and their footprints. And all things We have kept in a clear Register)

36:13.ar: وَاضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلاً اَصْحَٰبَ اَ۬لْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا اَ۬لْمُرْسَلُونَ
36:13.en: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them

36:14.ar: إِذَ اَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ اُ۪ثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثࣲ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَۖ
36:14.en: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you

36:15.ar: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمُۥٓ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَےْءٍ اِنَ اَنتُمُۥٓ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَۖ
36:15.en: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie

36:16.ar: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
36:16.en: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you

36:17.en: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message)

36:18.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيمࣱۖ
36:18.en: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands

36:19.ar: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمُۥٓ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُمۖ بَلَ اَنتُمْ قَوْمࣱ مُّسْرِفُونَۖ
36:19.en: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk

36:20.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنَ اَقْصَا اَ۬لْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلࣱ يَسْع۪يٰۖ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ اِ۪تَّبِعُواْ اُ۬لْمُرْسَلِينَ
36:20.en: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent

36:21.ar: اَ۪تَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمُۥٓ أَجْراࣰ وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَۖ
36:21.en: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided

36:22.ar: وَمَا لِيَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ اُ۬لذِے فَطَرَنِے وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَۖ
36:22.en: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back

36:23.ar: ءَآتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً اِنْ يُّرِدْنِ اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرࣲّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّے شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَئْاࣰ وَلَا يُنقِذُونِۦٓۖ
36:23.en: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save

36:24.en: Then truly I should be in error manifest

36:25.en: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me

36:26.ar: قِيلَ اَ۟دْخُلِ اِ۬لْجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِے يَعْلَمُونَ
36:26.en: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew

36:27.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِے رَبِّے وَجَعَلَنِے مِنَ اَ۬لْمُكْرَمِينَۖ
36:27.en: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones

36:28.ar: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندࣲ مِّنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَۖ
36:28.en: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send

36:29.ar: إِن كَانَتِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَۖ
36:29.en: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct

36:30.ar: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَي اَ۬لْعِبَادِۖ مَا يَاتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ اِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَۖ
36:30.en: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him

36:31.ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْاْ كَمَ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ اَ۬لْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَۖ
36:31.en: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them

36:32.ar: وَإِن كُلࣱّ لَّمَا جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَۖ
36:32.en: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us

36:33.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ اُ۬لَارْضُ اُ۬لْمَيِّتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبّاࣰ فَمِنْهُ يَاكُلُونَۖ
36:33.en: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof

36:34.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعْنَٰبࣲ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ اَ۬لْعُيُونِ
36:34.en: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein

36:35.ar: لِيَاكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمُۥٓۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَۖ
36:35.en: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks

36:36.ar: سُبْحَٰنَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَ اَ۬لَازْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ اُ۬لَارْضُ وَمِنَ اَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَۖ
36:36.en: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not

36:37.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ اُ۬ليْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ اُ۬لنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَۖ
36:37.en: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness

36:38.ar: وَالشَّمْسُ تَجْرِے لِمُسْتَقَرࣲّ لَّهَاۖ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ اُ۬لْعَزِيزِ اِ۬لْعَلِيمِۖ
36:38.en: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise

36:39.ar: وَالْقَمَرُ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّيٰ عَادَ كَالْعُرْجُونِ اِ۬لْقَدِيمِۖ
36:39.en: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf

36:40.ar: لَا اَ۬لشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِے لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ اَ۬لْقَمَرَ وَلَا اَ۬ليْلُ سَابِقُ اُ۬لنَّه۪ارِۖ وَكُلࣱّ فِے فَلَكࣲ يَسْبَحُونَۖ
36:40.en: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit

36:41.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُۥٓ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ فِے اِ۬لْفُلْكِ اِ۬لْمَشْحُونِ
36:41.en: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship

36:42.ar: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَۖ
36:42.en: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride

36:43.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
36:43.en: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved

36:44.ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعاً اِلَيٰ حِينࣲۖ
36:44.en: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while

36:45.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اُ۪تَّقُواْ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَۖ
36:45.en: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless)

36:46.ar: ۞وَمَا تَاتِيهِم مِّنَ اٰيَةࣲ مِّنَ اٰيَٰتِ رَبِّهِمُۥٓ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَۖ
36:46.en: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it

36:47.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ قَالَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ اُ۬للَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنَ اَنتُمُۥٓ إِلَّا فِے ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲۖ
36:47.en: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest

36:48.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَت۪يٰ هَٰذَا اَ۬لْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَۖ
36:48.en: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful

36:49.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ تَاخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخَصِّمُونَۖ
36:49.en: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing

36:50.ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةࣰ وَلَآ إِلَيٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَۖ
36:50.en: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk

36:51.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِے اِ۬لصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ اَ۬لَاجْدَاثِ إِلَيٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَۖ
36:51.en: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord

36:52.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَاۖ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ اَ۬لْمُرْسَلُونَۖ
36:52.en: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth

36:53.ar: إِن كَانَتِ اِلَّا صَيْحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَۖ
36:53.en: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us

36:54.ar: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسࣱ شَئْاࣰ وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَۖ
36:54.en: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do

36:55.ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ اَ۬لْجَنَّةِ اِ۬لْيَوْمَ فِے شُغْلࣲ فَٰكِهُونَ
36:55.en: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed

36:56.ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِے ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَي اَ۬لَارَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَۖ
36:56.en: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining

36:57.ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱۖ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
36:57.en: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask

36:58.en: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace

36:59.en: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day

36:60.ar: ۞أَلَمَ اَعْهَدِ اِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِےٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُواْ اُ۬لشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:60.en: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe

36:61.en: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path

36:62.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلّاࣰ كَثِيراًۖ اَفَلَمْ تَكُونُواْ تَعْقِلُونَۖ
36:62.en: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense

36:63.en: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him)

36:64.en: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved

36:65.ar: اَ۬لْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَيٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَۖ
36:65.en: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn

36:66.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَيٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَاسْتَبَقُواْ اُ۬لصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنّ۪يٰ يُبْصِرُونَۖ
36:66.en: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen

36:67.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَيٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا اَ۪سْتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيّاࣰ وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَۖ
36:67.en: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back

36:68.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نَنكُسْهُ فِے اِ۬لْخَلْقِۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَۖ
36:68.en: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense

36:69.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ اُ۬لشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِے لَهُۥٓۖ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرࣱ وَقُرْءَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:69.en: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain

36:70.ar: لِّتُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيّاࣰ وَيَحِقَّ اَ۬لْقَوْلُ عَلَي اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
36:70.en: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers

36:71.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوَاْ اَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتَ اَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰماࣰ فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَۖ
36:71.en: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners

36:72.ar: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَاكُلُونَۖ
36:72.en: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food

36:73.ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَۖ
36:73.en: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks

36:74.ar: وَاتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
36:74.en: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped

36:75.ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندࣱ مُّحْضَرُونَۖ
36:75.en: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms

36:76.ar: فَلَا يُحْزِنكَ قَوْلُهُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَۖ
36:76.en: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim

36:77.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ اَ۬لِانسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱۖ
36:77.en: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent

36:78.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلاࣰ وَنَسِيَ خَلْقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَنْ يُّحْيِ اِ۬لْعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمࣱۖ
36:78.en: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away

36:79.ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا اَ۬لذِےٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌۖ
36:79.en: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation

36:80.ar: ۞اِ۬لذِے جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لشَّجَرِ اِ۬لَاخْضَرِ نَاراࣰ فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَۖ
36:80.en: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it

36:81.ar: أَوَلَيْسَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَيٰٓ أَنْ يَّخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمۖ بَل۪يٰ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْخَلَّٰقُ اُ۬لْعَلِيمُۖ
36:81.en: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator

36:82.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَئْاً اَنْ يَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُنۖ فَيَكُونُۖ
36:82.en: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is

36:83.ar: فَسُبْحَٰنَ اَ۬لذِے بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَۖ
36:83.en: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back

37:1.en: By those who set the ranks in battle order

37:2.en: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof

37:3.en: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder

37:4.en: Lo! thy Lord is surely One

37:5.ar: رَّبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ اُ۬لْمَشَٰرِقِۖ
37:5.en: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings

37:6.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا اَ۬لسَّمَآءَ اَ۬لدُّنْي۪ا بِزِينَةِ اِ۬لْكَوَاكِبِۖ
37:6.en: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets

37:7.en: With security from every froward devil

37:8.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ إِلَي اَ۬لْمَلَإِ اِ۬لَاعْل۪يٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲۖ
37:8.en: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side

37:9.en: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment

37:10.ar: اِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ اَ۬لْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱۖ
37:10.en: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame

37:11.ar: فَاسْتَفْتِهِمُۥٓ أَهُمُۥٓ أَشَدُّ خَلْقاً اَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّٰزِبِۢۖ
37:11.en: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay

37:12.en: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock

37:13.en: And heed not when they are reminded

37:14.en: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent

37:15.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
37:15.en: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic

37:16.ar: اَ۟ذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباࣰ وَعِظَٰماً اِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
37:16.en: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)

37:18.en: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low

37:19.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجْرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَۖ
37:19.en: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold

37:20.en: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment

37:21.ar: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ اُ۬لْفَصْلِ اِ۬لذِے كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَۖ
37:21.en: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny

37:22.ar: ۞اَ۟حْشُرُواْ اُ۬لذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعْبُدُونَ
37:22.en: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship

37:23.ar: مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ فَاهْدُوهُمُۥٓ إِلَيٰ صِرَٰطِ اِ۬لْجَحِيمِۖ
37:23.en: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell

37:24.en: And stop them, for they must be questioned

37:25.en: What aileth you that ye help not one another

37:26.en: Nay, but this day they make full submission

37:27.en: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

37:28.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَاتُونَنَا عَنِ اِ۬لْيَمِينِۖ
37:28.en: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth)

37:29.en: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers

37:30.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنِۢ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْماࣰ طَٰغِينَۖ
37:30.en: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk

37:31.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
37:31.en: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom)

37:32.en: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray

37:33.en: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom

37:34.en: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty

37:35.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اَ۬للَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
37:35.en: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful

37:36.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجْنُونِۢۖ
37:36.en: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet

37:37.en: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him)

37:38.en: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom

37:39.ar: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
37:39.en: Ye are requited naught save what ye did

37:41.en: For them there is a known provision

37:42.en: Fruits. And they will be honoured

37:45.en: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them

37:47.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلࣱ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَۖ
37:47.en: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby

37:48.en: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes

37:49.en: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich)

37:50.en: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning

37:51.ar: ۞قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنْهُمُۥٓ إِنِّے كَانَ لِے قَرِينࣱ‏
37:51.en: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade

37:52.en: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)

37:53.ar: أَ۟ذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباࣰ وَعِظَٰماً اِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَۖ
37:53.en: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book

37:55.en: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell

37:56.en: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin

37:57.ar: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّے لَكُنتُ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُحْضَرِينَۖ
37:57.en: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom)

37:58.en: Are we then not to die

37:59.ar: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا اَ۬لُاول۪يٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَۖ
37:59.en: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished

37:60.en: Lo! this is the supreme triumph

37:61.en: For the like of this, then, let the workers work

37:62.ar: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرࣱ نُّزُلاً اَمْ شَجَرَةُ اُ۬لزَّقُّومِۖ
37:62.en: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum

37:63.en: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers

37:64.ar: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةࣱ تَخْرُجُ فِےٓ أَصْلِ اِ۬لْجَحِيمِ
37:64.en: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell

37:65.en: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils

37:66.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا اَ۬لْبُطُونَ
37:66.en: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith

37:67.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْباࣰ مِّنْ حَمِيمࣲۖ
37:67.en: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water

37:68.en: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell

37:69.en: They indeed found their fathers astray

37:70.en: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps

37:71.en: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them

37:72.en: And verily We sent among them warners

37:73.en: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned

37:75.en: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer

37:76.en: And We saved him and his household from the great distress

37:77.en: And made his seed the survivors

37:78.en: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation)

37:79.en: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples

37:80.en: Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:81.en: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves

37:82.en: Then We did drown the others

37:83.en: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham

37:84.en: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart

37:85.ar: اِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَۖ
37:85.en: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship

37:86.en: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire

37:87.en: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds

37:88.en: And he glanced a glance at the stars

37:89.en: Then said: Lo! I feel sick

37:90.en: And they turned their backs and went away from him

37:91.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَيٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَاكُلُونَ
37:91.en: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat

37:92.en: What aileth you that ye speak not

37:93.en: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand

37:94.en: And (his people) came toward him, hastening

37:95.en: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve

37:96.en: When Allah hath created you and what ye make

37:97.ar: قَالُواْ اُ۪بْنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰناࣰ فَأَلْقُوهُ فِے اِ۬لْجَحِيمِ
37:97.en: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire

37:98.en: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost

37:99.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّے ذَاهِبٌ اِلَيٰ رَبِّے سَيَهْدِينِۖ
37:99.en: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me

37:100.en: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous

37:101.en: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son

37:102.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ اُ۬لسَّعْيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيِّ إِنِّيَ أَر۪يٰ فِے اِ۬لْمَنَامِ أَنِّيَ أَذْبَحُكَ فَانظُرْ مَاذَا تَر۪يٰۖ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ اِ۪فْعَلْ مَا تُومَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيَ إِن شَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُ مِنَ اَ۬لصَّٰبِرِينَۖ
37:102.en: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast

37:103.en: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face

37:104.en: We called unto him: O Abraham

37:105.ar: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ اَ۬لرُّءْي۪آۖ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِے اِ۬لْمُحْسِنِينَۖ
37:105.en: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:106.en: Lo! that verily was a clear test

37:107.en: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim

37:108.en: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)

37:110.en: Thus do We reward the good

37:111.en: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves

37:112.en: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous

37:113.ar: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَۖ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱۖ
37:113.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves

37:114.en: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron

37:115.en: And saved them and their people from the great distress

37:116.en: And helped them so that they became the victors

37:117.en: And We gave them the clear Scripture

37:118.en: And showed them the right path

37:119.en: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation)

37:120.en: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron

37:121.en: Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:122.en: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves

37:123.en: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)

37:124.en: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)

37:125.en: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators

37:126.en: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers

37:127.en: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)

37:129.en: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)

37:131.en: Lo! thus do We reward the good

37:132.en: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves

37:133.en: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)

37:134.en: When We saved him and his household, every one

37:135.en: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind

37:137.en: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning

37:138.en: And at night-time; have ye then no sense

37:139.en: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)

37:140.en: When he fled unto the laden ship

37:141.en: And then drew lots and was of those rejected

37:142.en: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy

37:143.en: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)

37:144.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِے بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَيٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَۖ
37:144.en: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised

37:145.en: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick

37:146.en: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him

37:147.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلْفٍ اَوْ يَزِيدُونَۖ
37:147.en: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more

37:148.en: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while

37:149.en: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons

37:150.ar: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا اَ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثاࣰ وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَۖ
37:150.en: Or created We the angels females while they were present

37:151.en: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say

37:152.en: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie

37:153.en: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons

37:154.en: What aileth you? How judge ye

37:156.en: Or have ye a clear warrant

37:157.en: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful

37:158.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ اَ۬لْجِنَّةِ نَسَباࣰۖ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ اِ۬لْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَۖ
37:158.en: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him)

37:159.en: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him)

37:161.en: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship

37:163.en: Save him who is to burn in hell

37:164.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامࣱ مَّعْلُومࣱۖ
37:164.en: There is not one of us but hath his known position

37:165.en: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks

37:166.en: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise

37:167.en: And indeed they used to say

37:168.ar: لَوَ اَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْراࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لَاوَّلِينَ
37:168.en: If we had but a reminder from the men of old

37:169.en: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah

37:170.en: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know

37:171.en: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)

37:172.en: That they verily would be helped

37:173.en: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors

37:174.en: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile

37:175.en: And watch, for they will (soon) see

37:176.en: Would they hasten on Our doom

37:177.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ اُ۬لْمُنذَرِينَۖ
37:177.en: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned

37:179.en: And watch, for they will (soon) see

37:180.ar: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَۖ
37:180.en: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)

37:181.en: And peace be unto those sent (to warn)

37:182.en: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds

38:2.ar: بَلِ اِ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِے عِزَّةࣲ وَشِقَاقࣲۖ
38:2.en: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism

38:3.ar: كَمَ اَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲۖ
38:3.en: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape

38:4.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنْهُمْۖ وَقَالَ اَ۬لْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابٌ
38:4.en: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan

38:5.ar: اَجَعَلَ اَ۬لَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهاࣰ وَٰحِداً اِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَےْءٌ عُجَابࣱۖ
38:5.en: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing

38:6.ar: وَانطَلَقَ اَ۬لْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمُۥٓ أَنِ اِ۪مْشُواْ وَاصْبِرُواْ عَلَيٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَےْءࣱ يُرَادُ
38:6.en: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed

38:7.ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِے اِ۬لْمِلَّةِ اِ۬لَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا اَ۪خْتِلَٰقٌ
38:7.en: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention

38:8.ar: اَ۟نزِلَ عَلَيْهِ اِ۬لذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَاۖ بَلْ هُمْ فِے شَكࣲّ مِّن ذِكْرِے بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِۖ
38:8.en: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom

38:9.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزِ اِ۬لْوَهَّابِۖ
38:9.en: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower

38:10.ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُواْ فِے اِ۬لَاسْبَٰبِۖ
38:10.en: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes

38:11.ar: جُندࣱ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لَاحْزَابِۖ
38:11.en: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there

38:12.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو اُ۬لَاوْتَادِ
38:12.en: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted

38:13.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطࣲ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لَيْكَةَۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لَاحْزَابُۖ
38:13.en: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions

38:14.ar: إِن كُلٌّ اِلَّا كَذَّبَ اَ۬لرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِۖ
38:14.en: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified

38:15.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ الَّا صَيْحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقࣲۖ
38:15.en: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto

38:16.ar: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ اِ۬لْحِسَابِۖ
38:16.en: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning

38:17.ar: اِ۪صْبِرْ عَلَيٰ مَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا اَ۬لَايْدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۖ
38:17.en: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

38:18.ar: اِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا اَ۬لْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالِاشْرَاقِ
38:18.en: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise

38:19.en: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him

38:20.ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ اُ۬لْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ اَ۬لْخِطَابِۖ
38:20.en: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech

38:21.ar: ۞وَهَلَ اَت۪يٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ اُ۬لْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُواْ اُ۬لْمِحْرَابَ
38:21.en: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber

38:22.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفْۖ خَصْمَٰنِ بَغ۪يٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَيٰ بَعْضࣲ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْۖ وَاهْدِنَآ إِلَيٰ سَوَآءِ اِ۬لصِّرَٰطِۖ
38:22.en: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way

38:23.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِے لَهُۥ تِسْعࣱ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةࣰ وَلِے نَعْجَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِے فِے اِ۬لْخِطَابِۖ
38:23.en: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech

38:24.ar: قَالَ لَقَد ظَّلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَيٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيراࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِے بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَيٰ بَعْضٍ اِلَّا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِۖ وَقَلِيلࣱ مَّا هُمْۖ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعاࣰ وَأَنَابَۖ۩
38:24.en: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented

38:25.ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْف۪يٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابࣲۖ
38:25.en: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end

38:26.ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةࣰ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ فَاحْكُم بَيْنَ اَ۬لنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ اِ۬لْهَو۪يٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْحِسَابِۖ
38:26.en: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning

38:27.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا اَ۬لسَّمَآءَ وَالَارْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلاࣰۖ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ فَوَيْلࣱ لِّلذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ اَ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
38:27.en: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire

38:28.ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ اُ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ اُ۬لْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجّ۪ارِۖ
38:28.en: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked

38:29.ar: كِتَٰبٌ اَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكࣱ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ اُ۬لَالْبَٰبِۖ
38:29.en: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect

38:30.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَۖ نِعْمَ اَ۬لْعَبْدُۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۖ
38:30.en: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah)

38:31.en: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers

38:32.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّيَ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ اَ۬لْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّے حَتَّيٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِۖ
38:32.en: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain

38:33.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحاَۢ بِالسُّوقِ وَالَاعْنَاقِۖ
38:33.en: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks

38:34.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَيٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَداࣰ ثُمَّ أَنَابَۖ
38:34.en: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent

38:35.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِ۪غْفِرْ لِے وَهَبْ لِے مُلْكاࣰ لَّا يَنۢبَغِے لِأَحَدࣲ مِّنۢ بَعْدِيَۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ اَ۬لْوَهَّابُۖ
38:35.en: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower

38:36.ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ اُ۬لرِّيحَ تَجْرِے بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
38:36.en: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended

38:37.en: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient)

38:38.en: And others linked together in chains

38:39.ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَامْنُنَ اَوَ اَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابࣲۖ
38:39.en: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning

38:40.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْف۪يٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابࣲۖ
38:40.en: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end

38:41.ar: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَاد۪يٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّے مَسَّنِيَ اَ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبࣲ وَعَذَابٍۖ
38:41.en: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment

38:42.ar: اُ۟رْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱۖ
38:42.en: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink

38:43.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَذِكْر۪يٰ لِأُوْلِے اِ۬لَالْبَٰبِۖ
38:43.en: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding

38:44.ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثاࣰ فَاضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثِۖ اِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِراࣰۖ نِّعْمَ اَ۬لْعَبْدُۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱۖ
38:44.en: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord)

38:45.ar: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُوْلِے اِ۬لَايْدِے وَالَابْصٰ۪رِۖ
38:45.en: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision

38:46.en: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter)

38:47.en: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent

38:48.ar: وَاذْكُرِ اِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا اَ۬لْكِفْلِۖ وَكُلࣱّ مِّنَ اَ۬لَاخْي۪ارِۖ
38:48.en: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen

38:49.ar: هَٰذَا ذِكْرࣱۖ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:49.en: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end

38:50.en: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them

38:51.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ وَشَرَابࣲۖ
38:51.en: Wherein, reclining, they call for plenteous fruit and cool drink (that is) therein

38:52.en: And with them are those of modest gaze, companions

38:53.en: This it is that ye are promised for the Day of Reckoning

38:54.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍۖ
38:54.en: Lo! this in truth is Our provision, which will never waste away

38:55.en: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end

38:56.en: Hell, where they will burn, an evil resting-place

38:57.en: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it

38:58.en: And other (torment) of the kind in pairs (the two extremes)

38:59.ar: هَٰذَا فَوْجࣱ مُّقْتَحِمࣱ مَّعَكُمْۖ لَا مَرْحَباَۢ بِهِمُۥٓۖ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُواْ اُ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
38:59.en: Here is an army rushing blindly with you. (Those who are already in the Fire say): No word of welcome for them. Lo! they will roast at the Fire

38:60.ar: قَالُواْ بَلَ اَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَباَۢ بِكُمُۥٓ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِيسَ اَ۬لْقَرَارُۖ
38:60.en: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight

38:61.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَاباࣰ ضِعْفاࣰ فِے اِ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
38:61.en: They say: Our Lord! Whoever did prepare this for us, oh, give him double portion of the Fire

38:62.ar: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَر۪يٰ رِجَالاࣰ كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ اَ۬لَاشْر۪ارِۖ
38:62.en: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked

38:63.ar: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سُخْرِيّاً اَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ اُ۬لَابْصَٰرُۖ
38:63.en: Did we take them (wrongly) for a laughing-stock, or have our eyes missed them

38:64.ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقࣱّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ اِ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
38:64.en: Lo! that is very truth: the wrangling of the dwellers in the Fire

38:65.ar: قُلِ اِنَّمَآ أَنَا مُنذِرࣱۖ وَمَا مِنِ اِلَٰهٍ اِلَّا اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْوَٰحِدُ اُ۬لْقَهَّارُۖ
38:65.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I am only a warner, and there is no Allah save Allah, the One, the Absolute

38:66.ar: رَبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۖ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْغَفَّٰرُۖ
38:66.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the Mighty, the Pardoning

38:69.ar: مَا كَانَ لِے مِنْ عِلْمِۢ بِالْمَلَإِ اِ۬لَاعْل۪يٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَۖ
38:69.en: I had no knowledge of the Highest Chiefs when they disputed

38:70.ar: إِنْ يُّوح۪يٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌۖ
38:70.en: It is revealed unto me only that I may be a plain warner

38:71.ar: اِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّے خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَراࣰ مِّن طِينࣲ‏
38:71.en: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire

38:72.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِے فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَۖ
38:72.en: And when I have fashioned him and breathed into him of My Spirit, then fall down before him prostrate

38:73.en: The angels fell down prostrate, every one

38:74.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ اَ۪سْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
38:74.en: Saving Iblis; he was scornful and became one of the disbelievers

38:75.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لْعَالِينَۖ
38:75.en: He said: O Iblis! What hindereth thee from falling prostrate before that which I have created with both My hands? Art thou too proud or art thou of the high exalted

38:76.ar: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرࣱ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِے مِن نّ۪ارࣲ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينࣲۖ
38:76.en: He said: I am better than him. Thou createdst me of fire, whilst him Thou didst create of clay

38:77.en: He said: Go forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast

38:78.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِيَ إِلَيٰ يَوْمِ اِ۬لدِّينِۖ
38:78.en: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment

38:79.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِےٓ إِلَيٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَۖ
38:79.en: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised

38:80.en: He said: Lo! thou art of those reprieved

38:81.en: Until the day of the time appointed

38:82.en: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one

38:83.en: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them

38:84.en: He said: The Truth is, and the Truth I speak

38:85.ar: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَۖ
38:85.en: That I shall fill hell with thee and with such of them as follow thee, together

38:86.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اَجْرࣲ وَمَآ أَنَا مِنَ اَ۬لْمُتَكَلِّفِينَۖ
38:86.en: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating

38:87.en: Lo! it is naught else than a reminder for all peoples

38:88.en: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof

39:1.ar: تَنزِيلُ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ اَ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لْعَزِيزِ اِ۬لْحَكِيمِۖ
39:1.en: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise

39:2.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ بِالْحَقِّ فَاعْبُدِ اِ۬للَّهَ مُخْلِصاࣰ لَّهُ اُ۬لدِّينَۖ
39:2.en: Lo! We have revealed the Scripture unto thee (Muhammad) with truth; so worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only)

39:3.ar: أَلَا لِلهِ اِ۬لدِّينُ اُ۬لْخَالِصُۖ وَالذِينَ اَ۪تَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمُۥٓ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ زُلْف۪يٰٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِے مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَا يَهْدِے مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبࣱ كَفَّارࣱۖ
39:3.en: Surely pure religion is for Allah only. And those who choose protecting friends beside Him (say): We worship them only that they may bring us near unto Allah. Lo! Allah will judge between them concerning that wherein they differ. Lo! Allah guideth not him who is a liar, an ingrate

39:4.ar: لَّوَ اَرَادَ اَ۬للَّهُ أَنْ يَّتَّخِذَ وَلَداࣰ لَّاصْطَف۪يٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥۖ هُوَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْوَٰحِدُ اُ۬لْقَهَّارُۖ
39:4.en: If Allah had willed to choose a son, He could have chosen what He would of that which He hath created. Be He Glorified! He is Allah, the One, the Absolute

39:5.ar: خَلَقَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ بِالْحَقِّۖ يُكَوِّرُ اُ۬ليْلَ عَلَي اَ۬لنَّه۪ارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ اُ۬لنَّهَارَ عَلَي اَ۬ليْلِۖ وَسَخَّرَ اَ۬لشَّمْسَ وَالْقَمَرَۖ كُلࣱّ يَجْرِے لِأَجَلࣲ مُّسَمّيًۖ اَلَا هُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْغَفَّٰرُۖ
39:5.en: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. He maketh night to succeed day, and He maketh day to succeed night, and He constraineth the sun and the moon to give service, each running on for an appointed term. Is not He the Mighty, the Forgiver

39:6.ar: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسࣲ وَٰحِدَةࣲ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَاۖ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لَانْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجࣲۖ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِے بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقاࣰ مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقࣲ فِے ظُلُمَٰتࣲ ثَلَٰثࣲۖ ذَٰلِكُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ اُ۬لْمُلْكُۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنّ۪يٰ تُصْرَفُونَۖ
39:6.en: He created you from one being, then from that (being) He made its mate; and He hath provided for you of cattle eight kinds. He created you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, in a threefold gloom. Such is Allah, your Lord. His is the Sovereignty. There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye turned away

39:7.ar: إِن تَكْفُرُواْ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنكُمْۖ وَلَا يَرْض۪يٰ لِعِبَادِهِ اِ۬لْكُفْرَۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُواْ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْۖ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةࣱ وِزْرَ أُخْر۪يٰۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ اِ۬لصُّدُورِۖ
39:7.en: If ye are thankless, yet Allah is Independent of you, though He is not pleased with thanklessness for His bondmen; and if ye are thankful He is pleased therewith for you. No laden soul will bear another's load. Then unto your Lord is your return; and He will tell you what ye used to do. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men)

39:8.ar: ۞وَإِذَا مَسَّ اَ۬لِانسَٰنَ ضُرࣱّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيباً اِلَيْهِۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةࣰ مِّنْهُ نَسِيَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓاْ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلهِ أَندَاداࣰ لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۖ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلاً اِنَّكَ مِنَ اَصْحَٰبِ اِ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
39:8.en: And when some hurt toucheth man, he crieth unto his Lord, turning unto Him (repentant). Then, when He granteth him a boon from Him he forgetteth that for which he cried unto Him before, and setteth up rivals to Allah that he may beguile (men) from his way. Say (O Muhammad, unto such an one): Take pleasure in thy disbelief a while. Lo! thou art of the owners of the Fire

39:9.ar: أَمَنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ اٰنَآءَ اَ۬ليْلِ سَاجِداࣰ وَقَآئِماࣰ يَحْذَرُ اُ۬لَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُواْ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦۖ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِے اِ۬لذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَۖ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُوْلُواْ اُ۬لَالْبَٰبِۖ
39:9.en: Is he who payeth adoration in the watches of the night, prostrate and standing, bewaring of the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, (to be accounted equal with a disbeliever)? Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Are those who know equal with those who know not? But only men of understanding will pay heed

39:10.ar: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ اِ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اُ۪تَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمْۖ لِلذِينَ أَحْسَنُواْ فِے هَٰذِهِ اِ۬لدُّنْي۪ا حَسَنَةࣱۖ وَأَرْضُ اُ۬للَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۖ اِنَّمَا يُوَفَّي اَ۬لصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابࣲۖ
39:10.en: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint

39:11.ar: قُلِ اِنِّيَ أُمِرْتُ أَنَ اَعْبُدَ اَ۬للَّهَ مُخْلِصاࣰ لَّهُ اُ۬لدِّينَ
39:11.en: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only)

39:12.en: And I am commanded to be the first of those who are muslims (surrender unto Him)

39:13.ar: قُلِ اِنِّيَ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّے عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمࣲۖ
39:13.en: Say: Lo! if I should disobey my Lord, I fear the doom of a tremendous Day

39:14.ar: قُلِ اِ۬للَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصاࣰ لَّهُۥ دِينِےۖ
39:14.en: Say: Allah I worship, making my religion pure for Him (only)

39:15.ar: فَاعْبُدُواْ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦۖ قُلِ اِنَّ اَ۬لْخَٰسِرِينَ اَ۬لذِينَ خَسِرُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِۖ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ اَ۬لْخُسْرَانُ اُ۬لْمُبِينُۖ
39:15.en: Then worship what ye will beside Him. Say: The losers will be those who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Ah, that will be the manifest loss

39:16.ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لنّ۪ارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلࣱۖ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ اُ۬للَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥۖ يَٰعِبَادِ فَاتَّقُونِۖ
39:16.en: They have an awning of fire above them and beneath them a dais (of fire). With this doth Allah appal His bondmen. O My bondmen, therefor fear Me

39:17.ar: وَالذِينَ اَ۪جْتَنَبُواْ اُ۬لطَّٰغُوتَ أَنْ يَّعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓاْ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ لَهُمُ اُ۬لْبُشْر۪يٰۖ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
39:17.en: And those who put away false gods lest they should worship them and turn to Allah in repentance, for them there are glad tidings. Therefor give good tidings (O Muhammad) to My bondmen

39:18.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ اَ۬لْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ اَ۬لذِينَ هَد۪يٰهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُۥٓ أُوْلُواْ اُ۬لَالْبَٰبِۖ
39:18.en: Who hear advice and follow the best thereof. Such are those whom Allah guideth, and such are men of understanding

39:19.ar: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ اُ۬لْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِے اِ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
39:19.en: Is he on whom the word of doom is fulfilled (to be helped), and canst thou (O Muhammad) rescue him who is in the Fire

39:20.ar: لَٰكِنِ اِ۬لذِينَ اَ۪تَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفࣱ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفࣱ مَّبْنِيَّةࣱ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُۖ وَعْدَ اَ۬للَّهِۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْمِيعَادَۖ
39:20.en: But those who keep their duty to their Lord, for them are lofty halls with lofty halls above them, built (for them), beneath which rivers flow. (It is) a promise of Allah. Allah faileth not His promise

39:21.ar: ۞أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعاࣰ مُّخْتَلِفاً اَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَر۪يٰهُ مُصْفَرّاࣰ ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰماًۖ اِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْر۪يٰ لِأُوْلِے اِ۬لَالْبَٰبِۖ
39:21.en: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath sent down water from the sky and hath caused it to penetrate the earth as watersprings, and afterward thereby produceth crops of divers hues; and afterward they wither and thou seest them turn yellow; then He maketh them chaff. Lo! herein verily is a reminder for men of understanding

39:22.ar: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ اَ۬للَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلِاسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَيٰ نُورࣲ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦۖ فَوَيْلࣱ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِے ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍۖ
39:22.en: Is he whose bosom Allah hath expanded for Al-Islam, so that he followeth a light from his Lord, (as he who disbelieveth)? Then woe unto those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allah. Such are in plain error

39:23.ar: اِ۬للَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ اَ۬لْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰباࣰ مُّتَشَٰبِهاࣰ مَّثَانِيَۖ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ اُ۬لذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمُۥٓ إِلَيٰ ذِكْرِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَي اَ۬للَّهِ يَهْدِے بِهِۦ مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اِ۬للَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۖ
39:23.en: Allah hath (now) revealed the fairest of statements, a Scripture consistent, (wherein promises of reward are) paired (with threats of punishment), whereat doth creep the flesh of those who fear their Lord, so that their flesh and their hearts soften to Allah's reminder. Such is Allah's guidance, wherewith He guideth whom He will. And him whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

39:24.ar: اَفَمَنْ يَّتَّقِے بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ اَ۬لْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِۖ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُواْ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَۖ
39:24.en: Is he then, who will strike his face against the awful doom upon the Day of Resurrection (as he who doeth right)? And it will be said unto the wrong-doers: Taste what ye used to earn

39:25.ar: كَذَّبَ اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَت۪يٰهُمُ اُ۬لْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَۖ
39:25.en: Those before them denied, and so the doom came on them whence they knew not

39:26.ar: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْخِزْيَ فِے اِ۬لْحَيَوٰةِ اِ۬لدُّنْي۪اۖ وَلَعَذَابُ اُ۬لَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَۖ
39:26.en: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know

39:27.ar: وَلَقَد ضَّرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِے هَٰذَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلࣲ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
39:27.en: And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect

39:28.ar: قُرْءَاناً عَرَبِيّاً غَيْرَ ذِے عِوَجࣲ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَۖ
39:28.en: A Lecture in Arabic, containing no crookedness, that haply they may ward off (evil)

39:29.ar: ضَرَبَ اَ۬للَّهُ مَثَلاࣰ رَّجُلاࣰ فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلاࣰ سَلَماࣰ لِّرَجُلٍۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَٰنِ مَثَلاًۖ اِ۬لْحَمْدُ لِلهِۖ بَلَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَۖ
39:29.en: Allah coineth a similitude: A man in relation to whom are several part-owners, quarrelling, and a man belonging wholly to one man. Are the two equal in similitude? Praise be to Allah! But most of them know not

39:30.en: Lo! thou wilt die, and lo! they will die

39:31.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَۖ
39:31.en: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord ye will dispute

39:32.ar: ۞فَمَنَ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِالصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓۖ أَلَيْسَ فِے جَهَنَّمَ مَثْويࣰ لِّلْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
39:32.en: And who doth greater wrong than he who telleth a lie against Allah, and denieth the truth when it reacheth him? Will not the home of disbelievers be in hell

39:33.ar: وَالذِے جَآءَ بِالصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْمُتَّقُونَۖ
39:33.en: And whoso bringeth the truth and believeth therein - Such are the dutiful

39:34.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْۖ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُاْ اُ۬لْمُحْسِنِينَ
39:34.en: They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good

39:35.ar: لِيُكَفِّرَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَنْهُمُۥٓ أَسْوَأَ اَ۬لذِے عَمِلُواْ وَيَجْزِيَهُمُۥٓ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ اِ۬لذِے كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَۖ
39:35.en: That Allah will remit from them the worst of what they did, and will pay them for reward the best they used to do

39:36.ar: أَلَيْسَ اَ۬للَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِالذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦۖ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اِ۬للَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادࣲۖ
39:36.en: Will not Allah defend His slave? Yet they would frighten thee with those beside Him. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

39:37.ar: وَمَنْ يَّهْدِ اِ۬للَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۖ اَلَيْسَ اَ۬للَّهُ بِعَزِيزࣲ ذِے اِ۪نتِقَامࣲۖ
39:37.en: And he whom Allah guideth, for him there can be no misleader. Is not Allah Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)

39:38.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ اَ۬للَّهُۖ قُلَ اَفَرَٰٓيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ إِنَ اَرَادَنِيَ اَ۬للَّهُ بِضُرٍّ هَلْ هُنَّ كَٰشِفَٰتُ ضُرِّهِۦٓ أَوَ اَرَادَنِے بِرَحْمَةٍ هَلْ هُنَّ مُمْسِكَٰتُ رَحْمَتِهِۦۖ قُلْ حَسْبِيَ اَ۬للَّهُۖ عَلَيْهِ يَتَوَكَّلُ اُ۬لْمُتَوَكِّلُونَۖ
39:38.en: And verily, if thou shouldst ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth? they will say: Allah. Say: Bethink you then of those ye worship beside Allah, if Allah willed some hurt for me, could they remove from me His hurt; or if He willed some mercy for me, could they restrain His mercy? Say: Allah is my all. In Him do (all) the trusting put their trust

39:39.ar: قُلْ يَٰقَوْمِ اِ۪عْمَلُواْ عَلَيٰ مَكَانَتِكُمُۥٓ إِنِّے عَٰمِلࣱۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
39:39.en: Say: O my people! Act in your manner. Lo! I (too) am acting. Thus ye will come to know

39:40.ar: مَنْ يَّاتِيهِ عَذَابࣱ يُخْزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيْهِ عَذَابࣱ مُّقِيمٌۖ
39:40.en: Who it is unto whom cometh a doom that will abase him, and on whom there falleth everlasting doom

39:41.ar: اِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبَ لِلنَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّۖ فَمَنِ اِ۪هْتَد۪يٰ فَلِنَفْسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَاۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِوَكِيلٍۖ
39:41.en: Lo! We have revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture for mankind with truth. Then whosoever goeth right it is for his soul, and whosoever strayeth, strayeth only to its hurt. And thou art not a warder over them

39:42.ar: اِ۬للَّهُ يَتَوَفَّي اَ۬لَانفُسَ حِينَ مَوْتِهَا وَالتِے لَمْ تَمُتْ فِے مَنَامِهَاۖ فَيُمْسِكُ اُ۬لتِے قَض۪يٰ عَلَيْهَا اَ۬لْمَوْتَ وَيُرْسِلُ اُ۬لُاخْر۪يٰٓ إِلَيٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمّيًۖ اِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوْمࣲ يَتَفَكَّرُونَۖ
39:42.en: Allah receiveth (men's) souls at the time of their death, and that (soul) which dieth not (yet) in its sleep. He keepeth that (soul) for which He hath ordained death and dismisseth the rest till an appointed term. Lo! herein verily are portents for people who take thought

39:43.ar: ۞أَمِ اِ۪تَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ شُفَعَآءَۖ قُلَ اَوَلَوْ كَانُواْ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ شَئْاࣰ وَلَا يَعْقِلُونَۖ
39:43.en: Or choose they intercessors other than Allah? Say: What! Even though they have power over nothing and have no intelligence

39:44.ar: قُل لِّلهِ اِ۬لشَّفَٰعَةُ جَمِيعاࣰۖ لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَۖ
39:44.en: Say: Unto Allah belongeth all intercession. His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. And afterward unto Him ye will be brought back

39:45.ar: وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اَ۬للَّهُ وَحْدَهُ اُ۪شْمَأَزَّتْ قُلُوبُ اُ۬لذِينَ لَا يُومِنُونَ بِالَاخِرَةِۖ وَإِذَا ذُكِرَ اَ۬لذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَۖ
39:45.en: And when Allah alone is mentioned, the hearts of those who believe not in the Hereafter are repelled, and when those (whom they worship) beside Him are mentioned, behold! they are glad

39:46.ar: قُلِ اِ۬للَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ عَٰلِمَ اَ۬لْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَٰدَةِ أَنتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِے مَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَۖ
39:46.en: Say: O Allah! Creator of the heavens and the earth! Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! Thou wilt judge between Thy slaves concerning that wherein they used to differ

39:47.ar: وَلَوَ اَنَّ لِلذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ جَمِيعاࣰ وَمِثْلَهُۥ مَعَهُۥ لَافْتَدَوْاْ بِهِۦ مِن سُوٓءِ اِ۬لْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِۖ وَبَدَا لَهُم مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ مَا لَمْ يَكُونُواْ يَحْتَسِبُونَۖ
39:47.en: And though those who do wrong possess all that is in the earth, and therewith as much again, they verily will seek to ransom themselves therewith on the Day of Resurrection from the awful doom; and there will appear unto them, from their Lord, that wherewith they never reckoned

39:48.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۖ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَۖ
39:48.en: And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them

39:49.ar: فَإِذَا مَسَّ اَ۬لِانسَٰنَ ضُرࣱّ دَعَانَا ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلْنَٰهُ نِعْمَةࣰ مِّنَّا قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أُوتِيتُهُۥ عَلَيٰ عِلْمِۢۖ بَلْ هِيَ فِتْنَةࣱ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَۖ
39:49.en: Now when hurt toucheth a man he crieth unto Us, and afterward when We have granted him a boon from Us, he saith: Only by force of knowledge I obtained it. Nay, but it is a test. But most of them know not

39:50.ar: قَدْ قَالَهَا اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَمَآ أَغْن۪يٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَۖ
39:50.en: Those before them said it, yet (all) that they had earned availed them not

39:51.ar: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْۖ وَالذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنْ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ سَيُصِيبُهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَۖ
39:51.en: But the evils that they earned smote them; and such of these as do wrong, the evils that they earn will smite them; they cannot escape

39:52.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَعْلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَبْسُطُ اُ۬لرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُۖ إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتࣲ لِّقَوْمࣲ يُومِنُونَۖ
39:52.en: Know they not that Allah enlargeth providence for whom He will, and straiteneth it (for whom He will). Lo! herein verily are portents for people who believe

39:53.ar: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِيَ اَ۬لذِينَ أَسْرَفُواْ عَلَيٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُواْ مِن رَّحْمَةِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَغْفِرُ اُ۬لذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاًۖ اِنَّهُۥ هُوَ اَ۬لْغَفُورُ اُ۬لرَّحِيمُۖ
39:53.en: Say: O My slaves who have been prodigal to their own hurt! Despair not of the mercy of Allah, Who forgiveth all sins. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful

39:54.ar: ۞وَأَنِيبُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ رَبِّكُمْ وَأَسْلِمُواْ لَهُۥ مِن قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّاتِيَكُمُ اُ۬لْعَذَابُ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَۖ
39:54.en: Turn unto your Lord repentant, and surrender unto Him, before there come unto you the doom, when ye cannot be helped

39:55.ar: وَاتَّبِعُوٓاْ أَحْسَنَ مَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُم مِّن رَّبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّاتِيَكُمُ اُ۬لْعَذَابُ بَغْتَةࣰ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
39:55.en: And follow the better (guidance) of that which is revealed unto you from your Lord, before the doom cometh on you suddenly when ye know not

39:56.ar: أَن تَقُولَ نَفْسࣱ يَٰحَسْرَت۪يٰ عَلَيٰ مَا فَرَّطْتُّ فِے جَنۢبِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَإِن كُنتُ لَمِنَ اَ۬لسَّٰخِرِينَ
39:56.en: Lest any soul should say: Alas, my grief that I was unmindful of Allah, and I was indeed among the scoffers

39:57.ar: أَوْ تَقُولَ لَوَ اَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هَد۪يٰنِے لَكُنتُ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُتَّقِينَ
39:57.en: Or should say: If Allah had but guided me I should have been among the dutiful

39:58.ar: أَوْ تَقُولَ حِينَ تَرَي اَ۬لْعَذَابَ لَوَ اَنَّ لِے كَرَّةࣰ فَأَكُونَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُحْسِنِينَۖ
39:58.en: Or should say, when it seeth the doom: Oh, that I had but a second chance that I might be among the righteous

39:59.ar: بَل۪يٰ قَدْ جَآءَتْكَ ءَايَٰتِے فَكَذَّبْتَ بِهَا وَاسْتَكْبَرْتَ وَكُنتَ مِنَ اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
39:59.en: (But now the answer will be): Nay, for My revelations came unto thee, but thou didst deny them and wast scornful and wast among the disbelievers

39:60.ar: وَيَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ تَرَي اَ۬لذِينَ كَذَبُواْ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ وُجُوهُهُم مُّسْوَدَّةٌۖ اَلَيْسَ فِے جَهَنَّمَ مَثْويࣰ لِّلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَۖ
39:60.en: And on the Day of Resurrection thou (Muhammad) seest those who lied concerning Allah with their faces blackened. Is not the home of the scorners in hell

39:61.ar: وَيُنَجِّے اِ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ اَ۪تَّقَوْاْ بِمَفَازَتِهِمْ لَا يَمَسُّهُمُ اُ۬لسُّوٓءُ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَۖ
39:61.en: And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve

39:62.ar: اَ۬للَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲۖ وَهُوَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ وَكِيلࣱۖ
39:62.en: Allah is Creator of all things, and He is Guardian over all things

39:63.ar: لَّهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَالذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ اِ۬للَّهِ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْخَٰسِرُونَۖ
39:63.en: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth, and they who disbelieve the revelations of Allah - such are they who are the losers

39:64.ar: قُلَ اَفَغَيْرَ اَ۬للَّهِ تَامُرُونِيَ أَعْبُدُ أَيُّهَا اَ۬لْجَٰهِلُونَۖ
39:64.en: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools

39:65.ar: وَلَقَدُ ا۟وحِيَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِلَي اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكَ لَئِنَ اَشْرَكْتَ لَيَحْبَطَنَّ عَمَلُكَ وَلَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ اَ۬لْخَٰسِرِينَۖ
39:65.en: And verily it hath been revealed unto thee as unto those before thee (saying): If thou ascribe a partner to Allah thy work will fail and thou indeed wilt be among the losers

39:66.ar: بَلِ اِ۬للَّهَ فَاعْبُدْ وَكُن مِّنَ اَ۬لشَّٰكِرِينَۖ
39:66.en: Nay, but Allah must thou serve, and be among the thankful

39:67.ar: ۞وَمَا قَدَرُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦ وَالَارْضُ جَمِيعاࣰ قَبْضَتُهُۥ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ وَالسَّمَٰوَٰتُ مَطْوِيَّٰتُۢ بِيَمِينِهِۦۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰل۪يٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَۖ
39:67.en: And they esteem not Allah as He hath the right to be esteemed, when the whole earth is His handful on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens are rolled in His right hand. Glorified is He and High Exalted from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

39:68.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِے اِ۬لصُّورِ فَصَعِقَ مَن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُۖ ثُمَّ نُفِخَ فِيهِ أُخْر۪يٰ فَإِذَا هُمْ قِيَامࣱ يَنظُرُونَۖ
39:68.en: And the trumpet is blown, and all who are in the heavens and all who are in the earth swoon away, save him whom Allah willeth. Then it is blown a second time, and behold them standing waiting

39:69.ar: وَأَشْرَقَتِ اِ۬لَارْضُ بِنُورِ رَبِّهَا وَوُضِعَ اَ۬لْكِتَٰبُ وَجِےٓءَ بِالنَّبِيٓـِٕۧنَ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَۖ
39:69.en: And the earth shineth with the light of her Lord, and the Book is set up, and the prophets and the witnesses are brought, and it is judged between them with truth, and they are not wronged

39:70.ar: وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسࣲ مَّا عَمِلَتْ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَفْعَلُونَۖ
39:70.en: And each soul is paid in full for what it did. And He is Best Aware of what they do

39:71.ar: وَسِيقَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ جَهَنَّمَ زُمَراًۖ حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا فُتِّحَتَ اَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَاتِكُمْ رُسُلࣱ مِّنكُمْ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْكُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّكُمْ وَيُنذِرُونَكُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَاۖ قَالُواْ بَل۪يٰ وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَةُ اُ۬لْعَذَابِ عَلَي اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَۖ
39:71.en: And those who disbelieve are driven unto hell in troops till, when they reach it and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Came there not unto you messengers of your own, reciting unto you the revelations of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this your Day? they say: Yea, verily. But the word of doom of disbelievers is fulfilled

39:72.ar: قِيلَ اَ۟دْخُلُوٓاْ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَبِيسَ مَثْوَي اَ۬لْمُتَكَبِّرِينَۖ
39:72.en: It is said (unto them): Enter ye the gates of hell to dwell therein. Thus hapless is the journey's end of the scorners

39:73.ar: وَسِيقَ اَ۬لذِينَ اَ۪تَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمُۥٓ إِلَي اَ۬لْجَنَّةِ زُمَراًۖ حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِّحَتَ اَبْوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ طِبْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَۖ
39:73.en: And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein

39:74.ar: وَقَالُواْ اُ۬لْحَمْدُ لِلهِ اِ۬لذِے صَدَقَنَا وَعْدَهُۥ وَأَوْرَثَنَا اَ۬لَارْضَ نَتَبَوَّأُ مِنَ اَ۬لْجَنَّةِ حَيْثُ نَشَآءُ فَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ اُ۬لْعَٰمِلِينَۖ
39:74.en: They say: Praise be to Allah, Who hath fulfilled His promise unto us and hath made us inherit the land, sojourning in the Garden where we will! So bounteous is the wage of workers

39:75.ar: وَتَرَي اَ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ حَآفِّينَ مِنْ حَوْلِ اِ۬لْعَرْشِ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْۖ وَقُضِيَ بَيْنَهُم بِالْحَقِّۖ وَقِيلَ اَ۬لْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ اِ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
39:75.en: And thou (O Muhammad) seest the angels thronging round the Throne, hymning the praises of their Lord. And they are judged aright. And it is said: Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

40:2.ar: تَنزِيلُ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ اَ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لْعَزِيزِ اِ۬لْعَلِيمِ
40:2.en: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Knower

40:3.ar: غَافِرِ اِ۬لذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ اِ۬لتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ اِ۬لْعِقَابِ ذِے اِ۬لطَّوْلِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ إِلَيْهِ اِ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
40:3.en: The Forgiver of sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Stern in punishment, the Bountiful. There is no Allah save Him. Unto Him is the journeying

40:4.ar: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِےٓ ءَايَٰتِ اِ۬للَّهِ إِلَّا اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِے اِ۬لْبِلَٰدِۖ
40:4.en: None argue concerning the revelations of Allah save those who disbelieve, so let not their turn of fortune in the land deceive thee (O Muhammad)

40:5.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحࣲ وَالَاحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْۖ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةِۢ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَاخُذُوهُۖ وَجَٰدَلُواْ بِالْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُواْ بِهِ اِ۬لْحَقَّ فَأَخَذتُّهُمْۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِۖ
40:5.en: The folk of Noah and the factions after them denied (their messengers) before these, and every nation purposed to seize their messenger and argued falsely, (thinking) thereby to refute the Truth. Then I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment

40:6.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَي اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمُۥٓ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
40:6.en: Thus was the word of thy Lord concerning those who disbelieve fulfilled: That they are owners of the Fire

40:7.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ اَ۬لْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُومِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَےْءࣲ رَّحْمَةࣰ وَعِلْماࣰ فَاغْفِرْ لِلذِينَ تَابُواْ وَاتَّبَعُواْ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ اَ۬لْجَحِيمِۖ
40:7.en: Those who bear the Throne, and all who are round about it, hymn the praises of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who believe (saying): Our Lord! Thou comprehendest all things in mercy and knowledge, therefor forgive those who repent and follow Thy way. Ward off from them the punishment of hell

40:8.ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ اِ۬لتِے وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنَ اٰبَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمُۥٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
40:8.en: Our Lord! And make them enter the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised them, with such of their fathers and their wives and their descendants as do right. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Mighty, the Wise

40:9.ar: وَقِهِمُ اُ۬لسَّيِّـَٔاتِۖ وَمَن تَقِ اِ۬لسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذࣲ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥۖ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ اَ۬لْفَوْزُ اُ۬لْعَظِيمُۖ
40:9.en: And ward off from them ill-deeds; and he from whom Thou wardest off ill-deeds that day, him verily hast Thou taken into mercy. That is the supreme triumph

40:10.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ اُ۬للَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمُۥٓ أَنفُسَكُمُۥٓ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَي اَ۬لِايمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَۖ
40:10.en: Lo! (on that day) those who disbelieve are informed by proclamation: Verily Allah's abhorrence is more terrible than your abhorrence one of another, when ye were called unto the faith but did refuse

40:11.ar: ۞قَالُواْ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا اَ۪ثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا اَ۪ثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلِ اِلَيٰ خُرُوجࣲ مِّن سَبِيلࣲۖ
40:11.en: They say: Our Lord! Twice hast Thou made us die, and twice hast Thou made us live. Now we confess our sins. Is there any way to go out

40:12.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ اَ۬للَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِنْ يُّشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُومِنُواْۖ فَالْحُكْمُ لِلهِ اِ۬لْعَلِيِّ اِ۬لْكَبِيرِۖ
40:12.en: (It is said unto them): This is (your plight) because, when Allah only was invoked, ye disbelieved, but when some partner was ascribed to Him ye were believing. But the command belongeth only to Allah, the Sublime, the Majestic

40:13.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِے يُرِيكُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ رِزْقاࣰۖ وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَنْ يُّنِيبُۖ
40:13.en: He it is Who showeth you His portents, and sendeth down for you provision from the sky. None payeth heed save him who turneth (unto Him) repentant

40:14.ar: فَادْعُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ اُ۬لدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ اَ۬لْكَٰفِرُونَۖ
40:14.en: Therefor (O believers) pray unto Allah, making religion pure for Him (only), however much the disbelievers be averse

40:15.ar: رَفِيعُ اُ۬لدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو اُ۬لْعَرْشِۖ يُلْقِے اِ۬لرُّوحَ مِنَ اَمْرِهِۦ عَلَيٰ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ اَ۬لتَّلَٰقِۦ
40:15.en: The Exalter of Ranks, the Lord of the Throne. He causeth the Spirit of His command upon whom He will of His slaves, that He may warn of the Day of Meeting

40:16.ar: يَوْمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخْف۪يٰ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَےْءࣱۖ لِّمَنِ اِ۬لْمُلْكُ اُ۬لْيَوْمَۖ لِلهِ اِ۬لْوَٰحِدِ اِ۬لْقَهّ۪ارِۖ
40:16.en: The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty

40:17.ar: اِ۬لْيَوْمَ تُجْز۪يٰ كُلُّ نَفْسِۢ بِمَا كَسَبَتْۖ لَا ظُلْمَ اَ۬لْيَوْمَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ سَرِيعُ اُ۬لْحِسَابِۖ
40:17.en: This day is each soul requited that which it hath earned; no wrong (is done) this day. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning

40:18.ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لَازِفَةِ إِذِ اِ۬لْقُلُوبُ لَدَي اَ۬لْحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۖ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمࣲ وَلَا شَفِيعࣲ يُطَاعُۖ
40:18.en: Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard

40:19.ar: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ اَ۬لَاعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِے اِ۬لصُّدُورُۖ
40:19.en: He knoweth the traitor of the eyes, and that which the bosoms hide

40:20.ar: وَاللَّهُ يَقْضِے بِالْحَقِّۖ وَالذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَےْءٍۖ اِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لسَّمِيعُ اُ۬لْبَصِيرُۖ
40:20.en: Allah judgeth with truth, while those to whom they cry instead of Him judge not at all. Lo! Allah, He is the Hearer, the Seer

40:21.ar: ۞أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُواْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَانُواْ مِن قَبْلِهِمْۖ كَانُواْ هُمُۥٓ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةࣰ وَءَاثَاراࣰ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْۖ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ مِنْ وَّاقࣲۖ
40:21.en: Have they not travelled in the land to see the nature of the consequence for those who disbelieved before them? They were mightier than these in power and (in the) traces (which they left behind them) in the earth. Yet Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah

40:22.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّاتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُواْ فَأَخَذَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِيࣱّ شَدِيدُ اُ۬لْعِقَابِۖ
40:22.en: That was because their messengers kept bringing them clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty) but they disbelieved; so Allah seized them. Lo! He is Strong, severe in punishment

40:23.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوس۪يٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينٍ
40:23.en: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant

40:24.ar: اِلَيٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَامَٰنَ وَقَارُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابࣱۖ
40:24.en: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer

40:25.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِالْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُواْ اُ۟قْتُلُوٓاْ أَبْنَآءَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ وَاسْتَحْيُواْ نِسَآءَهُمْۖ وَمَا كَيْدُ اُ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَ إِلَّا فِے ضَلَٰلࣲۖ
40:25.en: And when he brought them the Truth from Our presence, they said: Slay the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women. But the plot of disbelievers is in naught but error

40:26.ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِےٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوس۪يٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ إِنِّيَ أَخَافُ أَنْ يُّبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ وَأَنْ يُّظْهِرَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ اِ۬لْفَسَادَۖ
40:26.en: And Pharaoh said: Suffer me to kill Moses, and let him cry unto his Lord. Lo! I fear that he will alter your religion or that he will cause confusion in the land

40:27.ar: وَقَالَ مُوس۪يٰٓ إِنِّے عُذْتُ بِرَبِّے وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرࣲ لَّا يُومِنُ بِيَوْمِ اِ۬لْحِسَابِۖ
40:27.en: Moses said: Lo! I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every scorner who believeth not in a Day of Reckoning

40:28.ar: وَقَالَ رَجُلࣱ مُّومِنࣱ مِّنَ اٰلِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلاً اَنْ يَّقُولَ رَبِّيَ اَ۬للَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِالْبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَإِنْ يَّكُ كَٰذِباࣰ فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ وَإِنْ يَّكُ صَادِقاࣰ يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ اُ۬لذِے يَعِدُكُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَا يَهْدِے مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفࣱ كَذَّابࣱۖ
40:28.en: And a believing man of Pharaoh's family, who hid his faith, said: Would ye kill a man because he saith: My Lord is Allah, and hath brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is lying, then his lie is upon him; and if he is truthful, then some of that wherewith he threateneth you will strike you. Lo! Allah guideth not one who is a prodigal, a liar

40:29.ar: يَٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ اُ۬لْمُلْكُ اُ۬لْيَوْمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ فَمَنْ يَّنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ اِ۬للَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَاۖ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمُۥٓ إِلَّا مَآ أَر۪يٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمُۥٓ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ اَ۬لرَّشَادِۖ
40:29.en: O my people! Yours is the kingdom to-day, ye being uppermost in the land. But who would save us from the wrath of Allah should it reach us? Pharaoh said: I do but show you what I think, and I do but guide you to wise policy

40:30.ar: ۞وَقَالَ اَ۬لذِےٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّيَ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ اِ۬لَاحْزَابِ
40:30.en: And he who believed said: O my people! Lo! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions (of old)

40:31.ar: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣲ وَثَمُودَ وَالذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْۖ وَمَا اَ۬للَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْماࣰ لِّلْعِبَادِۖ
40:31.en: A plight like that of Noah's folk, and A'ad and Thamud, and those after them, and Allah willeth no injustice for (His) slaves

40:32.ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّيَ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لتَّنَادِۦ
40:32.en: And, O my people! Lo! I fear for you a Day of Summoning

40:33.ar: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ مِنْ عَٰصِمࣲۖ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اِ۬للَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادࣲۖ
40:33.en: A day when ye will turn to flee, having no preserver from Allah: and he whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide

40:34.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِالْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِے شَكࣲّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَنْ يَّبْعَثَ اَ۬للَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولاࣰۖ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اُ۬للَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفࣱ مُّرْتَابٌۖ
