54:11.en: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water

54:12.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا اَ۬لَارْضَ عُيُوناࣰ فَالْتَقَي اَ۬لْمَآءُ عَلَيٰٓ أَمْرࣲ قَدْ قُدِرَۖ
54:12.en: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose

54:13.en: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails

54:14.ar: تَجْرِے بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءࣰ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَۖ
54:14.en: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected

54:15.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةࣰ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲۖ
54:15.en: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth

54:16.en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54:17.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲۖ
54:17.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54:18.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادࣱ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِے وَنُذُرِۦٓۖ
54:18.en: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54:19.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحاࣰ صَرْصَراࣰ فِے يَوْمِ نَحْسࣲ مُّسْتَمِرࣲّ‏
54:19.en: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity

54:20.ar: تَنزِعُ اُ۬لنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمُۥٓ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلࣲ مُّنقَعِرࣲۖ
54:20.en: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees

54:21.en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54:22.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲۖ
54:22.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54:24.ar: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَراࣰ مِّنَّا وَٰحِداࣰ نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذاࣰ لَّفِے ضَلَٰلࣲ وَسُعُرٍ
54:24.en: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness

54:25.ar: اَ۟لْقِيَ اَ۬لذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرࣱۖ
54:25.en: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar

54:26.en: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar

54:27.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُواْ اُ۬لنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةࣰ لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْۖ
54:27.en: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience

54:28.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمُۥٓ أَنَّ اَ۬لْمَآءَ قِسْمَةُۢ بَيْنَهُمْۖ كُلُّ شِرْبࣲ مُّحْتَضَرࣱۖ
54:28.en: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed

54:29.en: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her)

54:30.en: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings

54:31.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَكَانُواْ كَهَشِيمِ اِ۬لْمُحْتَظِرِۖ
54:31.en: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold

54:32.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲۖ
54:32.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54:33.en: The folk of Lot rejected warnings

54:34.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِباً اِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطࣲ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرࣲۖ
54:34.en: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night

54:35.ar: نِّعْمَةࣰ مِّنْ عِندِنَاۖ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِے مَن شَكَرَۖ
54:35.en: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks

54:36.en: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings

54:37.ar: ۞وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِے وَنُذُرِۦۖ
54:37.en: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings

54:38.en: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning

54:39.en: Now taste My punishment after My warnings

54:40.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲۖ
54:40.en: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth

54:41.en: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh

54:42.ar: كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمُۥٓ أَخْذَ عَزِيزࣲ مُّقْتَدِرٍۖ
54:42.en: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful

54:43.ar: اَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرࣱ مِّنُ ا۟وْلَٰٓئِكُمُۥٓ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةࣱ فِے اِ۬لزُّبُرِۖ
54:43.en: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures

54:44.en: Or say they: We are a host victorious

54:45.en: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee

54:46.ar: بَلِ اِ۬لسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْۖ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْه۪يٰ وَأَمَرُّۖ
54:46.en: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure)

54:47.en: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness

54:48.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِے اِ۬لنّ۪ارِ عَلَيٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُواْ مَسَّ سَقَرَۖ
54:48.en: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell

54:49.en: Lo! We have created every thing by measure

54:50.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةࣱ كَلَمْحِۢ بِالْبَصَرِۖ
54:50.en: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye

54:51.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرࣲۖ
54:51.en: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth

54:52.en: And every thing they did is in the scriptures

54:53.en: And every small and great thing is recorded

54:54.en: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers

54:55.ar: فِے مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكࣲ مُّقْتَدِرٍۖ
54:55.en: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King

55:5.en: The sun and the moon are made punctual

55:6.en: The stars and the trees prostrate

55:7.en: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure

55:8.en: That ye exceed not the measure

55:9.ar: وَأَقِيمُواْ اُ۬لْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُواْ اُ۬لْمِيزَانَۖ
55:9.en: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof

55:10.en: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures

55:11.en: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees

55:13.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:14.en: He created man of clay like the potter's

55:15.ar: وَخَلَقَ اَ۬لْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجࣲ مِّن نّ۪ارࣲۖ
55:15.en: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire

55:16.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:17.en: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests

55:18.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:19.en: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet

55:20.en: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other)

55:21.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:22.en: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone

55:23.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:24.ar: وَلَهُ اُ۬لْجَوَارِ اِ۬لْمُنشَأَٰتُ فِے اِ۬لْبَحْرِ كَالَاعْلَٰمِۖ
55:24.en: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners

55:25.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:26.en: Everyone that is thereon will pass away

55:27.ar: وَيَبْق۪يٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو اُ۬لْجَلَٰلِ وَالِاكْرَامِۖ
55:27.en: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory

55:28.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:29.ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِے شَأْنࣲۖ
55:29.en: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power

55:30.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:31.en: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn)

55:32.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:33.ar: يَٰمَعْشَرَ اَ۬لْجِنِّ وَالِانسِ إِنِ اِ۪سْتَطَعْتُمُۥٓ أَن تَنفُذُواْ مِنَ اَقْط۪ارِ اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ فَانفُذُواْۖ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنࣲۖ
55:33.en: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction

55:34.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:35.ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظࣱ مِّن نّ۪ارࣲ وَنُحَاسࣱ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَٰنِۖ
55:35.en: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape

55:36.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:37.ar: فَإِذَا اَ۪نشَقَّتِ اِ۬لسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةࣰ كَالدِّهَانِ
55:37.en: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide

55:38.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:39.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذࣲ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسࣱ وَلَا جَآنࣱّۖ
55:39.en: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin

55:40.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:41.en: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet

55:42.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:43.ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ اُ۬لتِے يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا اَ۬لْمُجْرِمُونَ
55:43.en: This is hell which the guilty deny

55:44.en: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water

55:45.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:46.en: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens

55:47.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:49.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:51.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:52.en: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs

55:53.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:54.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕينَ عَلَيٰ فُرُشِۢ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنِ اِسْتَبْرَقࣲ وَجَنَا اَ۬لْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانࣲۖ
55:54.en: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand

55:55.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:56.ar: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ اُ۬لطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنࣱّۖ
55:56.en: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them

55:57.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:58.en: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone

55:59.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:60.en: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness

55:61.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:62.en: And beside them are two other gardens

55:63.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:65.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:67.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:68.en: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate

55:69.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:70.en: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful

55:71.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:73.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:74.ar: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسࣱ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنࣱّۖ
55:74.en: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them

55:75.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:76.ar: مُتَّكِـِٕينَ عَلَيٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرࣲ وَعَبْقَرِيٍّ حِسَانࣲۖ
55:76.en: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets

55:77.en: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny

55:78.ar: تَبَٰرَكَ اَ۪سْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِے اِ۬لْجَلَٰلِ وَالِاكْرَامِۖ
55:78.en: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious

56:2.en: There is no denying that it will befall

56:4.en: When the earth is shaken with a shock

56:5.en: And the hills are ground to powder

56:6.en: So that they become a scattered dust

56:7.en: And ye will be three kinds

56:8.en: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand

56:9.en: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand

56:10.en: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race

56:11.en: Those are they who will be brought nigh

56:13.en: A multitude of those of old

56:14.en: And a few of those of later time

56:17.en: There wait on them immortal youths

56:18.en: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring

56:19.en: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness

56:21.en: And flesh of fowls that they desire

56:22.en: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes

56:24.en: Reward for what they used to do

56:25.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواࣰ وَلَا تَاثِيماًۖ
56:25.en: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination

56:26.en: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace

56:27.en: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand

56:33.en: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden

56:35.en: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation

56:38.en: For those on the right hand

56:39.en: A multitude of those of old

56:40.en: And a multitude of those of later time

56:41.en: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand

56:42.en: In scorching wind and scalding water

56:45.en: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury

56:46.en: And used to persist in the awful sin

56:47.ar: وَكَانُواْ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباࣰ وَعِظَٰماً اِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
56:47.en: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again

56:49.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time

56:50.en: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day

56:51.en: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers

56:52.en: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum

56:53.en: And will fill your bellies therewith

56:54.en: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water

56:55.en: Drinking even as the camel drinketh

56:56.en: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment

56:57.en: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth

56:58.en: Have ye seen that which ye emit

56:59.en: Do ye create it or are We the Creator

56:60.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ اُ۬لْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
56:60.en: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun

56:61.ar: عَلَيٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِے مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَۖ
56:61.en: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not

56:62.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ اُ۬لنَّشْأَةَ اَ۬لُاول۪يٰۖ فَلَوْلَا تَذَّكَّرُونَۖ
56:62.en: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect

56:63.en: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate

56:64.en: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer

56:65.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰماࣰ فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
56:65.en: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim

56:66.en: Lo! we are laden with debt

56:68.en: Have ye observed the water which ye drink

56:69.ar: ءَآنتُمُۥٓ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ اُ۬لْمُنزِلُونَۖ
56:69.en: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder

56:70.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَٰهُ أُجَاجاࣰۖ فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَۖ
56:70.en: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks

56:71.en: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out

56:72.ar: ءَآنتُمُۥٓ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ اُ۬لْمُنشِـُٔونَۖ
56:72.en: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower

56:73.en: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness

56:74.en: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous

56:75.en: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars

56:76.en: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew

56:77.en: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an

56:79.en: Which none toucheth save the purified

56:80.en: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds

56:81.en: Is it this Statement that ye scorn

56:82.en: And make denial thereof your livelihood

56:83.en: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)

56:84.en: And ye are at that moment looking

56:85.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
56:85.en: And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not

56:86.en: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us)

56:87.en: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful

56:88.en: Thus if he is of those brought nigh

56:89.en: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight

56:90.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ اَصْحَٰبِ اِ۬لْيَمِينِ
56:90.en: And if he is of those on the right hand

56:91.en: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand

56:92.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمُكَذِّبِينَ اَ۬لضَّآلِّينَ
56:92.en: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring

56:93.en: Then the welcome will be boiling water

56:96.en: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous

57:1.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلهِ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
57:1.en: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise

57:2.ar: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ يُحْيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرٌۖ
57:2.en: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things

57:3.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لَاوَّلُ وَالَاخِرُ وَالظَّٰهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عَلِيمٌۖ
57:3.en: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things

57:4.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ فِے سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ ثُمَّ اَ۪سْتَو۪يٰ عَلَي اَ۬لْعَرْشِۖ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ اَ۬لسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَاۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمُۥٓ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱۖ
57:4.en: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do

57:5.ar: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَإِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ تُرْجَعُ اُ۬لُامُورُۖ
57:5.en: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back

57:6.ar: يُولِجُ اُ۬ليْلَ فِے اِ۬لنَّه۪ارِ وَيُولِجُ اُ۬لنَّهَارَ فِے اِ۬ليْلِۖ وَهُوَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ اِ۬لصُّدُورِۖ
57:6.en: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts

57:7.ar: ۞ءَامِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِۖ فَالذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُواْ لَهُمُۥٓ أَجْرࣱ كَبِيرࣱۖ
57:7.en: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward

57:8.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُومِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُومِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدَ اَخَذَ مِيثَٰقَكُمُۥٓ إِن كُنتُم مُّومِنِينَۖ
57:8.en: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers

57:9.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِے يُنَزِّلُ عَلَيٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتِۢ بَيِّنَٰتࣲ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَي اَ۬لنُّورِۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
57:9.en: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful

57:10.ar: وَمَا لَكُمُۥٓ أَلَّا تُنفِقُواْ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَلِلهِ مِيرَٰثُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ لَا يَسْتَوِے مِنكُم مَّنَ اَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ اِ۬لْفَتْحِ وَقَٰتَلَۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لذِينَ أَنفَقُواْ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَٰتَلُواْۖ وَكُلّاࣰ وَعَدَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْحُسْن۪يٰۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱۖ
57:10.en: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do

57:11.ar: مَّن ذَا اَ۬لذِے يُقْرِضُ اُ۬للَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناࣰ فَيُضَٰعِفُهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرࣱ كَرِيمࣱۖ
57:11.en: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward

57:12.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَي اَ۬لْمُومِنِينَ وَالْمُومِنَٰتِ يَسْع۪يٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمۖ بُشْر۪يٰكُمُ اُ۬لْيَوْمَ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ اَ۬لْفَوْزُ اُ۬لْعَظِيمُۖ
57:12.en: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph

57:13.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ اُ۬لْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَالْمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اُ۟نظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ اَ۪رْجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَالْتَمِسُواْ نُوراࣰۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورࣲ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ اِ۬لرَّحْمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ اِ۬لْعَذَابُۖ
57:13.en: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom

57:14.ar: يُنَادُونَهُمُۥٓ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْۖ قَالُواْ بَل۪يٰ وَلَٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمُۥٓ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَارْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ اُ۬لَامَانِيُّ حَتَّيٰ جَآءَ امْرُ اُ۬للَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِاللَّهِ اِ۬لْغَرُورُۖ
57:14.en: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah

57:15.ar: فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُوخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةࣱ وَلَا مِنَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مَأْو۪يٰكُمُ اُ۬لنَّارُ هِيَ مَوْل۪يٰكُمْۖ وَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
57:15.en: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end

57:16.ar: ۞أَلَمْ يَانِ لِلذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ اَ۬لْحَقِّۖ وَلَا يَكُونُواْ كَالذِينَ أُوتُواْ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ اُ۬لَامَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَۖ
57:16.en: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers

57:17.ar: اَ۪عْلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُحْيِ اِ۬لَارْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاۖ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ اُ۬لَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَۖ
57:17.en: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand

57:18.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَالْمُصَّدِّقَٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناࣰ يُضَٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمُۥٓ أَجْرࣱ كَرِيمࣱۖ
57:18.en: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward

57:19.ar: وَالذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لصِّدِّيقُونَۖ وَالشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْۖ لَهُمُۥٓ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْۖ وَالذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لْجَحِيمِۖ
57:19.en: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire

57:20.ar: اِ۪عْلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا اَ۬لْحَيَوٰةُ اُ۬لدُّنْي۪ا لَعِبࣱ وَلَهْوࣱ وَزِينَةࣱ وَتَفَاخُرُۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرࣱ فِے اِ۬لَامْوَٰلِ وَالَاوْلَٰدِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ اَعْجَبَ اَ۬لْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَر۪يٰهُ مُصْفَرّاࣰ ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَٰماࣰۖ وَفِے اِ۬لَاخِرَةِ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدࣱ وَمَغْفِرَةࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنࣱۖ وَمَا اَ۬لْحَيَوٰةُ اُ۬لدُّنْي۪آ إِلَّا مَتَٰعُ اُ۬لْغُرُورِۖ
57:20.en: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion

57:21.ar: سَابِقُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ مَغْفِرَةࣲ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ اِ۬لسَّمَآءِ وَالَارْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦۖ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اُ۬للَّهِ يُوتِيهِ مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَاللَّهُ ذُو اُ۬لْفَضْلِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِۖ
57:21.en: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty

57:22.ar: ۞مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةࣲ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَلَا فِےٓ أَنفُسِكُمُۥٓ إِلَّا فِے كِتَٰبࣲ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ يَسِيرࣱ‏
57:22.en: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah

57:23.ar: لِّكَيْلَا تَاسَوْاْ عَلَيٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُواْ بِمَآ ءَات۪يٰكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالࣲ فَخُورٍۖ
57:23.en: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters

57:24.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَامُرُونَ اَ۬لنَّاسَ بِالْبُخْلِۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ اَ۬لْغَنِيُّ اُ۬لْحَمِيدُۖ
57:24.en: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

57:25.ar: لَقَدَ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِالْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبَ وَالْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ اَ۬لنَّاسُ بِالْقِسْطِۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا اَ۬لْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسࣱ شَدِيدࣱ وَمَنَٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِۖ وَلِيَعْلَمَ اَ۬للَّهُ مَنْ يَّنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِالْغَيْبِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزࣱۖ
57:25.en: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

57:26.ar: وَلَقَدَ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوحاࣰ وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِے ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا اَ۬لنُّبُوٓءَةَ وَالْكِتَٰبَۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدࣲۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَۖ
57:26.en: And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of them are evil-livers

57:27.ar: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَيٰٓ ءَاثٰ۪رِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَي اَ۪بْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ اُ۬لِانجِيلَۖ وَجَعَلْنَا فِے قُلُوبِ اِ۬لذِينَ اَ۪تَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةࣰ وَرَحْمَةࣰ وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً اِ۪بْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَٰهَا عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ إِلَّا اَ۪بْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَاۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنْهُمُۥٓ أَجْرَهُمْۖ وَكَثِيرࣱ مِّنْهُمْ فَٰسِقُونَۖ
57:27.en: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers

57:28.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اُ۪تَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَءَامِنُواْ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُوتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُوراࣰ تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱ‏
57:28.en: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah and put faith in His messenger. He will give you twofold of His mercy and will appoint for you a light wherein ye shall walk, and will forgive you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

57:29.ar: لِّيَ۬لَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَيٰ شَےْءࣲ مِّن فَضْلِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَأَنَّ اَ۬لْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اِ۬للَّهِ يُوتِيهِ مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَاللَّهُ ذُو اُ۬لْفَضْلِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِۖ
57:29.en: That the People of the Scripture may know that they control naught of the bounty of Allah, but that the bounty is in Allah's hand to give to whom He will. And Allah is of Infinite Bounty

58:1.ar: قَدْ سَمِعَ اَ۬للَّهُ قَوْلَ اَ۬لتِے تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِے زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِےٓ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ وَاللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌۖ
58:1.en: Allah hath heard the saying of her that disputeth with thee (Muhammad) concerning her husband, and complaineth unto Allah. And Allah heareth your colloquy. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Knower

58:2.ar: اِ۬لذِينَ يَظَّهَّرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمُۥٓۖ إِنُ ا۟مَّهَٰتُهُمُۥٓ إِلَّا اَ۬ل۪ےْ وَلَدْنَهُمْۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَراࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬لْقَوْلِ وَزُوراࣰۖ وَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورࣱۖ
58:2.en: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

58:3.ar: وَالذِينَ يَظَّهَّرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةࣲ مِّن قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّتَمَآسَّاۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱۖ
58:3.en: Those who put away their wives (by saying they are as their mothers) and afterward would go back on that which they have said, (the penalty) in that case (is) the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. Unto this ye are exhorted; and Allah is Informed of what ye do

58:4.ar: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّتَمَآسَّاۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناࣰۖ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُومِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۖ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اُ۬للَّهِۖ وَلِلْكٰ۪فِرِينَ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمٌۖ
58:4.en: And he who findeth not (the wherewithal), let him fast for two successive months before they touch one another; and for him who is unable to do so (the penance is) the feeding of sixty needy ones. This, that ye may put trust in Allah and His messenger. Such are the limits (imposed by Allah); and for disbelievers is a painful doom

58:5.ar: اِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ اَ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُواْ كَمَا كُبِتَ اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْۖ وَقَدَ اَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَٰتِۢ بَيِّنَٰتࣲۖ وَلِلْكٰ۪فِرِينَ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِينࣱۖ
58:5.en: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger will be abased even as those before them were abased; and We have sent down clear tokens, and for disbelievers is a shameful doom

58:6.ar: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ جَمِيعاࣰ فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۖ أَحْص۪يٰهُ اُ۬للَّهُ وَنَسُوهُۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ شَهِيدٌۖ
58:6.en: On the day when Allah will raise them all together and inform them of what they did. Allah hath kept account of it while they forgot it. And Allah is Witness over all things

58:7.ar: اَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْو۪يٰ ثَلَٰثَةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ اِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْن۪يٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمُۥٓ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُواْۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُواْ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عَلِيمٌۖ
58:7.en: Hast thou not seen that Allah knoweth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? There is no secret conference of three but He is their fourth, nor of five but He is their sixth, nor of less than that or more but He is with them wheresoever they may be; and afterward, on the Day of Resurrection, He will inform them of what they did. Lo! Allah is Knower of all things

58:8.ar: ۞اَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَي اَ۬لذِينَ نُهُواْ عَنِ اِ۬لنَّجْو۪يٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُواْ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَٰجَوْنَ بِالِاثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ اِ۬لرَّسُولِۖ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ اِ۬للَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِےٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا اَ۬للَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُۖ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُۖ يَصْلَوْنَهَاۖ فَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
58:8.en: Hast thou not observed those who were forbidden conspiracy and afterward returned to that which they had been forbidden, and (now) conspire together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger? And when they come unto thee they greet thee with a greeting wherewith Allah greeteth thee not, and say within themselves: Why should Allah punish us for what we say? Hell will suffice them; they will feel the heat thereof - a hapless journey's end

58:9.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا تَنَٰجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَٰجَوْاْ بِالِاثْمِ وَالْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ اِ۬لرَّسُولِۖ وَتَنَٰجَوْاْ بِالْبِرِّ وَالتَّقْو۪يٰۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ اَ۬لذِےٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَۖ
58:9.en: O ye who believe! When ye conspire together, conspire not together for crime and wrongdoing and disobedience toward the messenger, but conspire together for righteousness and piety, and keep your duty toward Allah, unto whom ye will be gathered

58:10.ar: إِنَّمَا اَ۬لنَّجْو۪يٰ مِنَ اَ۬لشَّيْطَٰنِ لِيُحْزِنَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَئْاً اِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ وعَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ اِ۬لْمُومِنُونَۖ
58:10.en: Lo! Conspiracy is only of the devil, that he may vex those who believe; but he can harm them not at all unless by Allah's leave. In Allah let believers put their trust

58:11.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُواْ فِے اِ۬لْمَجْلِسِ فَافْسَحُواْ يَفْسَحِ اِ۬للَّهُ لَكُمْۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ اَ۟نشُزُواْ فَانشُزُواْ يَرْفَعِ اِ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمْ وَالذِينَ أُوتُواْ اُ۬لْعِلْمَ دَرَجَٰتࣲۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱۖ
58:11.en: O ye who believe! when it is said unto you, Make room! in assemblies, then make room; Allah will make way for you (hereafter). And when it is said, Come up higher! go up higher; Allah will exalt those who believe among you, and those who have knowledge, to high ranks. Allah is Informed of what ye do

58:12.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَٰجَيْتُمُ اُ۬لرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُواْ بَيْنَ يَدَےْ نَجْو۪يٰكُمْ صَدَقَةࣰۖ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرࣱ لَّكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُۖ فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُواْ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌۖ
58:12.en: O ye who believe! When ye hold conference with the messenger, offer an alms before your conference. That is better and purer for you. But if ye cannot find (the wherewithal) then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

58:13.ar: آٰشْفَقْتُمُۥٓ أَن تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيْنَ يَدَےْ نَجْو۪يٰكُمْ صَدَقَٰتࣲۖ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُواْ وَتَابَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُواْ اُ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ اُ۬لزَّكَوٰةَۖ وَأَطِيعُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۖ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَۖ
58:13.en: Fear ye to offer alms before your conference? Then, when ye do it not and Allah hath forgiven you, establish worship and pay the poor-due and obey Allah and His messenger. And Allah is Aware of what ye do

58:14.ar: ۞أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَي اَ۬لذِينَ تَوَلَّوْاْ قَوْماً غَضِبَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَي اَ۬لْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَۖ
58:14.en: Hast thou not seen those who take for friends a folk with whom Allah is wroth? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear a false oath knowingly

58:15.ar: أَعَدَّ اَ۬للَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَاباࣰ شَدِيداًۖ اِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَۖ
58:15.en: Allah hath prepared for them a dreadful doom. Evil indeed is that which they are wont to do

58:16.ar: اَ۪تَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةࣰ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابࣱ مُّهِينࣱۖ
58:16.en: They make a shelter of their oaths and turn (men) from the way of Allah; so theirs will be a shameful doom

58:17.ar: لَّن تُغْنِيَ عَنْهُمُۥٓ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُهُم مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ شَئْاًۖ ا۟وْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لنّ۪ارِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَۖ
58:17.en: Their wealth and their children will avail them naught against Allah. Such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein

58:18.ar: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ جَمِيعاࣰ فَيَحْلِفُونَ لَهُۥ كَمَا يَحْلِفُونَ لَكُمْ وَيَحْسِبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ عَلَيٰ شَےْءٍۖ اَلَآ إِنَّهُمْ هُمُ اُ۬لْكَٰذِبُونَۖ
58:18.en: On the day when Allah will raise them all together, then will they swear unto Him as they (now) swear unto you, and they will fancy that they have some standing. Lo! is it not they who are the liars

58:19.ar: اَ۪سْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِمُ اُ۬لشَّيْطَٰنُ فَأَنس۪يٰهُمْ ذِكْرَ اَ۬للَّهِۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اُ۬لشَّيْطَٰنِۖ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ اَ۬لشَّيْطَٰنِ هُمُ اُ۬لْخَٰسِرُونَۖ
58:19.en: The devil hath engrossed them and so hath caused them to forget remembrance of Allah. They are the devil's party. Lo! is it not the devil's party who will be the losers

58:20.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ اَ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ فِے اِ۬لَاذَلِّينَۖ
58:20.en: Lo! those who oppose Allah and His messenger, they will be among the lowest

58:21.ar: كَتَبَ اَ۬للَّهُ لَأَغْلِبَنَّ أَنَا وَرُسُلِيَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ قَوِيٌّ عَزِيزࣱۖ
58:21.en: Allah hath decreed: Lo! I verily shall conquer, I and My messengers. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty

58:22.ar: لَّا تَجِدُ قَوْماࣰ يُومِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ اِ۬لَاخِرِ يُوَآدُّونَ مَنْ حَآدَّ اَ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَانُوٓاْ ءَابَآءَهُمُۥٓ أَوَ اَبْنَآءَهُمُۥٓ أَوِ اِخْوَٰنَهُمُۥٓ أَوْ عَشِيرَتَهُمُۥٓۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ كَتَبَ فِے قُلُوبِهِمُ اُ۬لِايمَٰنَ وَأَيَّدَهُم بِرُوحࣲ مِّنْهُ وَيُدْخِلُهُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ رَضِيَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُواْ عَنْهُۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ حِزْبُ اُ۬للَّهِۖ أَلَآ إِنَّ حِزْبَ اَ۬للَّهِ هُمُ اُ۬لْمُفْلِحُونَۖ
58:22.en: Thou wilt not find folk who believe in Allah and the Last Day loving those who oppose Allah and His messenger, even though they be their fathers or their sons or their brethren or their clan. As for such, He hath written faith upon their hearts and hath strengthened them with a Spirit from Him, and He will bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide. Allah is well pleased with them, and they are well pleased with Him. They are Allah's party. Lo! is it not Allah's party who are the successful

59:1.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلهِ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
59:1.en: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

59:2.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَخْرَجَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ اَهْلِ اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ مِن دِيٰ۪رِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ اِ۬لْحَشْرِۖ مَا ظَنَنتُمُۥٓ أَنْ يَّخْرُجُواْۖ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَنَّهُم مَّانِعَتُهُمْ حُصُونُهُم مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِۖ فَأَت۪يٰهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَمْ يَحْتَسِبُواْۖ ۞وَقَذَفَ فِے قُلُوبِهِمُ اُ۬لرُّعْبَۖ يُخْرِبُونَ بُيُوتَهُم بِأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَيْدِے اِ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ فَاعْتَبِرُواْ يَٰٓأُوْلِے اِ۬لَابْصٰ۪رِۖ
59:2.en: He it is Who hath caused those of the People of the Scripture who disbelieved to go forth from their homes unto the first exile. Ye deemed not that they would go forth, while they deemed that their strongholds would protect them from Allah. But Allah reached them from a place whereof they recked not, and cast terror in their hearts so that they ruined their houses with their own hands and the hands of the believers. So learn a lesson, O ye who have eyes

59:3.ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن كَتَبَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِمُ اُ۬لْجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمْ فِے اِ۬لدُّنْي۪اۖ وَلَهُمْ فِے اِ۬لَاخِرَةِ عَذَابُ اُ۬لنّ۪ارِۖ
59:3.en: And if Allah had not decreed migration for them, He verily would have punished them in the world, and theirs in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire

59:4.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَآقُّواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۖ وَمَنْ يُّشَآقِّ اِ۬للَّهَ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ شَدِيدُ اُ۬لْعِقَابِۖ
59:4.en: That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal

59:5.ar: مَا قَطَعْتُم مِّن لِّينَةٍ اَوْ تَرَكْتُمُوهَا قَآئِمَةً عَلَيٰٓ أُصُولِهَا فَبِإِذْنِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَلِيُخْزِيَ اَ۬لْفَٰسِقِينَۖ
59:5.en: Whatsoever palm-trees ye cut down or left standing on their roots, it was by Allah's leave, in order that He might confound the evil-livers

59:6.ar: وَمَآ أَفَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلࣲ وَلَا رِكَابࣲۖ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُسَلِّطُ رُسُلَهُۥ عَلَيٰ مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرࣱۖ
59:6.en: And that which Allah gave as spoil unto His messenger from them, ye urged not any horse or riding-camel for the sake thereof, but Allah giveth His messenger lordship over whom He will. Allah is Able to do all things

59:7.ar: مَّآ أَفَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيٰ رَسُولِهِۦ مِنَ اَهْلِ اِ۬لْقُر۪يٰ فَلِلهِ وَلِلرَّسُولِ وَلِذِے اِ۬لْقُرْب۪يٰ وَالْيَتَٰم۪يٰ وَالْمَسَٰكِينِ وَابْنِ اِ۬لسَّبِيلِ كَےْ لَا يَكُونَ دُولَةَۢ بَيْنَ اَ۬لَاغْنِيَآءِ مِنكُمْۖ وَمَآ ءَات۪يٰكُمُ اُ۬لرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُۖ وَمَا نَه۪يٰكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانتَهُواْۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ شَدِيدُ اُ۬لْعِقَابِۖ
59:7.en: That which Allah giveth as spoil unto His messenger from the people of the townships, it is for Allah and His messenger and for the near of kin and the orphans and the needy and the wayfarer, that it become not a commodity between the rich among you. And whatsoever the messenger giveth you, take it. And whatsoever he forbiddeth, abstain (from it). And keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is stern in reprisal

59:8.ar: لِلْفُقَرَآءِ اِ۬لْمُهَٰجِرِينَ اَ۬لذِينَ أُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيٰ۪رِهِمْ وَأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلاࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰناࣰ وَيَنصُرُونَ اَ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥٓۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لصَّٰدِقُونَۖ
59:8.en: And (it is) for the poor fugitives who have been driven out from their homes and their belongings, who seek bounty from Allah and help Allah and His messenger. They are the loyal

59:9.ar: وَالذِينَ تَبَوَّءُو اُ۬لدَّارَ وَالِايمَٰنَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ يُحِبُّونَ مَنْ هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَا يَجِدُونَ فِے صُدُورِهِمْ حَاجَةࣰ مِّمَّآ أُوتُواْ وَيُوثِرُونَ عَلَيٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةࣱۖ وَمَنْ يُّوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْمُفْلِحُونَۖ
59:9.en: Those who entered the city and the faith before them love those who flee unto them for refuge, and find in their breasts no need for that which hath been given them, but prefer (the fugitives) above themselves though poverty become their lot. And whoso is saved from his own avarice - such are they who are successful

59:10.ar: وَالذِينَ جَآءُو مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا اَ۪غْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَٰنِنَا اَ۬لذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالِايمَٰنِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِے قُلُوبِنَا غِلّاࣰ لِّلذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۖ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ رَءُوفࣱ رَّحِيمٌۖ
59:10.en: And those who came (into the faith) after them say: Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who were before us in the faith, and place not in our hearts any rancour toward those who believe. Our Lord! Thou art Full of Pity, Merciful

59:11.ar: ۞اَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَي اَ۬لذِينَ نَافَقُواْ يَقُولُونَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ اَهْلِ اِ۬لْكِتَٰبِ لَئِنُ ا۟خْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ وَلَا نُطِيعُ فِيكُمُۥٓ أَحَداً اَبَداࣰ وَإِن قُوتِلْتُمْ لَنَنصُرَنَّكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَۖ
59:11.en: Hast thou not observed those who are hypocrites, (how) they tell their brethren who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture: If ye are driven out, we surely will go out with you, and we will never obey anyone against you, and if ye are attacked we verily will help you. And Allah beareth witness that they verily are liars

59:12.ar: لَئِنُ ا۟خْرِجُواْ لَا يَخْرُجُونَ مَعَهُمْۖ وَلَئِن قُوتِلُواْ لَا يَنصُرُونَهُمْۖ وَلَئِن نَّصَرُوهُمْ لَيُوَلُّنَّ اَ۬لَادْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَۖ
59:12.en: (For) indeed if they are driven out they go not out with them, and indeed if they are attacked they help them not, and indeed if they had helped them they would have turned and fled, and then they would not have been victorious

59:13.ar: لَأَنتُمُۥٓ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةࣰ فِے صُدُورِهِم مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِۖ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمࣱ لَّا يَفْقَهُونَۖ
59:13.en: Ye are more awful as a fear in their bosoms than Allah. That is because they are a folk who understand not

59:14.ar: لَا يُقَٰتِلُونَكُمْ جَمِيعاً اِلَّا فِے قُريࣰ مُّحَصَّنَةٍ اَوْ مِنْ وَّرَآءِ جُدُرِۢۖ بَأْسُهُم بَيْنَهُمْ شَدِيدࣱۖ تَحْسِبُهُمْ جَمِيعاࣰ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ شَتّ۪يٰۖ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَوْمࣱ لَّا يَعْقِلُونَۖ
59:14.en: They will not fight against you in a body save in fortified villages or from behind walls. Their adversity among themselves is very great. Ye think of them as a whole whereas their hearts are divers. That is because they are a folk who have no sense

59:15.ar: كَمَثَلِ اِ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ قَرِيباࣰۖ ذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمࣱۖ
59:15.en: On the likeness of those (who suffered) a short time before them, they taste the ill-effects of their own conduct, and theirs is painful punishment

59:16.ar: كَمَثَلِ اِ۬لشَّيْطَٰنِ إِذْ قَالَ لِلِانسَٰنِ اِ۟كْفُرْ فَلَمَّا كَفَرَ قَالَ إِنِّے بَرِےٓءࣱ مِّنكَ إِنِّيَ أَخَافُ اُ۬للَّهَ رَبَّ اَ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
59:16.en: (And the hypocrites are) on the likeness of the devil when he telleth man to disbelieve, then, when he disbelieveth saith: Lo! I am quit of thee. Lo! I fear Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

59:17.ar: فَكَانَ عَٰقِبَتَهُمَآ أَنَّهُمَا فِے اِ۬لنّ۪ارِ خَالِدَيْنِ فِيهَاۖ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَٰٓؤُاْ اُ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
59:17.en: And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers

59:18.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اُ۪تَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسࣱ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدࣲۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَۖ
59:18.en: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah. And let every soul look to that which it sendeth on before for the morrow. And observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do

59:19.ar: وَلَا تَكُونُواْ كَالذِينَ نَسُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ فَأَنس۪يٰهُمُۥٓ أَنفُسَهُمُۥٓۖ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْفَٰسِقُونَۖ
59:19.en: And be not ye as those who forgot Allah, therefor He caused them to forget their souls. Such are the evil-doers

59:20.ar: لَا يَسْتَوِےٓ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لنّ۪ارِ وَأَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لْجَنَّةِۖ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لْجَنَّةِ هُمُ اُ۬لْفَآئِزُونَۖ
59:20.en: Not equal are the owners of the Fire and the owners of the Garden. The owners of the Garden, they are the victorious

59:21.ar: لَوَ اَنزَلْنَا هَٰذَا اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ عَلَيٰ جَبَلࣲ لَّرَأَيْتَهُۥ خَٰشِعاࣰ مُّتَصَدِّعاࣰ مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ وَتِلْكَ اَ۬لَامْثَٰلُ نَضْرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَۖ
59:21.en: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect

59:22.ar: هُوَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِے لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَٰلِمُ اُ۬لْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَٰدَةِۖ هُوَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ اُ۬لرَّحِيمُۖ
59:22.en: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible. He is the Beneficent, Merciful

59:23.ar: هُوَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِے لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ اَ۬لْمَلِكُ اُ۬لْقُدُّوسُ اُ۬لسَّلَٰمُ اُ۬لْمُومِنُ اُ۬لْمُهَيْمِنُ اُ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْجَبَّارُ اُ۬لْمُتَكَبِّرُۖ سُبْحَٰنَ اَ۬للَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَۖ
59:23.en: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)

59:24.ar: هُوَ اَ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لْخَٰلِقُ اُ۬لْبَارِۓُ اُ۬لْمُصَوِّرُۖ لَهُ اُ۬لَاسْمَآءُ اُ۬لْحُسْن۪يٰۖ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
59:24.en: He is Allah, the Creator, the Shaper out of naught, the Fashioner. His are the most beautiful names. All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

60:1.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَّخِذُواْ عَدُوِّے وَعَدُوَّكُمُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءَۖ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ كَفَرُواْ بِمَا جَآءَكُم مِّنَ اَ۬لْحَقِّۖ يُخْرِجُونَ اَ۬لرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمُۥٓ أَن تُومِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمُۥٓۖ إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَٰداࣰ فِے سَبِيلِے وَابْتِغَآءَ مَرْضَاتِے تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِم بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَآ أَعْلَمُ بِمَآ أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَآ أَعْلَنتُمْۖ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْهُ مِنكُمْ فَقَد ضَّلَّ سَوَآءَ اَ۬لسَّبِيلِۖ
60:1.en: O ye who believe! Choose not My enemy and your enemy for allies. Do ye give them friendship when they disbelieve in that truth which hath come unto you, driving out the messenger and you because ye believe in Allah, your Lord? If ye have come forth to strive in My way and seeking My good pleasure, (show them not friendship). Do ye show friendship unto them in secret, when I am Best Aware of what ye hide and what ye proclaim? And whosoever doeth it among you, he verily hath strayed from the right way

60:2.ar: إِنْ يَّثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُواْ لَكُمُۥٓ أَعْدَآءࣰ وَيَبْسُطُوٓاْ إِلَيْكُمُۥٓ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُم بِالسُّوٓءِۖ وَوَدُّواْ لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَۖ
60:2.en: If they have the upper hand of you, they will be your foes, and will stretch out their hands and their tongues toward you with evil (intent), and they long for you to disbelieve

60:3.ar: لَن تَنفَعَكُمُۥٓ أَرْحَامُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُمْۖ يَوْمَ اَ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ يُفْصَلُ بَيْنَكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرࣱۖ
60:3.en: Your ties of kindred and your children will avail you naught upon the Day of Resurrection. He will part you. Allah is Seer of what ye do

60:4.ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ لَكُمُۥٓ إِسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ فِےٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَالذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِذْ قَالُواْ لِقَوْمِهِمُۥٓ إِنَّا بُرَءَٰٓؤُاْ مِنكُمْ وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ كَفَرْنَا بِكُمْ وَبَدَا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمُ اُ۬لْعَدَٰوَةُ وَالْبَغْضَآءُ اَ۬بَداً حَتَّيٰ تُومِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ وَمَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اَ۬للَّهِ مِن شَےْءࣲۖ رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
60:4.en: There is a goodly pattern for you in Abraham and those with him, when they told their folk: Lo! we are guiltless of you and all that ye worship beside Allah. We have done with you. And there hath arisen between us and you hostility and hate for ever until ye believe in Allah only - save that which Abraham promised his father (when he said): I will ask forgiveness for thee, though I own nothing for thee from Allah - Our Lord! In Thee we put our trust, and unto Thee we turn repentant, and unto Thee is the journeying

60:5.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةࣰ لِّلذِينَ كَفَرُواْۖ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
60:5.en: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise

60:6.ar: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمُۥٓ إِسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةࣱ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَالْيَوْمَ اَ۬لَاخِرَۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ اَ۬لْغَنِيُّ اُ۬لْحَمِيدُۖ
60:6.en: Verily ye have in them a goodly pattern for everyone who looketh to Allah and the Last Day. And whosoever may turn away, lo! still Allah, He is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise

60:7.ar: ۞عَسَي اَ۬للَّهُ أَنْ يَّجْعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ اَ۬لذِينَ عَادَيْتُم مِّنْهُم مَّوَدَّةࣰۖ وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرࣱۖ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
60:7.en: It may be that Allah will ordain love between you and those of them with whom ye are at enmity. Allah is Mighty, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

60:8.ar: لَّا يَنْه۪يٰكُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ عَنِ اِ۬لذِينَ لَمْ يُقَٰتِلُوكُمْ فِے اِ۬لدِّينِ وَلَمْ يُخْرِجُوكُم مِّن دِيٰ۪رِكُمُۥٓ أَن تَبَرُّوهُمْ وَتُقْسِطُوٓاْ إِلَيْهِمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُحِبُّ اُ۬لْمُقْسِطِينَۖ
60:8.en: Allah forbiddeth you not those who warred not against you on account of religion and drove you not out from your homes, that ye should show them kindness and deal justly with them. Lo! Allah loveth the just dealers

60:9.ar: إِنَّمَا يَنْه۪يٰكُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ عَنِ اِ۬لذِينَ قَٰتَلُوكُمْ فِے اِ۬لدِّينِ وَأَخْرَجُوكُم مِّن دِيٰ۪رِكُمْ وَظَٰهَرُواْ عَلَيٰٓ إِخْرَاجِكُمُۥٓ أَن تَوَلَّوْهُمْۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَوَلَّهُمْ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لظَّٰلِمُونَۖ
60:9.en: Allah forbiddeth you only those who warred against you on account of religion and have driven you out from your homes and helped to drive you out, that ye make friends of them. Whosoever maketh friends of them - (All) such are wrong-doers

60:10.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا جَآءَكُمُ اُ۬لْمُومِنَٰتُ مُهَٰجِرَٰتࣲ فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّۖ اَ۬للَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمَٰنِهِنَّۖ فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُومِنَٰتࣲ فَلَا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَي اَ۬لْكُفّ۪ارِۖ لَا هُنَّ حِلࣱّ لَّهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّۖ وَءَاتُوهُم مَّآ أَنفَقُواْۖ وَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمُۥٓ أَن تَنكِحُوهُنَّ إِذَآ ءَاتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّۖ وَلَا تُمْسِكُواْ بِعِصَمِ اِ۬لْكَوَافِرِۖ وَسْـَٔلُواْ مَآ أَنفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْـَٔلُواْ مَآ أَنفَقُواْۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اُ۬للَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمࣱۖ
60:10.en: O ye who believe! When believing women come unto you as fugitives, examine them. Allah is Best Aware of their faith. Then, if ye know them for true believers, send them not back unto the disbelievers. They are not lawful for them (the disbelievers), nor are they (the disbelievers) lawful for them. And give them (the disbelievers) that which they have spent (upon them). And it is no sin for you to marry such women when ye have given them their dues. And hold not to the ties of disbelieving women; and ask for (the return of) that which ye have spent; and let them (the disbelievers) ask for that which they have spent. That is the judgment of Allah. He judgeth between you. Allah is Knower, Wise

60:11.ar: وَإِن فَاتَكُمْ شَےْءࣱ مِّنَ اَزْوَٰجِكُمُۥٓ إِلَي اَ۬لْكُفّ۪ارِ فَعَاقَبْتُمْ فَـَٔاتُواْ اُ۬لذِينَ ذَهَبَتَ اَزْوَٰجُهُم مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنفَقُواْۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَنتُم بِهِۦ مُومِنُونَۖ
60:11.en: And if any of your wives have gone from you unto the disbelievers and afterward ye have your turn (of triumph), then give unto those whose wives have gone the like of that which they have spent, and keep your duty to Allah in Whom ye are believers

60:12.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا‏ اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءُ اِ۪ذَا جَآءَكَ اَ۬لْمُومِنَٰتُ يُبَايِعْنَكَ عَلَيٰٓ أَن لَّا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَئْاࣰ وَلَا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلَا يَزْنِينَ وَلَا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلَٰدَهُنَّ وَلَا يَاتِينَ بِبُهْتَٰنࣲ يَفْتَرِينَهُۥ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلَا يَعْصِينَكَ فِے مَعْرُوفࣲ فَبَايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اَ۬للَّهَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
60:12.en: O Prophet! If believing women come unto thee, taking oath of allegiance unto thee that they will ascribe no thing as partner unto Allah, and will neither steal nor commit adultery nor kill their children, nor produce any lie that they have devised between their hands and feet, nor disobey thee in what is right, then accept their allegiance and ask Allah to forgive them. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

60:13.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تَتَوَلَّوْاْ قَوْماً غَضِبَ اَ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَدْ يَئِسُواْ مِنَ اَ۬لَاخِرَةِ كَمَا يَئِسَ اَ۬لْكُفَّارُ مِنَ اَصْحَٰبِ اِ۬لْقُبُورِۖ
60:13.en: O ye who believe! Be not friendly with a folk with whom Allah is wroth, (a folk) who have despaired of the Hereafter as the disbelievers despair of those who are in the graves

61:1.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلهِ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
61:1.en: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, and He is the Mighty, the Wise

61:2.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَۖ
61:2.en: O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not

61:3.ar: كَبُرَ مَقْتاً عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ أَن تَقُولُواْ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَۖ
61:3.en: It is most hateful in the sight of Allah that ye say that which ye do not

61:4.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُحِبُّ اُ۬لذِينَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِے سَبِيلِهِۦ صَفّاࣰ كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَٰنࣱ مَّرْصُوصࣱۖ
61:4.en: Lo! Allah loveth them who battle for His cause in ranks, as if they were a solid structure

61:5.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوس۪يٰ لِقَوْمِهِۦ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تُوذُونَنِے وَقَد تَّعْلَمُونَ أَنِّے رَسُولُ اُ۬للَّهِ إِلَيْكُمْۖ فَلَمَّا زَاغُوٓاْ أَزَاغَ اَ۬للَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِے اِ۬لْقَوْمَ اَ۬لْفَٰسِقِينَۖ
61:5.en: And (remember) when Moses said unto his people: O my people! Why persecute ye me, when ye well know that I am Allah's messenger unto you? So when they went astray Allah sent their hearts astray. And Allah guideth not the evil-living folk

61:6.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَي اَ۪بْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَٰبَنِےٓ إِسْرَآءِيلَ إِنِّے رَسُولُ اُ۬للَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقاࣰ لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ اَ۬لتَّوْر۪يٰةِ وَمُبَشِّراَۢ بِرَسُولࣲ يَاتِے مِنۢ بَعْدِيَ اَ۪سْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِالْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحْرࣱ مُّبِينࣱۖ
61:6.en: And when Jesus son of Mary said: O Children of Israel! Lo! I am the messenger of Allah unto you, confirming that which was (revealed) before me in the Torah, and bringing good tidings of a messenger who cometh after me, whose name is the Praised One. Yet when he hath come unto them with clear proofs, they say: This is mere magic

61:7.ar: وَمَنَ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنِ اِ۪فْتَر۪يٰ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ اِ۬لْكَذِبَ وَهُوَ يُدْع۪يٰٓ إِلَي اَ۬لِاسْلَٰمِۖ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِے اِ۬لْقَوْمَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
61:7.en: And who doeth greater wrong than he who inventeth a lie against Allah when he is summoned unto Al-Islam? And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk

61:8.ar: يُرِيدُونَ لِيُطْفِـُٔواْ نُورَ اَ۬للَّهِ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَاللَّهُ مُتِمࣱّ نُّورَهُۥ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ اَ۬لْكَٰفِرُونَۖ
61:8.en: Fain would they put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will perfect His light however much the disbelievers are averse

61:9.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِالْهُد۪يٰ وَدِينِ اِ۬لْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَي اَ۬لدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ اَ۬لْمُشْرِكُونَۖ
61:9.en: He it is Who hath sent His messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, that He may make it conqueror of all religion however much idolaters may be averse

61:10.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ هَلَ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَيٰ تِجَٰرَةࣲ تُنجِيكُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمࣲ‏
61:10.en: O ye who believe! Shall I show you a commerce that will save you from a painful doom

61:11.ar: تُومِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُجَٰهِدُونَ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِ بِأَمْوَٰلِكُمْ وَأَنفُسِكُمْ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرࣱ لَّكُمُۥٓ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
61:11.en: Ye should believe in Allah and His messenger, and should strive for the cause of Allah with your wealth and your lives. That is better for you, if ye did but know

61:12.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ وَيُدْخِلْكُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةࣰ فِے جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنࣲۖ ذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْفَوْزُ اُ۬لْعَظِيمُۖ
61:12.en: He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph

61:13.ar: وَأُخْر۪يٰ تُحِبُّونَهَا نَصْرࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ وَفَتْحࣱ قَرِيبࣱۖ وَبَشِّرِ اِ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ
61:13.en: And (He will give you) another (blessing) which ye love: help from Allah and present victory. Give good tidings (O Muhammad) to believers

61:14.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ كُونُوٓاْ أَنصَاراࣰ لِّلهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَي اَ۪بْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنَ اَنصَارِيَ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِۖ قَالَ اَ۬لْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ اُ۬للَّهِۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةࣱ مِّنۢ بَنِےٓ إِسْرَآءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةࣱۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ عَلَيٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُواْ ظَٰهِرِينَۖ
61:14.en: O ye who believe! Be Allah's helpers, even as Jesus son of Mary said unto the disciples: Who are my helpers for Allah? They said: We are Allah's helpers. And a party of the Children of Israel believed, while a party disbelieved. Then We strengthened those who believed against their foe, and they became the uppermost

62:1.ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلهِ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ اِ۬لْمَلِكِ اِ۬لْقُدُّوسِ اِ۬لْعَزِيزِ اِ۬لْحَكِيمِۖ
62:1.en: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, the Mighty, the Wise

62:2.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِے بَعَثَ فِے اِ۬لُامِّيِّـۧنَ رَسُولاࣰ مِّنْهُمْ يَتْلُواْ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِے ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
62:2.en: He it is Who hath sent among the unlettered ones a messenger of their own, to recite unto them His revelations and to make them grow, and to teach them the Scripture and wisdom, though heretofore they were indeed in error manifest

62:3.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُواْ بِهِمْۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
62:3.en: Along with others of them who have not yet joined them. He is the Mighty, the Wise

62:4.ar: ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ اُ۬للَّهِ يُوتِيهِ مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَاللَّهُ ذُو اُ۬لْفَضْلِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِۖ
62:4.en: That is the bounty of Allah; which He giveth unto whom He will. Allah is of Infinite Bounty

62:5.ar: مَثَلُ اُ۬لذِينَ حُمِّلُواْ اُ۬لتَّوْر۪يٰةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا كَمَثَلِ اِ۬لْحِم۪ارِ يَحْمِلُ أَسْفَاراَۢۖ بِيسَ مَثَلُ اُ۬لْقَوْمِ اِ۬لذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ وَاللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِے اِ۬لْقَوْمَ اَ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
62:5.en: The likeness of those who are entrusted with the Law of Moses, yet apply it not, is as the likeness of the ass carrying books. Wretched is the likeness of folk who deny the revelations of Allah. And Allah guideth not wrongdoing folk

62:6.ar: قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ هَادُوٓاْ إِن زَعَمْتُمُۥٓ أَنَّكُمُۥٓ أَوْلِيَآءُ لِلهِ مِن دُونِ اِ۬لنَّاسِ فَتَمَنَّوُاْ اُ۬لْمَوْتَ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَۖ
62:6.en: Say (O Muhammad): O ye who are Jews! If ye claim that ye are favoured of Allah apart from (all) mankind, then long for death if ye are truthful

62:7.ar: وَلَا يَتَمَنَّوْنَهُۥٓ أَبَداَۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتَ اَيْدِيهِمْۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِالظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
62:7.en: But they will never long for it because of all that their own hands have sent before, and Allah is Aware of evil-doers

62:8.ar: قُلِ اِنَّ اَ۬لْمَوْتَ اَ۬لذِے تَفِرُّونَ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مُلَٰقِيكُمْ ثُمَّ تُرَدُّونَ إِلَيٰ عَٰلِمِ اِ۬لْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَٰدَةِ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَۖ
62:8.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! the death from which ye shrink will surely meet you, and afterward ye will be returned unto the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, and He will tell you what ye used to do

62:9.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَوٰةِ مِنْ يَّوْمِ اِ۬لْجُمُعَةِ فَاسْعَوِاْ اِلَيٰ ذِكْرِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَذَرُواْ اُ۬لْبَيْعَۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرࣱ لَّكُمُۥٓ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَۖ
62:9.en: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know

62:10.ar: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ اِ۬لصَّلَوٰةُ فَانتَشِرُواْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَابْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَاذْكُرُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ كَثِيراࣰ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَۖ
62:10.en: And when the prayer is ended, then disperse in the land and seek of Allah's bounty, and remember Allah much, that ye may be successful

62:11.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْاْ تِجَٰرَةً اَوْ لَهْواً اِ۪نفَضُّوٓاْ إِلَيْهَا وَتَرَكُوكَ قَآئِماࣰۖ قُلْ مَا عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهْوِ وَمِنَ اَ۬لتِّجَٰرَةِۖ وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ اُ۬لرَّٰزِقِينَۖ
62:11.en: But when they spy some merchandise or pastime they break away to it and leave thee standing. Say: That which Allah hath is better than pastime and than merchandise, and Allah is the Best of providers

63:1.ar: إِذَا جَآءَكَ اَ۬لْمُنَٰفِقُونَ قَالُواْ نَشْهَدُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُ اُ۬للَّهِۖ وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ إِنَّكَ لَرَسُولُهُۥۖ وَاللَّهُ يَشْهَدُ إِنَّ اَ۬لْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَكَٰذِبُونَۖ
63:1.en: When the hypocrites come unto thee (O Muhammad), they say: We bear witness that thou art indeed Allah's messenger. And Allah knoweth that thou art indeed His messenger, and Allah beareth witness that the hypocrites indeed are speaking falsely

63:2.ar: اَ۪تَّخَذُوٓاْ أَيْمَٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةࣰ فَصَدُّواْ عَن سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَۖ
63:2.en: They make their faith a pretext so that they may turn (men) from the way of Allah. Verily evil is that which they are wont to do

63:3.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُۥٓ ءَامَنُواْ ثُمَّ كَفَرُواْ فَطُبِعَ عَلَيٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يَفْقَهُونَۖ
63:3.en: That is because they believed, then disbelieved, therefore their hearts are sealed so that they understand not

63:4.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ تُعْجِبُكَ أَجْسَامُهُمْۖ وَإِنْ يَّقُولُواْ تَسْمَعْ لِقَوْلِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ خُشُبࣱ مُّسَنَّدَةࣱۖ يَحْسِبُونَ كُلَّ صَيْحَةٍ عَلَيْهِمْۖ هُمُ اُ۬لْعَدُوُّۖ فَاحْذَرْهُمْۖ قَٰتَلَهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُۖ أَنّ۪يٰ يُوفَكُونَۖ
63:4.en: And when thou seest them their figures please thee; and if they speak thou givest ear unto their speech. (They are) as though they were blocks of wood in striped cloaks. They deem every shout to be against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. Allah confound them! How they are perverted

63:5.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْاْ يَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ رَسُولُ اُ۬للَّهِ لَوَوْاْ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَرَأَيْتَهُمْ يَصُدُّونَ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَۖ
63:5.en: And when it is said unto them: Come! The messenger of Allah will ask forgiveness for you! they avert their faces and thou seest them turning away, disdainful

63:6.ar: سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمُۥٓ أَسْتَغْفَرْتَ لَهُمُۥٓ أَمْ لَمْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْۖ لَنْ يَّغْفِرَ اَ۬للَّهُ لَهُمُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ لَا يَهْدِے اِ۬لْقَوْمَ اَ۬لْفَٰسِقِينَۖ
63:6.en: Whether thou ask forgiveness for them or ask not forgiveness for them is all one for them; Allah will not forgive them. Lo! Allah guideth not the evil-living folk

63:7.ar: هُمُ اُ۬لذِينَ يَقُولُونَ لَا تُنفِقُواْ عَلَيٰ مَنْ عِندَ رَسُولِ اِ۬للَّهِ حَتَّيٰ يَنفَضُّواْۖ وَلِلهِ خَزَآئِنُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَ۬لْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَفْقَهُونَۖ
63:7.en: They it is who say: Spend not on behalf of those (who dwell) with Allah's messenger that they may disperse (and go away from you); when Allah's are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the hypocrites comprehend not

63:8.ar: يَقُولُونَ لَئِن رَّجَعْنَآ إِلَي اَ۬لْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ اَ۬لَاعَزُّ مِنْهَا اَ۬لَاذَلَّۖ وَلِلهِ اِ۬لْعِزَّةُ وَلِرَسُولِهِۦ وَلِلْمُومِنِينَۖ وَلَٰكِنَّ اَ۬لْمُنَٰفِقِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَۖ
63:8.en: They say: Surely, if we return to Al-Madinah the mightier will soon drive out the weaker; when might belongeth to Allah and to His messenger and to the believers; but the hypocrites know not

63:9.ar: ۞يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ لَا تُلْهِكُمُۥٓ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَٰدُكُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْخَٰسِرُونَۖ
63:9.en: O ye who believe! Let not your wealth nor your children distract you from remembrance of Allah. Those who do so, they are the losers

63:10.ar: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقْنَٰكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّاتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ اُ۬لْمَوْتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوْلَآ أَخَّرْتَنِےٓ إِلَيٰٓ أَجَلࣲ قَرِيبࣲ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ اَ۬لصَّٰلِحِينَۖ
63:10.en: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous

63:11.ar: وَلَنْ يُّوَ۬خِّرَ اَ۬للَّهُ نَفْساً اِذَا جَآءَ اجَلُهَاۖ وَاللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَۖ
63:11.en: But Allah reprieveth no soul when its term cometh, and Allah is Informed of what ye do

64:1.ar: يُسَبِّحُ لِلهِ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِے اِ۬لَارْضِۖ لَهُ اُ۬لْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ اُ۬لْحَمْدُۖ وَهُوَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرٌۖ
64:1.en: All that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth glorifieth Allah; unto Him belongeth Sovereignty and unto Him belongeth praise, and He is Able to do all things

64:2.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِے خَلَقَكُمْ فَمِنكُمْ كَافِرࣱ وَمِنكُم مُّومِنࣱۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۖ
64:2.en: He it is Who created you, but one of you is a disbeliever and one of you is a believer, and Allah is Seer of what ye do

64:3.ar: خَلَقَ اَ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْۖ وَإِلَيْهِ اِ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
64:3.en: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying

64:4.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا فِے اِ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ اِ۬لصُّدُورِۖ
64:4.en: He knoweth all that is in the heavens and the earth, and He knoweth what ye conceal and what ye publish. And Allah is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men)

64:5.ar: أَلَمْ يَاتِكُمْ نَبَؤُاْ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَبْلُ فَذَاقُواْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمࣱۖ
64:5.en: Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of old and so did taste the ill-effects of their conduct, and theirs will be a painful doom

64:6.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُۥ كَانَت تَّاتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِالْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَقَالُوٓاْ أَبَشَرࣱ يَهْدُونَنَاۖ فَكَفَرُواْ وَتَوَلَّواْ وَّاسْتَغْنَي اَ۬للَّهُۖ وَاللَّهُ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدࣱۖ
64:6.en: That was because their messengers (from Allah) kept coming unto them with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), but they said: Shall mere mortals guide us? So they disbelieved and turned away, and Allah was independent (of them). Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise

64:7.ar: ۞زَعَمَ اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَن لَّنْ يُّبْعَثُواْۖ قُلْ بَل۪يٰ وَرَبِّے لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْۖ وَذَٰلِكَ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ يَسِيرࣱۖ
64:7.en: Those who disbelieve assert that they will not be raised again. Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Yea, verily, by my Lord! ye will be raised again and then ye will be informed of what ye did; and that is easy for Allah

64:8.ar: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَالنُّورِ اِ۬لذِےٓ أَنزَلْنَاۖ وَاللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرࣱۖ
64:8.en: So believe in Allah and His messenger and the light which We have revealed. And Allah is Informed of what ye do

64:9.ar: يَوْمَ يَجْمَعُكُمْ لِيَوْمِ اِ۬لْجَمْعِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ اُ۬لتَّغَابُنِۖ وَمَنْ يُّومِنۢ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحاࣰ نُّكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَنُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَداࣰۖ ذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْفَوْزُ اُ۬لْعَظِيمُۖ
64:9.en: The day when He shall gather you unto the Day of Assembling, that will be a day of mutual disillusion. And whoso believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will remit from him his evil deeds and will bring him unto Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. That is the supreme triumph

64:10.ar: وَالذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لنّ۪ارِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ وَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
64:10.en: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are owners of the Fire; they will abide therein - a hapless journey's end

64:11.ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ اِلَّا بِإِذْنِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ وَمَنْ يُّومِنۢ بِاللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥۖ وَاللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عَلِيمࣱۖ
64:11.en: No calamity befalleth save by Allah's leave. And whosoever believeth in Allah, He guideth his heart. And Allah is Knower of all things

64:12.ar: وَأَطِيعُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ اُ۬لرَّسُولَۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّيْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيٰ رَسُولِنَا اَ۬لْبَلَٰغُ اُ۬لْمُبِينُۖ
64:12.en: Obey Allah and obey His messenger; but if ye turn away, then the duty of Our messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly

64:13.ar: اُ۬للَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَعَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ اِ۬لْمُومِنُونَۖ
64:13.en: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. In Allah, therefore, let believers put their trust

64:14.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ مِنَ اَزْوَٰجِكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدِكُمْ عَدُوّاࣰ لَّكُمْ فَاحْذَرُوهُمْۖ وَإِن تَعْفُواْ وَتَصْفَحُواْ وَتَغْفِرُواْ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمٌۖ
64:14.en: O ye who believe! Lo! among your wives and your children there are enemies for you, therefor beware of them. And if ye efface and overlook and forgive, then lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

64:15.ar: اِنَّمَآ أَمْوَٰلُكُمْ وَأَوْلَٰدُكُمْ فِتْنَةࣱۖ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ عَظِيمࣱۖ
64:15.en: Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with Him is an immense reward

64:16.ar: فَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ مَا اَ۪سْتَطَعْتُمْ وَاسْمَعُواْ وَأَطِيعُواْ وَأَنفِقُواْ خَيْراࣰ لِّأَنفُسِكُمْۖ وَمَنْ يُّوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْمُفْلِحُونَۖ
64:16.en: So keep your duty to Allah as best ye can, and listen, and obey, and spend; that is better for your souls. And whoso is saved from his own greed, such are the successful

64:17.ar: إِن تُقْرِضُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناࣰ يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌۖ
64:17.en: If ye lend unto Allah a goodly loan, He will double it for you and will forgive you, for Allah is Responsive, Clement

64:18.en: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Wise

65:1.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا‏ اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءُ اِ۪ذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ اُ۬لنِّسَآءَ فَطَلِّقُوهُنَّ لِعِدَّتِهِنَّ وَأَحْصُواْ اُ۬لْعِدَّةَۖ وَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ رَبَّكُمْۖ لَا تُخْرِجُوهُنَّ مِنۢ بُيُوتِهِنَّۖ وَلَا يَخْرُجْنَ إِلَّآ أَنْ يَّاتِينَ بِفَٰحِشَةࣲ مُّبَيِّنَةࣲۖ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ اُ۬للَّهِۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَعَدَّ حُدُودَ اَ۬للَّهِ فَقَد ظَّلَمَ نَفْسَهُۥۖ لَا تَدْرِے لَعَلَّ اَ۬للَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ أَمْراࣰۖ
65:1.en: O Prophet! When ye (men) put away women, put them away for their (legal) period and reckon the period, and keep your duty to Allah, your Lord. Expel them not from their houses nor let them go forth unless they commit open immorality. Such are the limits (imposed by) Allah; and whoso transgresseth Allah's limits, he verily wrongeth his soul. Thou knowest not: it may be that Allah will afterward bring some new thing to pass

65:2.ar: فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ اَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفࣲۖ وَأَشْهِدُواْ ذَوَےْ عَدْلࣲ مِّنكُمْۖ وَأَقِيمُواْ اُ۬لشَّهَٰدَةَ لِلهِۖ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُومِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ اِ۬لَاخِرِۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَّقِ اِ۬للَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجاࣰ‏
65:2.en: Then, when they have reached their term, take them back in kindness or part from them in kindness, and call to witness two just men among you, and keep your testimony upright for Allah. Whoso believeth in Allah and the Last Day is exhorted to act thus. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, Allah will appoint a way out for him

65:3.ar: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَوَكَّلْ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ بَٰلِغٌ اَمْرَهُۥۖ قَدْ جَعَلَ اَ۬للَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدْراࣰۖ
65:3.en: And will provide for him from (a quarter) whence he hath no expectation. And whosoever putteth his trust in Allah, He will suffice him. Lo! Allah bringeth His command to pass. Allah hath set a measure for all things

65:4.ar: وَال۪ےْ يَئِسْنَ مِنَ اَ۬لْمَحِيضِ مِن نِّسَآئِكُمُۥٓ إِنِ اِ۪رْتَبْتُمْ فَعِدَّتُهُنَّ ثَلَٰثَةُ أَشْهُرࣲ وَال۪ےْ لَمْ يَحِضْنَۖ وَأُوْلَٰتُ اُ۬لَاحْمَالِ أَجَلُهُنَّ أَنْ يَّضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَّقِ اِ۬للَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِنَ اَمْرِهِۦ يُسْراࣰۖ
65:4.en: And for such of your women as despair of menstruation, if ye doubt, their period (of waiting) shall be three months, along with those who have it not. And for those with child, their period shall be till they bring forth their burden. And whosoever keepeth his duty to Allah, He maketh his course easy for him

65:5.ar: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ اُ۬للَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْۖ وَمَنْ يَّتَّقِ اِ۬للَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْراًۖ
65:5.en: That is the commandment of Allah which He revealeth unto you. And whoso keepeth his duty to Allah, He will remit from him his evil deeds and magnify reward for him

65:6.ar: اَسْكِنُوهُنَّ مِنْ حَيْثُ سَكَنتُم مِّنْ وُّجْدِكُمْۖ وَلَا تُضَآرُّوهُنَّ لِتُضَيِّقُواْ عَلَيْهِنَّۖ وَإِن كُنَّ أُوْلَٰتِ حَمْلࣲ فَأَنفِقُواْ عَلَيْهِنَّ حَتَّيٰ يَضَعْنَ حَمْلَهُنَّۖ فَإِنَ اَرْضَعْنَ لَكُمْ فَـَٔاتُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ وَاتَمِرُواْ بَيْنَكُم بِمَعْرُوفࣲۖ ۞وَإِن تَعَاسَرْتُمْ فَسَتُرْضِعُ لَهُۥٓ أُخْر۪يٰۖ
65:6.en: Lodge them where ye dwell, according to your wealth, and harass them not so as to straiten life for them. And if they are with child, then spend for them till they bring forth their burden. Then, if they give suck for you, give them their due payment and consult together in kindness; but if ye make difficulties for one another, then let some other woman give suck for him (the father of the child)

65:7.ar: لِيُنفِقْ ذُو سَعَةࣲ مِّن سَعَتِهِۦۖ وَمَن قُدِرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُۥ فَلْيُنفِقْ مِمَّآ ءَات۪يٰهُ اُ۬للَّهُۖ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اُ۬للَّهُ نَفْساً اِلَّا مَآ ءَات۪يٰهَاۖ سَيَجْعَلُ اُ۬للَّهُ بَعْدَ عُسْرࣲ يُسْراࣰۖ
65:7.en: Let him who hath abundance spend of his abundance, and he whose provision is measured, let him spend of that which Allah hath given him. Allah asketh naught of any soul save that which He hath given it. Allah will vouchsafe, after hardship, ease

65:8.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنَ اَمْرِ رَبِّهَا وَرُسُلِهِۦ فَحَاسَبْنَٰهَا حِسَاباࣰ شَدِيداࣰ وَعَذَّبْنَٰهَا عَذَاباࣰ نُّكُراࣰ‏
65:8.en: And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire punishment

65:9.ar: فَذَاقَتْ وَبَالَ أَمْرِهَاۖ وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمْرِهَا خُسْراًۖ
65:9.en: So that it tasted the ill-effects of its conduct, and the consequence of its conduct was loss

65:10.ar: اَعَدَّ اَ۬للَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَاباࣰ شَدِيداࣰۖ فَاتَّقُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ يَٰٓأُوْلِے اِ۬لَالْبَٰبِۖ اِ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَدَ اَنزَلَ اَ۬للَّهُ إِلَيْكُمْ ذِكْراࣰۖ
65:10.en: Allah hath prepared for them stern punishment; so keep your duty to Allah, O men of understanding! O ye who believe! Now Allah hath sent down unto you a reminder

65:11.ar: رَّسُولاࣰ يَتْلُواْ عَلَيْكُمُۥٓ ءَايَٰتِ اِ۬للَّهِ مُبَيَّنَٰتࣲ لِّيُخْرِجَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنَ اَ۬لظُّلُمَٰتِ إِلَي اَ۬لنُّورِۖ وَمَنْ يُّومِنۢ بِاللَّهِ وَيَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحاࣰ نُّدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَداࣰ قَدَ اَحْسَنَ اَ۬للَّهُ لَهُۥ رِزْقاًۖ
65:11.en: A messenger reciting unto you the revelations of Allah made plain, that He may bring forth those who believe and do good works from darkness unto light. And whosoever believeth in Allah and doeth right, He will bring him into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein to abide for ever. Allah hath made good provision for him
