65:12.ar: اِ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لذِے خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ وَمِنَ اَ۬لَارْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّۖ يَتَنَزَّلُ اُ۬لَامْرُ بَيْنَهُنَّ لِتَعْلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرࣱ وَأَنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ قَدَ اَحَاطَ بِكُلِّ شَےْءٍ عِلْماࣰۖ
65:12.en: Allah it is who hath created seven heavens, and of the earth the like thereof. The commandment cometh down among them slowly, that ye may know that Allah is Able to do all things, and that Allah surroundeth all things in knowledge

66:1.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا‏ اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءُ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَآ أَحَلَّ اَ۬للَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِے مَرْضَاتَ أَزْوَٰجِكَۖ وَاللَّهُ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
66:1.en: O Prophet! Why bannest thou that which Allah hath made lawful for thee, seeking to please thy wives? And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

66:2.ar: قَدْ فَرَضَ اَ۬للَّهُ لَكُمْ تَحِلَّةَ أَيْمَٰنِكُمْۖ وَاللَّهُ مَوْل۪يٰكُمْۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَلِيمُ اُ۬لْحَكِيمُۖ
66:2.en: Allah hath made lawful for you (Muslims) absolution from your oaths (of such a kind), and Allah is your Protector. He is the Knower, the Wise

66:3.ar: وَإِذَ اَسَرَّ‏ اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءُ اِ۪لَيٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثاࣰۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ اُ۬للَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضࣲۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنَ اَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا قَالَ نَبَّأَنِيَ اَ۬لْعَلِيمُ اُ۬لْخَبِيرُۖ
66:3.en: When the Prophet confided a fact unto one of his wives and when she afterward divulged it and Allah apprised him thereof, he made known (to her) part thereof and passed over part. And when he told it her she said: Who hath told thee? He said: The Knower, the Aware hath told me

66:4.ar: إِن تَتُوبَآ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ فَقَدْ صَغَتْ قُلُوبُكُمَاۖ وَإِن تَظَّٰهَرَا عَلَيْهِ فَإِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ هُوَ مَوْل۪يٰهُ وَجِبْرِيلُ وَصَٰلِحُ اُ۬لْمُومِنِينَۖ وَالْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ ظَهِيرٌۖ
66:4.en: If ye twain turn unto Allah repentant, (ye have cause to do so) for your hearts desired (the ban); and if ye aid one another against him (Muhammad) then lo! Allah, even He, is his Protecting Friend, and Gabriel and the righteous among the believers; and furthermore the angels are his helpers

66:5.ar: عَس۪يٰ رَبُّهُۥٓ إِن طَلَّقَكُنَّ أَنْ يُّبَدِّلَهُۥٓ أَزْوَٰجاً خَيْراࣰ مِّنكُنَّ مُسْلِمَٰتࣲ مُّومِنَٰتࣲ قَٰنِتَٰتࣲ تَٰٓئِبَٰتٍ عَٰبِدَٰتࣲ سَٰٓئِحَٰتࣲ ثَيِّبَٰتࣲ وَأَبْكَاراࣰۖ
66:5.en: It may happen that his Lord, if he divorce you, will give him in your stead wives better than you, submissive (to Allah), believing, pious, penitent, devout, inclined to fasting, widows and maids

66:6.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قُوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَأَهْلِيكُمْ نَاراࣰ وَقُودُهَا اَ۬لنَّاسُ وَالْحِجَارَةُ عَلَيْهَا مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌ غِلَٰظࣱ شِدَادࣱ لَّا يَعْصُونَ اَ۬للَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُومَرُونَۖ
66:6.en: O ye who believe! Ward off from yourselves and your families a Fire whereof the fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels strong, severe, who resist not Allah in that which He commandeth them, but do that which they are commanded

66:7.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعْتَذِرُواْ اُ۬لْيَوْمَ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَۖ
66:7.en: (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do

66:8.ar: ۞يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ تُوبُوٓاْ إِلَي اَ۬للَّهِ تَوْبَةࣰ نَّصُوحاً عَس۪يٰ رَبُّكُمُۥٓ أَنْ يُّكَفِّرَ عَنكُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتِكُمْ وَيُدْخِلَكُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُ يَوْمَ لَا يُخْزِے اِ۬للَّهُ اُ۬لنَّبِےٓءَ وَالذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مَعَهُۥ نُورُهُمْ يَسْع۪يٰ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَٰنِهِمْۖ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَآۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرࣱۖ
66:8.en: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things

66:9.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا‏ اَ۬لنَّبِےٓءُ جَٰهِدِ اِ۬لْكُفَّارَ وَالْمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَاغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْۖ وَمَأْو۪يٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُۖ وَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
66:9.en: O Prophet! Strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be stern with them. Hell will be their home, a hapless journey's end

66:10.ar: ضَرَبَ اَ۬للَّهُ مَثَلاࣰ لِّلذِينَ كَفَرُواْ اُ۪مْرَأَتَ نُوحࣲ وَامْرَأَتَ لُوطࣲۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَالِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَٰهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ اَ۬للَّهِ شَئْاࣰۖ وَقِيلَ اَ۟دْخُلَا اَ۬لنَّارَ مَعَ اَ۬لدَّٰخِلِينَۖ
66:10.en: Allah citeth an example for those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot, who were under two of Our righteous slaves yet betrayed them so that they (the husbands) availed them naught against Allah and it was said (unto them): Enter the Fire along with those who enter

66:11.ar: وَضَرَبَ اَ۬للَّهُ مَثَلاࣰ لِّلذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ اُ۪مْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِ۪بْنِ لِے عِندَكَ بَيْتاࣰ فِے اِ۬لْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِے مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِے مِنَ اَ۬لْقَوْمِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَۖ
66:11.en: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk

66:12.ar: وَمَرْيَمَ اَ۪بْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ اَ۬لتِےٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكِتَٰبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ اَ۬لْقَٰنِتِينَۖ
66:12.en: And Mary, daughter of 'Imran, whose body was chaste, therefor We breathed therein something of Our Spirit. And she put faith in the words of her Lord and His scriptures, and was of the obedient

67:1.ar: تَبَٰرَكَ اَ۬لذِے بِيَدِهِ اِ۬لْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ قَدِيرٌۖ
67:1.en: Blessed is He in Whose hand is the Sovereignty, and, He is Able to do all things

67:2.ar: اِ۬لذِے خَلَقَ اَ۬لْمَوْتَ وَالْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمُۥٓ أَيُّكُمُۥٓ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلاࣰۖ وَهُوَ اَ۬لْعَزِيزُ اُ۬لْغَفُورُۖ
67:2.en: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving

67:3.ar: اُ۬لذِے خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقاࣰۖ مَّا تَر۪يٰ فِے خَلْقِ اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتࣲۖ فَارْجِعِ اِ۬لْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَر۪يٰ مِن فُطُورࣲۖ
67:3.en: Who hath created seven heavens in harmony. Thou (Muhammad) canst see no fault in the Beneficent One's creation; then look again: Canst thou see any rifts

67:4.ar: ثُمَّ اَ۪رْجِعِ اِ۬لْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبِ اِلَيْكَ اَ۬لْبَصَرُ خَاسِئاࣰ وَهُوَ حَسِيرࣱۖ
67:4.en: Then look again and yet again, thy sight will return unto thee weakened and made dim

67:5.ar: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا اَ۬لسَّمَآءَ اَ۬لدُّنْي۪ا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُوماࣰ لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ اَ۬لسَّعِيرِۖ
67:5.en: And verily We have beautified the world's heaven with lamps, and We have made them missiles for the devils, and for them We have prepared the doom of flame

67:6.ar: وَلِلذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَۖ وَبِيسَ اَ۬لْمَصِيرُۖ
67:6.en: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the doom of hell, a hapless journey's end

67:7.ar: إِذَآ أُلْقُواْ فِيهَا سَمِعُواْ لَهَا شَهِيقاࣰ وَهِيَ تَفُورُ
67:7.en: When they are flung therein they hear its roaring as it boileth up

67:8.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ اَ۬لْغَيْظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِيَ فِيهَا فَوْجࣱ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَاتِكُمْ نَذِيرࣱۖ
67:8.en: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner

67:9.ar: قَالُواْ بَل۪يٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرࣱ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اَ۬للَّهُ مِن شَےْءٍ اِنَ اَنتُمُۥٓ إِلَّا فِے ضَلَٰلࣲ كَبِيرࣲۖ
67:9.en: They say: Yea, verily, a warner came unto us; but we denied and said: Allah hath naught revealed; ye are in naught but a great error

67:10.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِےٓ أَصْحَٰبِ اِ۬لسَّعِيرِۖ
67:10.en: And they say: Had we been wont to listen or have sense, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames

67:11.en: So they acknowledge their sins; but far removed (from mercy) are the dwellers in the flames

67:12.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِالْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةࣱ وَأَجْرࣱ كَبِيرࣱۖ
67:12.en: Lo! those who fear their Lord in secret, theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward

67:13.ar: وَأَسِرُّواْ قَوْلَكُمُۥٓ أَوِ اِ۪جْهَرُواْ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ اِ۬لصُّدُورِۖ
67:13.en: And keep your opinion secret or proclaim it, lo! He is Knower of all that is in the breasts (of men)

67:14.ar: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ اَ۬للَّطِيفُ اُ۬لْخَبِيرُۖ
67:14.en: Should He not know what He created? And He is the Subtile, the Aware

67:15.ar: هُوَ اَ۬لذِے جَعَلَ لَكُمُ اُ۬لَارْضَ ذَلُولاࣰ فَامْشُواْ فِے مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُواْ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيْهِ اِ۬لنُّشُورُۖ
67:15.en: He it is Who hath made the earth subservient unto you, so Walk in the paths thereof and eat of His providence. And unto Him will be the resurrection (of the dead)

67:16.ar: ءَامِنتُم مَّن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَآءِ اَ۬نْ يَّخْسِفَ بِكُمُ اُ۬لَارْضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُۖ
67:16.en: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed

67:17.ar: أَمَ اَمِنتُم مَّن فِے اِ۬لسَّمَآءِ اَ۬نْ يُّرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِباࣰۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِۦۖ
67:17.en: Or have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not let loose on you a hurricane? But ye shall know the manner of My warning

67:18.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اَ۬لذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْۖ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِۦٓۖ
67:18.en: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)

67:19.ar: ۞أَوَلَمْ يَرَوِاْ اِلَي اَ۬لطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتࣲ وَيَقْبِضْنَۖ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُۖ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَےْءِۢ بَصِيرٌۖ
67:19.en: Have they not seen the birds above them spreading out their wings and closing them? Naught upholdeth them save the Beneficent. Lo! He is Seer of all things

67:20.ar: اَمَّنْ هَٰذَا اَ۬لذِے هُوَ جُندࣱ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ اِ۬لرَّحْمَٰنِۖ إِنِ اِ۬لْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِے غُرُورٍۖ
67:20.en: Or who is he that will be an army unto you to help you instead of the Beneficent? The disbelievers are in naught but illusion

67:21.ar: اَمَّنْ هَٰذَا اَ۬لذِے يَرْزُقُكُمُۥٓ إِنَ اَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥۖ بَل لَّجُّواْ فِے عُتُوࣲّ وَنُفُورٍۖ
67:21.en: Or who is he that will provide for you if He should withhold His providence? Nay, but they are set in pride and frowardness

67:22.ar: اَفَمَنْ يَّمْشِے مُكِبّاً عَلَيٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْد۪يٰٓ أَمَّنْ يَّمْشِے سَوِيّاً عَلَيٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسْتَقِيمࣲۖ
67:22.en: Is he who goeth groping on his face more rightly guided, or he who walketh upright on a straight road

67:23.ar: قُلْ هُوَ اَ۬لذِےٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ اُ۬لسَّمْعَ وَالَابْصَٰرَ وَالَافْـِٕدَةَۖ قَلِيلاࣰ مَّا تَشْكُرُونَۖ
67:23.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): He it is who gave you being, and hath assigned unto you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

67:24.ar: قُلْ هُوَ اَ۬لذِے ذَرَأَكُمْ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَۖ
67:24.en: Say: He it is Who multiplieth you in the earth, and unto Whom ye will be gathered

67:25.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَت۪يٰ هَٰذَا اَ۬لْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَۖ
67:25.en: And they say: When (will) this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

67:26.ar: قُلِ اِنَّمَا اَ۬لْعِلْمُ عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينࣱۖ
67:26.en: Say: The knowledge is with Allah only, and I am but a plain warner

67:27.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةࣰ س۬يَٓٔتْ وُجُوهُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا اَ۬لذِے كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَۖ
67:27.en: But when they see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve will be awry, and it will be said (unto them): This is that for which ye used to call

67:28.ar: قُلَ اَرَٰٓيْتُمُۥٓ إِنَ اَهْلَكَنِيَ اَ۬للَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِيَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَنْ يُّجِيرُ اُ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِيمࣲۖ
67:28.en: Say (O Muhammad): Have ye thought: Whether Allah causeth me (Muhammad) and those with me to perish or hath mercy on us, still, who will protect the disbelievers from a painful doom

67:29.ar: قُلْ هُوَ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَاۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِے ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲۖ
67:29.en: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest

67:30.ar: قُلَ اَرَٰٓيْتُمُۥٓ إِنَ اَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْراࣰ فَمَنْ يَّاتِيكُم بِمَآءࣲ مَّعِينࣲۖ
67:30.en: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water

68:1.en: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith)

68:2.en: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman

68:3.en: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing

68:4.en: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature

68:5.en: And thou wilt see and they will see

68:6.en: Which of you is the demented

68:7.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦۖ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَۖ
68:7.en: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright

68:8.en: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters

68:9.en: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise

68:10.en: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger

68:12.en: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor

68:14.en: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children

68:15.ar: إِذَا تُتْل۪يٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ اُ۬لَاوَّلِينَۖ
68:15.en: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old

68:16.en: We shall brand him on the nose

68:17.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ اَ۬لْجَنَّةِ إِذَ اَقْسَمُواْ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
68:17.en: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning

68:18.en: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah)

68:19.ar: ۞فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
68:19.en: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept

68:20.en: And in the morning it was as if plucked

68:21.en: And they cried out one unto another in the morning

68:22.ar: أَنُ اُ۟غْدُواْ عَلَيٰ حَرْثِكُمُۥٓ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَۖ
68:22.en: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit)

68:23.en: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones

68:24.ar: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا اَ۬لْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينࣱۖ
68:24.en: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you

68:25.en: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose

68:26.en: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error

68:28.ar: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمُۥٓ أَلَمَ اَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَۖ
68:28.en: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)

68:29.ar: قَالُواْ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَۖ
68:29.en: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers

68:30.en: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching

68:31.en: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous

68:32.ar: عَس۪يٰ رَبُّنَآ أَنْ يُّبَدِّلَنَا خَيْراࣰ مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَيٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَۖ
68:32.en: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord

68:33.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ اُ۬لَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ لَوْ كَانُواْ يَعْلَمُونَۖ
68:33.en: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know

68:34.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ اِ۬لنَّعِيمِۖ
68:34.en: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord

68:35.en: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty

68:36.en: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge

68:37.en: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn

68:38.en: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose

68:39.ar: أَمْ لَكُمُۥٓ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ اِلَيٰ يَوْمِ اِ۬لْقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَۖ
68:39.en: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain

68:40.en: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that

68:41.ar: اَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَاتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمُۥٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَۖ
68:41.en: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful

68:42.ar: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَي اَ۬لسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَۖ
68:42.en: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able

68:43.ar: خَٰشِعَةً اَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةࣱۖ وَقَدْ كَانُواْ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَي اَ۬لسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَۖ
68:43.en: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt

68:44.ar: فَذَرْنِے وَمَنْ يُّكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا اَ۬لْحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
68:44.en: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not

68:45.en: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm

68:46.ar: اَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمُۥٓ أَجْراࣰ فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمࣲ مُّثْقَلُونَۖ
68:46.en: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed

68:47.en: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)

68:48.ar: ۞فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَٰحِبِ اِ۬لْحُوتِ إِذْ نَاد۪يٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومࣱۖ
68:48.en: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair

68:49.ar: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومࣱۖ
68:49.en: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate

68:50.en: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous

68:51.ar: وَإِنْ يَّكَادُ اُ۬لذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيَزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصٰ۪رِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ اُ۬لذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونࣱۖ
68:51.en: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad

68:52.en: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation

69:3.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is

69:4.en: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come

69:5.en: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning

69:6.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادࣱ فَأُهْلِكُواْ بِرِيحࣲ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةࣲ‏
69:6.en: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind

69:7.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالࣲ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُوماࣰۖ فَتَرَي اَ۬لْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْع۪يٰ كَأَنَّهُمُۥٓ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةࣲۖ
69:7.en: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees

69:8.en: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them

69:9.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَالْمُوتَفِكَٰتُ بِالْخَاطِئَةِ
69:9.en: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error

69:10.ar: فَعَصَوْاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمُۥٓ أَخْذَةࣰ رَّابِيَةًۖ
69:10.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip

69:11.ar: اِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا اَ۬لْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِے اِ۬لْجَارِيَةِ
69:11.en: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

69:12.ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةࣰ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذْنࣱ وَٰعِيَةࣱۖ
69:12.en: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember

69:13.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِے اِ۬لصُّورِ نَفْخَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ‏
69:13.en: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast

69:14.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ اِ۬لَارْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ‏
69:14.en: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash

69:15.en: Then, on that day will the Event befall

69:16.en: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail

69:17.ar: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلَيٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَاۖ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذࣲ ثَمَٰنِيَةࣱ‏
69:17.en: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them

69:18.ar: يَوْمَئِذࣲ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْف۪يٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةࣱۖ
69:18.en: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden

69:19.ar: ۞فَأَمَّا مَنُ ا۟وتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ اُ۪قْرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهْۖ
69:19.en: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book

69:20.en: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning

69:21.en: Then he will be in blissful state

69:23.en: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach

69:24.ar: كُلُواْ وَاشْرَبُواْۖ هَنِيٓـٔاَۢ بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِے اِ۬لَايَّامِ اِ۬لْخَالِيَةِۖ
69:24.en: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days

69:25.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنُ ا۟وتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِے لَمُ ا۟وتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْۖ
69:25.en: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book

69:26.en: And knew not what my reckoning

69:27.en: Oh, would that it had been death

69:28.en: My wealth hath not availed me

69:29.en: My power hath gone from me

69:30.en: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him

69:31.en: And then expose him to hell-fire

69:32.ar: ثُمَّ فِے سِلْسِلَةࣲ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعاࣰ فَاسْلُكُوهُۖ
69:32.en: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits

69:33.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُومِنُ بِاللَّهِ اِ۬لْعَظِيمِ
69:33.en: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous

69:34.en: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched

69:35.en: Therefor hath he no lover here this day

69:38.en: But nay! I swear by all that ye see

69:39.en: And all that ye see not

69:40.en: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger

69:41.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرࣲ قَلِيلاࣰ مَّا تُومِنُونَ
69:41.en: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe

69:42.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنࣲۖ قَلِيلاࣰ مَّا تَذَّكَّرُونَۖ
69:42.en: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember

69:43.en: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds

69:44.en: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us

69:45.en: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand

69:47.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنَ اَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَۖ
69:47.en: And not one of you could have held Us off from him

69:48.en: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil)

69:49.en: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it)

69:50.en: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers

69:51.en: And lo! it is absolute truth

69:52.en: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord

70:1.en: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall

70:2.en: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel

70:3.en: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways

70:4.ar: تَعْرُجُ اُ۬لْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِے يَوْمࣲ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةࣲۖ
70:4.en: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years

70:5.en: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see

70:6.en: Lo! they behold it afar off

70:8.en: The day when the sky will become as molten copper

70:9.en: And the hills become as flakes of wool

70:10.en: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend

70:11.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْۖ يَوَدُّ اُ۬لْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِے مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمَئِذِۢ بِبَنِيهِ
70:11.en: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children

70:12.en: And his spouse and his brother

70:13.en: And his kin that harboured him

70:14.ar: وَمَن فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ جَمِيعاࣰ ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
70:14.en: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him

70:15.en: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell

70:17.en: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth)

70:21.en: And, when good befalleth him, grudging

70:23.en: Who are constant at their worship

70:24.en: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged

70:25.en: For the beggar and the destitute

70:26.en: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment

70:27.ar: وَالذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
70:27.en: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom

70:28.en: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure

70:29.en: And those who preserve their chastity

70:30.ar: إِلَّا عَلَيٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمُۥٓ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتَ اَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَۖ
70:30.en: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy

70:31.ar: فَمَنِ اِ۪بْتَغ۪يٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ اُ۬لْعَادُونَۖ
70:31.en: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors

70:32.en: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant

70:33.en: And those who stand by their testimony

70:34.en: And those who are attentive at their worship

70:35.en: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured

70:36.en: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed

70:37.en: On the right and on the left, in groups

70:38.ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ اُ۪مْرِےࣲٕ مِّنْهُمُۥٓ أَنْ يُّدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمࣲ‏
70:38.en: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight

70:39.en: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know

70:40.ar: ۞فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ اِ۬لْمَشَٰرِقِ وَالْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
70:40.en: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able

70:41.ar: عَلَيٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْراࣰ مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَۖ
70:41.en: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun

70:42.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّيٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ اُ۬لذِے يُوعَدُونَ
70:42.en: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised

70:43.ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ اَ۬لَاجْدَاثِ سِرَاعاࣰ كَأَنَّهُمُۥٓ إِلَيٰ نَصْبࣲ يُوفِضُونَ
70:43.en: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal

70:44.ar: خَٰشِعَةً اَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةࣱۖ ذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْيَوْمُ اُ۬لذِے كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَۖ
70:44.en: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised

71:1.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحاً اِلَيٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنَ اَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَنْ يَّاتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ اَلِيمࣱۖ
71:1.en: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them

71:2.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّے لَكُمْ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
71:2.en: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you

71:3.en: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me

71:4.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُوَ۬خِّرْكُمُۥٓ إِلَيٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمّيًۖ اِنَّ أَجَلَ اَ۬للَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُوَ۬خَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَۖ
71:4.en: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew

71:5.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّے دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِے لَيْلاࣰ وَنَهَاراࣰ‏
71:5.en: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day

71:6.en: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance

71:7.ar: وَإِنِّے كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِےٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَاسْتَغْشَوْاْ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَاسْتَكْبَرُواْ اُ۪سْتِكْبَاراࣰۖ
71:7.en: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride

71:8.en: And lo! I have called unto them aloud

71:9.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّيَ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمُۥٓ إِسْرَاراࣰ‏
71:9.en: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private

71:10.ar: فَقُلْتُ اُ۪سْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمُۥٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّاراࣰ‏
71:10.en: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving

71:11.en: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain

71:12.ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمُۥٓ أَنْهَٰراࣰۖ
71:12.en: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers

71:13.ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلهِ وَقَاراࣰ‏
71:13.en: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity

71:14.en: When He created you by (divers) stages

71:15.ar: ۞اَلَمْ تَرَوْاْ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ اَ۬للَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقاࣰ‏
71:15.en: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony

71:16.ar: وَجَعَلَ اَ۬لْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُوراࣰ وَجَعَلَ اَ۬لشَّمْسَ سِرَاجاࣰۖ
71:16.en: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp

71:17.en: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth

71:18.en: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing

71:19.en: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you

71:20.en: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof

71:21.ar: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِے وَاتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَاراࣰ‏
71:21.en: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin

71:22.en: And they have plotted a mighty plot

71:23.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وُدّاࣰ وَلَا سُوَاعاࣰ وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْراࣰۖ
71:23.en: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr

71:24.ar: وَقَدَ اَضَلُّواْ كَثِيراࣰۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلاࣰۖ
71:24.en: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error

71:25.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمُۥٓ أُغْرِقُواْ فَأُدْخِلُواْ نَاراࣰ فَلَمْ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ اِ۬للَّهِ أَنصَاراࣰۖ
71:25.en: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah

71:26.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَي اَ۬لَارْضِ مِنَ اَ۬لْكٰ۪فِرِينَ دَيَّاراًۖ
71:26.en: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land

71:27.ar: اِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِراࣰ كَفَّاراࣰۖ
71:27.en: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates

71:28.ar: رَّبِّ اِ۪غْفِرْ لِے وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِے مُومِناࣰ وَلِلْمُومِنِينَ وَالْمُومِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ اِ۬لظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَاراࣰۖ
71:28.en: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin

72:1.ar: قُلُ ا۟وحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ اُ۪سْتَمَعَ نَفَرࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَاناً عَجَباࣰ‏
72:1.en: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an

72:2.ar: يَهْدِےٓ إِلَي اَ۬لرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَداࣰۖ
72:2.en: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord

72:3.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ تَعَٰل۪يٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا اَ۪تَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةࣰ وَلَا وَلَداࣰۖ
72:3.en: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son

72:4.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ شَطَطاࣰۖ
72:4.en: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie

72:5.ar: وَإِنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ اَ۬لِانسُ وَالْجِنُّ عَلَي اَ۬للَّهِ كَذِباࣰۖ
72:5.en: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah

72:6.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لِانسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالࣲ مِّنَ اَ۬لْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقاࣰۖ
72:6.en: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah

72:7.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمُۥٓ أَن لَّنْ يَّبْعَثَ اَ۬للَّهُ أَحَداࣰۖ
72:7.en: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)

72:8.ar: وَإِنَّا لَمَسْنَا اَ۬لسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَساࣰ شَدِيداࣰ وَشُهُباࣰۖ
72:8.en: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors

72:9.ar: وَإِنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَنْ يَّسْتَمِعِ اِ۬لَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَاباࣰ رَّصَداࣰۖ
72:9.en: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him

72:10.ar: وَإِنَّا لَا نَدْرِےٓ أَشَرٌّ ا۟رِيدَ بِمَن فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ أَمَ اَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَداࣰۖ
72:10.en: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them

72:11.ar: وَإِنَّا مِنَّا اَ۬لصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَداࣰۖ
72:11.en: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules

72:12.ar: وَإِنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ اَ۬للَّهَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَباࣰۖ
72:12.en: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight

72:13.ar: وَإِنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا اَ۬لْهُد۪يٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦۖ فَمَنْ يُّومِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْساࣰ وَلَا رَهَقاࣰۖ
72:13.en: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression

72:14.ar: وَإِنَّا مِنَّا اَ۬لْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا اَ۬لْقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنَ اَسْلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْاْ رَشَداࣰۖ
72:14.en: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully

72:15.en: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell

72:16.ar: وَأَن لَّوِ اِ۪سْتَقَٰمُواْ عَلَي اَ۬لطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقاࣰ‏
72:16.en: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance

72:17.ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِۖ وَمَنْ يُّعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ نَسْلُكْهُ عَذَاباࣰ صَعَداࣰۖ
72:17.en: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment

72:18.ar: وَأَنَّ اَ۬لْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلهِ فَلَا تَدْعُواْ مَعَ اَ۬للَّهِ أَحَداࣰۖ
72:18.en: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah

72:19.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ اُ۬للَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَداࣰۖ
72:19.en: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling

72:20.ar: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُواْ رَبِّے وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَداࣰۖ
72:20.en: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner

72:21.ar: قُلِ اِنِّے لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرّاࣰ وَلَا رَشَداࣰۖ
72:21.en: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you

72:22.ar: قُلِ اِنِّے لَنْ يُّجِيرَنِے مِنَ اَ۬للَّهِ أَحَدࣱ وَلَنَ اَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَداً
72:22.en: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him

72:23.ar: اِلَّا بَلَٰغاࣰ مِّنَ اَ۬للَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦۖ ۞وَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اِ۬للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَداًۖ
72:23.en: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever

72:24.ar: حَتَّيٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنَ اَضْعَفُ نَاصِراࣰ وَأَقَلُّ عَدَداࣰۖ
72:24.en: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude

72:25.ar: قُلِ اِنَ اَدْرِےٓ أَقَرِيبࣱ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّيَ أَمَداًۖ
72:25.en: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it

72:26.ar: عَٰلِمُ اُ۬لْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَيٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَداً
72:26.en: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret

72:27.ar: اِلَّا مَنِ اِ۪رْتَض۪يٰ مِن رَّسُولࣲ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَداࣰ‏
72:27.en: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him

72:28.ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدَ اَبْلَغُواْ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْص۪يٰ كُلَّ شَےْءٍ عَدَداࣰۖ
72:28.en: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things

73:1.en: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment

73:2.en: Keep vigil the night long, save a little

73:3.en: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof

73:4.ar: اَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ اِ۬لْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلاًۖ
73:4.en: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure

73:5.en: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight

73:6.ar: اِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ اَ۬ليْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـٔاࣰ وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلاًۖ
73:6.en: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain

73:7.ar: اِنَّ لَكَ فِے اِ۬لنَّه۪ارِ سَبْحاࣰ طَوِيلاࣰۖ
73:7.en: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business

73:8.ar: وَاذْكُرِ اِ۪سْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلِ اِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلاࣰۖ
73:8.en: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion

73:9.ar: رَّبُّ اُ۬لْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلاࣰۖ
73:9.en: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender

73:10.ar: وَاصْبِرْ عَلَيٰ مَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْراࣰ جَمِيلاࣰۖ
73:10.en: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking

73:11.ar: وَذَرْنِے وَالْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُوْلِے اِ۬لنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلاًۖ
73:11.en: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile

73:12.en: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire

73:13.en: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom

73:14.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ اُ۬لَارْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ اِ۬لْجِبَالُ كَثِيباࣰ مَّهِيلاًۖ
73:14.en: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand

73:15.ar: اِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولاࣰ شَٰهِداً عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولاࣰ‏
73:15.en: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger

73:16.ar: فَعَص۪يٰ فِرْعَوْنُ اُ۬لرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذاࣰ وَبِيلاࣰۖ
73:16.en: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip

73:17.ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْماࣰ يَجْعَلُ اُ۬لْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيباًۖ
73:17.en: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey

73:18.ar: اِ۬لسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرُۢ بِهِۦۖ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولاًۖ
73:18.en: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled

73:19.ar: اِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ اَ۪تَّخَذَ إِلَيٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلاًۖ
73:19.en: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord

73:20.ar: ۞اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْن۪يٰ مِن ثُلُثَيِ اِ۬ليْلِ وَنِصْفِهِۦ وَثُلُثِهِۦ وَطَآئِفَةࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لذِينَ مَعَكَۖ وَاللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ اُ۬ليْلَ وَالنَّهَارَۖ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْۖ فَاقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ اَ۬لْقُرْءَانِۖ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْض۪يٰ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِے اِ۬لَارْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ اِ۬للَّهِ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِے سَبِيلِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ فَاقْرَءُواْ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُۖ وَأَقِيمُواْ اُ۬لصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ اُ۬لزَّكَوٰةَۖ وَأَقْرِضُواْ اُ۬للَّهَ قَرْضاً حَسَناࣰۖ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُواْ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرࣲ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ اَ۬للَّهِ هُوَ خَيْراࣰ وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْراࣰۖ وَاسْتَغْفِرُواْ اُ۬للَّهَۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ غَفُورࣱ رَّحِيمࣱۖ
73:20.en: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

74:1.en: O thou enveloped in thy cloak

74:6.en: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain

74:7.en: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient

74:8.en: For when the trumpet shall sound

74:9.en: Surely that day will be a day of anguish

74:11.en: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely

74:12.en: And then bestowed upon him ample means

74:13.en: And sons abiding in his presence

74:15.en: Yet he desireth that I should give more

74:16.en: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations

74:17.en: On him I shall impose a fearful doom

74:18.en: For lo! he did consider; then he planned

74:20.en: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned

74:22.en: Then frowned he and showed displeasure

74:23.en: Then turned he away in pride

74:24.ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرࣱ يُوثَرُ
74:24.en: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old

74:25.en: This is naught else than speech of mortal man

74:26.en: Him shall I fling unto the burning

74:27.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is

74:28.en: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught

74:31.ar: ۞وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ اَ۬لنّ۪ارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةࣰۖ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمُۥٓ إِلَّا فِتْنَةࣰ لِّلذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ اَ۬لذِينَ أُوتُواْ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِيمَٰناࣰ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ اَ۬لذِينَ أُوتُواْ اُ۬لْكِتَٰبَ وَالْمُومِنُونَ وَلِيَقُولَ اَ۬لذِينَ فِے قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضࣱ وَالْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ اَ۬للَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلاࣰۖ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ اُ۬للَّهُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهْدِے مَنْ يَّشَآءُۖ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَمَا هِيَ إِلَّا ذِكْر۪يٰ لِلْبَشَرِۖ
74:31.en: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals

74:33.en: And the night when it withdraweth

74:34.en: And the dawn when it shineth forth

74:35.en: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)

74:37.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمُۥٓ أَنْ يَّتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَۖ
74:37.en: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back

74:38.en: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds

74:39.en: Save those who will stand on the right hand

74:40.en: In gardens they will ask one another

74:42.en: What hath brought you to this burning

74:43.en: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed

74:44.en: Nor did we feed the wretched

74:45.en: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders

74:46.en: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment

74:47.en: Till the Inevitable came unto us

74:48.en: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then

74:49.en: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment

74:52.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ اُ۪مْرِےࣲٕ مِّنْهُمُۥٓ أَنْ يُّوت۪يٰ صُحُفاࣰ مُّنَشَّرَةࣰۖ
74:52.en: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah)

74:53.en: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter

74:54.en: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment

74:56.ar: وَمَا تَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَنْ يَّشَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُۖ هُوَ أَهْلُ اُ۬لتَّقْو۪يٰ وَأَهْلُ اُ۬لْمَغْفِرَةِۖ
74:56.en: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy

75:1.en: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection

75:2.en: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true)

75:3.en: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones

75:4.ar: بَل۪يٰۖ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَيٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥۖ
75:4.en: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers

75:5.en: But man would fain deny what is before him

75:6.en: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection

75:9.en: And sun and moon are united

75:10.en: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee

75:12.en: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day

75:13.ar: يُنَبَّؤُاْ اُ۬لِانسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذِۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَۖ
75:13.en: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind

75:14.en: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself

75:16.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓۖ
75:16.en: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it

75:17.en: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof

75:18.en: And when We read it, follow thou the reading

75:19.en: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof

75:20.en: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now

75:22.en: That day will faces be resplendent

75:24.en: And that day will other faces be despondent

75:25.en: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them

75:26.en: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat

75:27.en: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)

75:28.en: And he knoweth that it is the parting

75:29.en: And agony is heaped on agony

75:30.en: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving

75:31.en: For he neither trusted, nor prayed

75:33.en: Then went he to his folk with glee

75:35.en: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom)

75:36.en: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless

75:37.ar: اَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةࣰ مِّن مَّنِيࣲّ تُمْن۪يٰ
75:37.en: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth

75:38.en: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned

75:39.en: And made of him a pair, the male and female

75:40.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَيٰٓ أَنْ يُّحْـِۧيَ اَ۬لْمَوْت۪يٰۖ
75:40.en: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life

76:1.ar: هَلَ اَت۪يٰ عَلَي اَ۬لِانسَٰنِ حِينࣱ مِّنَ اَ۬لدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَئْاࣰ مَّذْكُوراًۖ
76:1.en: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered

76:2.ar: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا اَ۬لِانسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجࣲ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعاَۢ بَصِيراًۖ
76:2.en: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing

76:3.ar: اِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ اُ۬لسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِراࣰ وَإِمَّا كَفُوراًۖ
76:3.en: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving

76:4.ar: اِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰ۪فِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلاࣰ وَأَغْلَٰلاࣰ وَسَعِيراًۖ
76:4.en: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire

76:5.ar: اِنَّ اَ۬لَابْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسࣲ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوراً
76:5.en: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur

76:6.ar: عَيْناࣰ يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اُ۬للَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيراࣰۖ
76:6.en: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly

76:7.ar: يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْماࣰ كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيراࣰۖ
76:7.en: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading

76:8.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ اَ۬لطَّعَامَ عَلَيٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِيناࣰ وَيَتِيماࣰ وَأَسِيراً
76:8.en: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him

76:9.ar: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اِ۬للَّهِۖ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَلَا شُكُوراًۖ
76:9.en: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you

76:10.ar: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْماً عَبُوساࣰ قَمْطَرِيراࣰۖ
76:10.en: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate

76:11.ar: فَوَق۪يٰهُمُ اُ۬للَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْيَوْمِ وَلَقّ۪يٰهُمْ نَضْرَةࣰ وَسُرُوراࣰۖ
76:11.en: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy

76:12.en: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire

76:13.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٕينَ فِيهَا عَلَي اَ۬لَارَآئِكِ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْساࣰ وَلَا زَمْهَرِيراࣰ‏
76:13.en: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold

76:14.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلاࣰۖ
76:14.en: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down

76:15.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةࣲ مِّن فِضَّةࣲ وَأَكْوَابࣲ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيراࣰۖ
76:15.en: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass

76:16.en: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds)

76:17.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْساࣰ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلاً
76:17.en: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil

76:18.en: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil

76:19.ar: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنࣱ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤاࣰ مَّنثُوراࣰۖ
76:19.en: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls

76:20.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيماࣰ وَمُلْكاࣰ كَبِيراً
76:20.en: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate

76:21.ar: عَٰلِيهِمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرࣱ وَإِسْتَبْرَقࣱۖ وَحُلُّوٓاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةࣲۖ وَسَق۪يٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَاباࣰ طَهُوراًۖ
76:21.en: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink

76:22.ar: اِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُوراًۖ
76:22.en: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance

76:23.ar: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ اَ۬لْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلاࣰۖ
76:23.en: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation

76:24.ar: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمُۥٓ ءَاثِماً اَوْ كَفُوراࣰۖ
76:24.en: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever

76:25.en: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening

76:26.ar: وَمِنَ اَ۬ليْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلاࣰ طَوِيلاًۖ
76:26.en: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night

76:27.ar: اِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ اَ۬لْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْماࣰ ثَقِيلاࣰۖ
76:27.en: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day

76:28.ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلاًۖ
76:28.en: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead

76:29.ar: اِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةࣱۖ فَمَن شَآءَ اَ۪تَّخَذَ إِلَيٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلاࣰۖ
76:29.en: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord

76:30.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَنْ يَّشَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُۖ إِنَّ اَ۬للَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيماً حَكِيماࣰۖ
76:30.en: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise

76:31.ar: يُدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَآءُ فِے رَحْمَتِهِۦۖ وَالظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَاباً اَلِيماࣰۖ
76:31.en: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom

77:1.en: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another

77:3.en: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive

77:4.en: By those who winnow with a winnowing

77:5.en: By those who bring down the Reminder

77:7.en: Surely that which ye are promised will befall

77:8.en: So when the stars are put out

77:9.en: And when the sky is riven asunder

77:10.en: And when the mountains are blown away

77:11.en: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed

77:12.en: For what day is the time appointed

77:14.en: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is

77:15.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:16.en: Destroyed We not the former folk

77:17.en: Then caused the latter folk to follow after

77:18.en: Thus deal We ever with the guilty

77:19.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:20.en: Did We not create you from a base fluid

77:21.en: Which We laid up in a safe abode

77:23.en: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging

77:24.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:25.en: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

77:26.en: Both for the living and the dead

77:27.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ شَٰمِخَٰتࣲ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءࣰ فُرَاتاࣰۖ
77:27.en: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein

77:28.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:29.ar: اَ۪نطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
77:29.en: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny

77:30.ar: اَ۪نطَلِقُوٓاْ إِلَيٰ ظِلࣲّ ذِے ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبࣲ‏
77:30.en: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold

77:31.ar: لَّا ظَلِيلࣲ وَلَا يُغْنِے مِنَ اَ۬للَّهَبِۖ
77:31.en: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame

77:32.en: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles

77:33.en: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue

77:34.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:35.en: This is a day wherein they speak not

77:36.en: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses

77:37.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:38.en: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together

77:39.en: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me

77:40.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:41.en: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains

77:42.en: And fruits such as they desire

77:43.ar: كُلُواْ وَاشْرَبُواْۖ هَنِيٓـٔاَۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَۖ
77:43.en: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did

77:44.en: Thus do We reward the good

77:45.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:46.en: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty

77:47.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:48.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ اُ۪رْكَعُواْ لَا يَرْكَعُونَۖ
77:48.en: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down

77:49.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

77:50.en: In what statement, after this, will they believe

78:1.en: Whereof do they question one another

78:3.en: Concerning which they are in disagreement

78:4.en: Nay, but they will come to know

78:5.en: Nay, again, but they will come to know

78:6.en: Have We not made the earth an expanse

78:8.en: And We have created you in pairs

78:9.en: And have appointed your sleep for repose

78:10.en: And have appointed the night as a cloak

78:11.en: And have appointed the day for livelihood

78:12.en: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens)

78:13.en: And have appointed a dazzling lamp

78:14.en: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water

78:15.en: Thereby to produce grain and plant

78:17.en: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time

78:18.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِے اِ۬لصُّورِ فَتَاتُونَ أَفْوَاجاࣰ‏
78:18.en: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes

78:19.en: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates

78:20.en: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage

78:23.en: They will abide therein for ages

78:24.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْداࣰ وَلَا شَرَاباً
78:24.en: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink

78:25.en: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold

78:27.en: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning

78:28.en: They called Our revelations false with strong denial

78:29.en: Everything have We recorded in a Book

78:30.en: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment

78:31.en: Lo! for the duteous is achievement

78:33.en: And voluptuous women of equal age

78:35.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواࣰ وَلَا كِذَّاباࣰۖ
78:35.en: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying

78:36.en: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment

78:37.ar: رَّبُّ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَاۖ اَ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَاباࣰۖ
78:37.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse

78:38.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ اُ۬لرُّوحُ وَالْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفّاࣰ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنَ اَذِنَ لَهُ اُ۬لرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَاباࣰۖ
78:38.en: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right

78:39.ar: ذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْيَوْمُ اُ۬لْحَقُّۖ فَمَن شَآءَ اَ۪تَّخَذَ إِلَيٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔاباًۖ
78:39.en: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord

78:40.ar: اِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَاباࣰ قَرِيباࣰ يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ اُ۬لْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَٰهُ وَيَقُولُ اُ۬لْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِے كُنتُ تُرَٰباࣰۖ
78:40.en: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust

79:1.en: By those who drag forth to destruction

79:5.en: And those who govern the event

79:6.en: On the day when the first trump resoundeth

79:8.en: On that day hearts beat painfully

79:10.en: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state

79:11.en: Even after we are crumbled bones

79:12.en: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding

79:13.en: Surely it will need but one shout

79:14.en: And lo! they will be awakened

79:15.en: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses

79:16.ar: إِذْ نَاد۪يٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِالْوَادِ اِ۬لْمُقَدَّسِ طُوَيۖ
79:16.en: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa

79:17.en: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled

79:18.ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَيٰٓ أَن تَزَّكّ۪يٰ
79:18.en: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)

79:19.en: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him)

79:20.en: And he showed him the tremendous token

79:22.en: Then turned he away in haste

79:24.en: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest

79:25.en: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former

79:26.ar: إِنَّ فِے ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةࣰ لِّمَنْ يَّخْش۪يٰٓۖ
79:26.en: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth

79:27.ar: ءَآنتُمُۥٓ أَشَدُّ خَلْقاً اَمِ اِ۬لسَّمَآءُۖ بَنَيٰهَا
79:27.en: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built

79:28.en: He raised the height thereof and ordered it

79:29.en: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof

79:30.en: And after that He spread the earth

79:31.en: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof

79:32.en: And He made fast the hills

79:33.en: A provision for you and for your cattle

79:34.en: But when the great disaster cometh

79:35.en: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour

79:36.en: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth

79:37.en: Then, as for him who rebelled

79:38.en: And chose the life of the world

79:39.en: Lo! hell will be his home

79:40.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَي اَ۬لنَّفْسَ عَنِ اِ۬لْهَو۪يٰ
79:40.en: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust

79:41.en: Lo! the Garden will be his home

79:42.en: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port

79:43.en: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof

79:44.en: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof

79:45.en: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it

79:46.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓاْ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً اَوْ ضُحَيٰهَاۖ
79:46.en: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof

80:2.en: Because the blind man came unto him

80:3.en: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)

80:4.en: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him

80:5.en: As for him who thinketh himself independent

80:7.en: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)

80:8.en: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose

80:11.en: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment

80:12.en: So let whosoever will pay heed to it

80:18.en: From what thing doth He create him

80:19.en: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him

80:20.en: Then maketh the way easy for him

80:21.en: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him

80:22.en: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life

80:23.en: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him

80:25.en: How We pour water in showers

80:26.en: Then split the earth in clefts

80:27.en: And cause the grain to grow therein

80:32.en: Provision for you and your cattle

80:34.en: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother

80:35.en: And his mother and his father

80:36.en: And his wife and his children

80:37.ar: لِكُلِّ اِ۪مْرِےࣲٕ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذࣲ شَأْنࣱ يُغْنِيهِۖ
80:37.en: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others)

80:38.en: On that day faces will be bright as dawn

80:40.en: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them

80:42.en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked

81:3.en: And when the hills are moved

81:4.en: And when the camels big with young are abandoned

81:5.en: And when the wild beasts are herded together

81:8.en: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked

81:9.en: For what sin she was slain

81:10.en: And when the pages are laid open

81:11.en: And when the sky is torn away

81:13.en: And when the Garden is brought nigh

81:14.en: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready

81:15.en: Oh, but I call to witness the planets

81:16.en: The stars which rise and set

81:19.en: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger

81:20.ar: ذِے قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِے اِ۬لْعَرْشِ مَكِينࣲ‏
81:20.en: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne

81:22.en: And your comrade is not mad

81:23.en: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon

81:24.en: And he is not avid of the Unseen

81:25.en: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned

81:27.en: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation

81:28.en: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight

81:29.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَنْ يَّشَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُ رَبُّ اُ۬لْعَٰلَمِينَۖ
81:29.en: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation

82:1.en: When the heaven is cleft asunder

82:3.en: When the seas are poured forth

82:5.en: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind

82:6.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لِانسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ اَ۬لْكَرِيمِ
82:6.en: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful

82:7.en: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee

82:8.ar: فِےٓ أَيِّ صُورَةࣲ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَۖ
82:8.en: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee

82:9.en: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment

82:10.en: Lo! there are above you guardians

82:13.en: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight

82:14.en: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell

82:15.en: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment

82:16.en: And will not be absent thence

82:17.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

82:18.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْر۪يٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ اُ۬لدِّينِۖ
82:18.en: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

82:19.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسࣱ لِّنَفْسࣲ شَئْاࣰۖ وَالَامْرُ يَوْمَئِذࣲ لِّلهِۖ
82:19.en: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's

83:2.ar: اَ۬لذِينَ إِذَا اَ۪كْتَالُواْ عَلَي اَ۬لنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
83:2.en: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full

83:3.en: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss

83:4.en: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again

83:6.en: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds

83:7.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ اَ۬لْفُجّ۪ارِ لَفِے سِجِّينࣲۖ
83:7.en: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin

83:8.en: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is

83:10.en: Woe unto the repudiators on that day

83:11.en: Those who deny the Day of Judgment

83:12.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ اَثِيمٍ
83:12.en: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor

83:13.ar: اِذَا تُتْل۪يٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ اُ۬لَاوَّلِينَۖ
83:13.en: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old

83:14.ar: ۞كَلَّا بَل رَّانَ عَلَيٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَۖ
83:14.en: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts

83:15.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذࣲ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَۖ
83:15.en: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord

83:16.en: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell

83:17.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا اَ۬لذِے كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَۖ
83:17.en: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny

83:18.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ اَ۬لَابْر۪ارِ لَفِے عِلِّيِّينَۖ
83:18.en: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin

83:19.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is

83:21.en: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)

83:22.en: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight

83:24.en: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight

83:25.en: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed

83:26.ar: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكࣱۖ وَفِے ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ اِ۬لْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَۖ
83:26.en: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss

83:27.en: And mixed with water of Tasnim

83:28.en: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink

83:29.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ أَجْرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضْحَكُونَ
83:29.en: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed

83:30.en: And wink one to another when they passed them

83:31.ar: وَإِذَا اَ۪نقَلَبُوٓاْ إِلَيٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ اُ۪نقَلَبُواْ فَٰكِهِينَ
83:31.en: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting

83:32.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
83:32.en: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray

83:33.en: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them

83:34.ar: فَالْيَوْمَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنَ اَ۬لْكُفّ۪ارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
83:34.en: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers

83:36.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ اَ۬لْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفْعَلُونَۖ
83:36.en: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do

84:1.en: When the heaven is split asunder

84:2.en: And attentive to her Lord in fear

84:3.en: And when the earth is spread out

84:4.en: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty

84:5.en: And attentive to her Lord in fear

84:6.ar: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا اَ۬لِانسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ اِلَيٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحاࣰ فَمُلَٰقِيهِۖ
84:6.en: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence)

84:7.en: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand

84:8.en: He truly will receive an easy reckoning

84:9.en: And will return unto his folk in joy

84:10.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنُ ا۟وتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
84:10.en: But whoso is given his account behind his back

84:12.en: And be thrown to scorching fire

84:13.en: He verily lived joyous with his folk

84:14.en: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)

84:15.ar: بَل۪يٰٓۖ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيراࣰۖ
84:15.en: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him

84:16.en: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset

84:17.en: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth

84:18.en: And by the moon when she is at the full

84:19.en: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane

84:20.en: What aileth them, then, that they believe not

84:21.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِۓَ عَلَيْهِمُ اُ۬لْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ۩ۖ
84:21.en: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)

84:22.en: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny

84:23.en: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding

84:24.en: So give them tidings of a painful doom

84:25.ar: اِلَّا اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمُۥٓ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونࣲۖ
84:25.en: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing

85:1.en: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars

85:3.en: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony

85:4.en: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

85:7.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَيٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِالْمُومِنِينَ شُهُودࣱۖ
85:7.en: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers

85:8.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنْهُمُۥٓ إِلَّآ أَنْ يُّومِنُواْ بِاللَّهِ اِ۬لْعَزِيزِ اِ۬لْحَمِيدِ
85:8.en: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise

85:9.ar: اِ۬لذِے لَهُۥ مُلْكُ اُ۬لسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَالَارْضِۖ وَاللَّهُ عَلَيٰ كُلِّ شَےْءࣲ شَهِيدٌۖ
85:9.en: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness

85:10.ar: اِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ فَتَنُواْ اُ۬لْمُومِنِينَ وَالْمُومِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ اُ۬لْحَرِيقِۖ
85:10.en: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning

85:11.ar: إِنَّ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ اُ۬لصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجْرِے مِن تَحْتِهَا اَ۬لَانْهَٰرُۖ ذَٰلِكَ اَ۬لْفَوْزُ اُ۬لْكَبِيرُۖ
85:11.en: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success

85:12.en: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern

85:13.en: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth

85:14.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving

85:15.en: Lord of the Throne of Glory

85:17.en: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts

85:18.en: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud

85:19.en: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial

85:20.en: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them

85:21.en: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an

86:1.en: By the heaven and the Morning Star

86:2.en: Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is

86:4.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسࣲ لَّمَا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظࣱۖ
86:4.en: No human soul but hath a guardian over it

86:5.en: So let man consider from what he is created

86:6.en: He is created from a gushing fluid

86:7.en: That issued from between the loins and ribs

86:8.en: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)

86:9.en: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out

86:10.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةࣲ وَلَا نَاصِرࣲۖ
86:10.en: Then will he have no might nor any helper

86:11.en: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain

86:12.en: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)

86:13.en: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word

86:15.en: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)

86:16.en: And I plot a plot (against them)

86:17.en: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while

87:1.en: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High

87:5.en: Then turneth it to russet stubble

87:6.en: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget

87:7.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ اَ۬للَّهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ اُ۬لْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْف۪يٰۖ
87:7.en: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden

87:8.en: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease

87:9.en: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder

87:11.en: But the most hapless will flout it

87:12.en: He who will be flung to the great Fire

87:13.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْي۪يٰۖ
87:13.en: Wherein he will neither die nor live

87:15.en: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth

87:16.en: But ye prefer the life of the world

87:17.en: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting

87:18.en: Lo! This is in the former scrolls

87:19.en: The Books of Abraham and Moses

88:1.en: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming

88:2.en: On that day (many) faces will be downcast

88:6.ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ اِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعࣲ‏
88:6.en: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit

88:7.ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِے مِن جُوعࣲۖ
88:7.en: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger

88:8.en: In that day other faces will be calm

88:11.en: Where they hear no idle speech

88:17.en: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created

88:18.en: And the heaven, how it is raised

88:19.en: And the hills, how they are set up

88:20.en: And the earth, how it is spread

88:21.en: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer

88:22.en: Thou art not at all a warder over them

88:23.en: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth

88:24.en: Allah will punish him with direst punishment

88:25.en: Lo! unto Us is their return

89:3.en: And the Even and the Odd

89:4.en: And the night when it departeth

89:5.ar: هَلْ فِے ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمࣱ لِّذِے حِجْرٍۖ
89:5.en: There surely is an oath for thinking man

89:6.ar: اَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
89:6.en: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad

89:8.ar: اِ۬لتِے لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِے اِ۬لْبِلَٰدِ
89:8.en: The like of which was not created in the lands

89:9.en: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley

89:10.en: And with Pharaoh, firm of might

89:11.en: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands

89:13.en: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment

89:14.en: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful

89:15.ar: فَأَمَّا اَ۬لِانسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا اَ۪بْتَل۪يٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيَ أَكْرَمَنِۦۖ
89:15.en: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me

89:16.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا اَ۪بْتَل۪يٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيَ أَهَٰنَنِۦ
89:16.en: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me

89:17.en: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan

89:18.en: And urge not on the feeding of the poor

89:19.en: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed

89:20.en: And love wealth with abounding love

89:21.ar: كَلَّآۖ إِذَا دُكَّتِ اِ۬لَارْضُ دَكّاࣰ دَكّاࣰ‏
89:21.en: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding

89:22.en: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank

89:23.ar: وَجِےٓءَ يَوْمَئِذِۢ بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذࣲ يَتَذَكَّرُ اُ۬لِانسَٰنُ وَأَنّ۪يٰ لَهُ اُ۬لذِّكْر۪يٰۖ
89:23.en: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)

89:24.en: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life

89:25.en: None punisheth as He will punish on that day

89:26.en: None bindeth as He then will bind

89:27.en: But ah! thou soul at peace

89:28.en: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure

90:1.en: Nay, I swear by this city

90:2.en: And thou art an indweller of this city

90:3.en: And the begetter and that which he begat

90:4.en: We verily have created man in an atmosphere

90:5.ar: اَيَحْسِبُ أَن لَّنْ يَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدࣱ‏
90:5.en: Thinketh he that none hath power over him

90:6.en: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth

90:7.en: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him

90:8.en: Did We not assign unto him two eyes

90:9.en: And a tongue and two lips

90:10.en: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways

90:11.en: But he hath not attempted the Ascent

90:12.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is

90:14.ar: اَوِ اِطْعَامࣱ فِے يَوْمࣲ ذِے مَسْغَبَةࣲ‏
90:14.en: And to feed in the day of hunger

90:16.en: Or some poor wretch in misery

90:17.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ اَ۬لذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوْاْ بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْاْ بِالْمَرْحَمَةِۖ
90:17.en: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity

90:18.en: Their place will be on the right hand

90:19.ar: وَالذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمُۥٓ أَصْحَٰبُ اُ۬لْمَشْـَٔمَةِۖ
90:19.en: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand

90:20.en: Fire will be an awning over them

91:1.en: By the sun and his brightness

91:2.en: And the moon when she followeth him

91:3.en: And the day when it revealeth him

91:4.en: And the night when it enshroudeth him

91:5.en: And the heaven and Him Who built it

91:6.en: And the earth and Him Who spread it

91:7.en: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

91:8.en: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it

91:9.en: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow

91:10.en: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it

91:11.en: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride

91:12.en: When the basest of them broke forth

91:13.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اُ۬للَّهِ نَاقَةَ اَ۬للَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
91:13.en: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink

91:14.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّيٰهَاۖ
91:14.en: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings)

91:15.en: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events)

92:3.en: And Him Who hath created male and female

92:4.en: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends)

92:5.en: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)

92:7.en: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease

92:8.en: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent

92:10.en: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity

92:11.ar: وَمَا يُغْنِے عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدّ۪يٰٓۖ
92:11.en: His riches will not save him when he perisheth

92:12.en: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance

92:13.en: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former

92:14.en: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire

92:15.en: Which only the most wretched must endure

92:16.en: He who denieth and turneth away

92:17.en: Far removed from it will be the righteous

92:18.en: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness)

92:19.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةࣲ تُجْز۪يٰٓ
92:19.en: And none hath with him any favour for reward

92:20.en: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High

93:2.en: And by the night when it is stillest
